## Write the model stg_acq__procedures
Domain: procedures. Acquired data format: claims export (CARIN consumer-directed payer data, one row per claim line). Raw schema: raw_claims.
## Staging contract (columns and types your model must return)
procedure_start_datetime TIMESTAMP
procedure_start_date DATE
procedure_stop_datetime TIMESTAMP
procedure_stop_date DATE
patient_id VARCHAR
encounter_id VARCHAR
procedure_code VARCHAR
procedure_description VARCHAR
procedure_base_cost FLOAT
procedure_reason_code VARCHAR
procedure_reason_description VARCHAR
## The acquirer's staging model stg_synthea__procedures (it reads the acquirer's own CSV source; shown for its conventions)
```sql
{% set column_names = 
    dbt_utils.get_filtered_columns_in_relation( source('synthea', 'procedures') ) 
%}


WITH cte_procedures_lower AS (

    SELECT
        {{ lowercase_columns(column_names) }}
    FROM {{ source('synthea','procedures') }}
)

, cte_procedures_rename AS (

    SELECT
        {{ timestamptz_to_naive(adapter.quote("start")) }} AS procedure_start_datetime
        , {{ timestamptz_to_naive(adapter.quote("stop")) }} AS procedure_stop_datetime
        , patient AS patient_id
        , encounter AS encounter_id
        , code AS procedure_code
        , description AS procedure_description
        , base_cost AS procedure_base_cost
        , reasoncode AS procedure_reason_code
        , reasondescription AS procedure_reason_description
    FROM cte_procedures_lower

)

, cte_procedures_date_columns AS (

    SELECT
        procedure_start_datetime
        , {{ dbt.cast("procedure_start_datetime", api.Column.translate_type("date")) }} AS procedure_start_date
        , procedure_stop_datetime
        , {{ dbt.cast("procedure_stop_datetime", api.Column.translate_type("date")) }} AS procedure_stop_date
        , patient_id
        , encounter_id
        , procedure_code
        , procedure_description
        , procedure_base_cost
        , procedure_reason_code
        , procedure_reason_description
    FROM cte_procedures_rename

)

SELECT *
FROM cte_procedures_date_columns
```

```sql
    , CAST(reaction_2_severity AS VARCHAR) AS reaction_2_severity
```

```sql
    FROM {{ source('raw_d1', 'allergy_list') }}

    FROM (

        UNION ALL
```

```sql
WITH src AS (

    SELECT
        NULLIF(TRIM(start_date), '') AS start_date
        , NULLIF(TRIM(start_time), '') AS start_time
        , NULLIF(TRIM(stop_date), '') AS stop_date
        , NULLIF(TRIM(stop_time), '') AS stop_time
        , NULLIF(TRIM(patient), '') AS patient
        , NULLIF(TRIM(payer), '') AS payer
        , NULLIF(TRIM(encounter), '') AS encounter
        , NULLIF(TRIM(code_display), '') AS code_display
        , base_cost
        , payer_coverage
        , dispenses
        , totalcost
        , NULLIF(TRIM(reason), '') AS reason
    FROM {{ source('raw_d2', 'medications') }}

)

, parsed AS (

    SELECT
        CAST(try_strptime(
            start_date || ' ' || COALESCE(start_time, '00:00:00')
            , ['%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S', '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S']
        ) AS TIMESTAMP) AS medication_start_datetime
        , CAST(try_strptime(
            stop_date || ' ' || COALESCE(stop_time, '00:00:00')
            , ['%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S', '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S']
        ) AS TIMESTAMP) AS medication_stop_datetime
        , patient
        , payer
        , encounter
        , code_display
        , POSITION(' | ' IN code_display) AS code_pos
        , base_cost
        , payer_coverage
        , dispenses
        , totalcost
        , reason
        , POSITION(' | ' IN reason) AS reason_pos
    FROM src

)

SELECT
    medication_start_datetime
    , CAST(medication_start_datetime AS DATE) AS medication_start_date
    , medication_stop_datetime
    , CAST(medication_stop_datetime AS DATE) AS medication_stop_date
    , CAST(patient AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id
    , CAST(payer AS VARCHAR) AS payer_id
    , CAST(encounter AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id
    , CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN code_display IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN code_pos = 0 THEN code_display
            ELSE TRIM(SUBSTR(code_display, 1, code_pos - 1))
        END AS VARCHAR) AS medication_code
    , CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN code_display IS NULL OR code_pos = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE NULLIF(TRIM(SUBSTR(code_display, code_pos + 3)), '')
        END AS VARCHAR) AS medication_description
    , CAST(base_cost AS FLOAT) AS medication_base_cost
    , CAST(payer_coverage AS FLOAT) AS medication_payer_coverage
    , CAST(dispenses AS FLOAT) AS dispenses
    , CAST(totalcost AS FLOAT) AS medication_total_cost
    , CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN reason IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN reason_pos = 0 THEN reason
            ELSE TRIM(SUBSTR(reason, 1, reason_pos - 1))
        END AS VARCHAR) AS medication_reason_code
    , CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN reason IS NULL OR reason_pos = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE NULLIF(TRIM(SUBSTR(reason, reason_pos + 3)), '')
        END AS VARCHAR) AS medication_reason_description
FROM parsed
```

```sql
WITH src AS (

    SELECT
        resource
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'observation') }}
    WHERE json_extract_string(resource, '$.resourceType') = 'Observation'
    QUALIFY row_number() OVER (
        PARTITION BY coalesce(json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'), id)
        ORDER BY json_extract_string(resource, '$.issued') DESC NULLS LAST
    ) = 1

)

-- observations without components: the resource itself carries code and value
, plain AS (

    SELECT
        resource
        , resource AS node
    FROM src
    WHERE coalesce(json_array_length(resource -> '$.component'), 0) = 0

)

-- panels (blood pressure, surveys): one row per component, as in the CSV convention
, comps AS (

    SELECT
        resource
        , unnest(from_json(resource -> '$.component', '["JSON"]')) AS node
    FROM src
    WHERE coalesce(json_array_length(resource -> '$.component'), 0) > 0

)

, all_nodes AS (

    SELECT resource, node FROM plain
    UNION ALL
    SELECT resource, node FROM comps

)

, extracted AS (

    SELECT
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.effectiveDateTime')
            , json_extract_string(resource, '$.issued')
        ) AS effective_raw
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference') AS subject_ref
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.context.reference') AS context_ref
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.category[0].coding[0].code') AS category_code
        , json_extract_string(node, '$.code.coding[0].code') AS code_value
        , coalesce(
            json_extract_string(node, '$.code.coding[0].display')
            , json_extract_string(node, '$.code.text')
        ) AS code_display
        , json_extract_string(node, '$.valueQuantity.value') AS quantity_value
        , json_extract_string(node, '$.valueQuantity.unit') AS quantity_unit
        , coalesce(
            json_extract_string(node, '$.valueString')
            , json_extract_string(node, '$.valueCodeableConcept.text')
            , json_extract_string(node, '$.valueCodeableConcept.coding[0].display')
        ) AS text_value
    FROM all_nodes

)

, final AS (

    SELECT
        CAST(CAST(effective_raw AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP) AS observation_datetime
        , regexp_replace(subject_ref, '^.*[:/]', '') AS patient_id
        , regexp_replace(context_ref, '^.*[:/]', '') AS encounter_id
        , category_code AS observation_category
        , code_value AS observation_code
        , code_display AS observation_description
        , coalesce(quantity_value, text_value) AS observation_value
        , quantity_unit AS observation_units
        , CASE WHEN quantity_value IS NOT NULL THEN 'numeric' ELSE 'text' END AS observation_value_type
    FROM extracted

)

SELECT
    CAST(observation_datetime AS TIMESTAMP) AS observation_datetime
    , CAST(observation_datetime AS DATE) AS observation_date
    , CAST(patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id
    , CAST(encounter_id AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id
    , CAST(observation_category AS VARCHAR) AS observation_category
    , CAST(observation_code AS VARCHAR) AS observation_code
    , CAST(observation_description AS VARCHAR) AS observation_description
    , CAST(observation_value AS VARCHAR) AS observation_value
    , CAST(observation_units AS VARCHAR) AS observation_units
    , CAST(observation_value_type AS VARCHAR) AS observation_value_type
FROM final
```

```sql
            codings[1]
        ) AS coding
    FROM src

, raw_vals AS (

    SELECT
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.onsetDateTime') AS onset_raw,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.abatementDateTime') AS abatement_raw,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference') AS subject_ref,

        json_extract_string(coding, '$.code') AS code_val,
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(coding, '$.display'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text')
        ) AS description_val
    FROM picked

)

SELECT

        WHEN onset_raw IS NULL THEN NULL
        WHEN length(onset_raw) = 10 THEN CAST(onset_raw AS DATE)
        ELSE CAST(timezone('UTC', CAST(onset_raw AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) AS DATE)
    END AS condition_start_date,
    CASE
        WHEN abatement_raw IS NULL THEN NULL
        WHEN length(abatement_raw) = 10 THEN CAST(abatement_raw AS DATE)
        ELSE CAST(timezone('UTC', CAST(abatement_raw AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) AS DATE)
    END AS condition_stop_date,
    CAST(lower(regexp_replace(subject_ref, '^.*[:/]', '')) AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id,
    CAST(lower(regexp_replace(encounter_ref, '^.*[:/]', '')) AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id,
    CAST(code_val AS VARCHAR) AS condition_code,

FROM raw_vals
```

```sql
WITH src AS (

    SELECT
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.onsetDateTime') AS onset_raw
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.assertedDate') AS asserted_raw
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.abatementDateTime') AS abatement_raw
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference') AS subject_ref
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.context.reference') AS context_ref
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') AS code_val
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display') AS display_val
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text') AS text_val
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'condition') }}
    WHERE json_extract_string(resource, '$.resourceType') = 'Condition'

)

, cte_prepared AS (

    SELECT
        COALESCE(onset_raw, asserted_raw) AS start_raw
        , abatement_raw AS stop_raw
        , regexp_replace(subject_ref, '^(urn:uuid:|.*/)', '') AS patient_id
        , regexp_replace(context_ref, '^(urn:uuid:|.*/)', '') AS encounter_id
        , code_val AS condition_code
        , COALESCE(display_val, text_val) AS condition_description
    FROM src

)

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN start_raw IS NULL THEN NULL
        WHEN length(start_raw) > 10
             AND regexp_matches(start_raw, '(Z|[+-][0-9]{2}:?[0-9]{2})$')
            THEN CAST(CAST(start_raw AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS DATE)
        ELSE CAST(substr(start_raw, 1, 10) AS DATE)
    END AS condition_start_date
    , CASE
        WHEN stop_raw IS NULL THEN NULL
        WHEN length(stop_raw) > 10
             AND regexp_matches(stop_raw, '(Z|[+-][0-9]{2}:?[0-9]{2})$')
            THEN CAST(CAST(stop_raw AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS DATE)
        ELSE CAST(substr(stop_raw, 1, 10) AS DATE)
    END AS condition_stop_date
    , CAST(patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id
    , CAST(encounter_id AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id
    , CAST(condition_code AS VARCHAR) AS condition_code
    , CAST(condition_description AS VARCHAR) AS condition_description
FROM cte_prepared
```

```sql
WITH src AS (

    SELECT
        TRIM("Patient account number") AS patient_raw
        , TRIM("Medical record number") AS encounter_raw
        , TRIM("Procedure code") AS code_raw
        , TRIM("Procedure description") AS description_raw
        , TRIM("Procedure date") AS procedure_date_raw
    FROM {{ source('raw_claims', 'claims') }}
    WHERE "Procedure code" IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM("Procedure code") <> ''

)

, typed AS (

    SELECT
        TRY_CAST(procedure_date_raw AS TIMESTAMP) AS procedure_datetime
        , LOWER(patient_raw) AS patient_id
        , LOWER(NULLIF(encounter_raw, '')) AS encounter_id
        , code_raw AS procedure_code
        , NULLIF(description_raw, '') AS procedure_description
    FROM src

)

SELECT
    procedure_datetime AS procedure_start_datetime
    , CAST(procedure_datetime AS DATE) AS procedure_start_date
    , procedure_datetime AS procedure_stop_datetime
    , CAST(procedure_datetime AS DATE) AS procedure_stop_date
    , CAST(patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id
    , CAST(encounter_id AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id
    , CAST(procedure_code AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_code
    , CAST(procedure_description AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_description
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS procedure_base_cost
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_reason_code
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_reason_description
FROM typed
```

```sql
        , try_cast(start_time_txt as time) as start_t
        , cast(coalesce(
            try_strptime(stop_date_txt, '%m/%d/%Y')
            , try_strptime(stop_date_txt, '%d-%b-%Y')
        ) as date) as stop_d
        , try_cast(stop_time_txt as time) as stop_t
        , patient
        , payer
        , encounter
        , code_display
        , strpos(code_display, ' | ') as code_pos
        , reason
        , strpos(reason, ' | ') as reason_pos
        , base_cost
        , payer_coverage
        , dispenses
        , totalcost
    from src

)

    cast(start_d + coalesce(start_t, cast('00:00:00' as time)) as timestamp) as medication_start_datetime
    , cast(start_d as date) as medication_start_date
    , cast(stop_d + coalesce(stop_t, cast('00:00:00' as time)) as timestamp) as medication_stop_datetime
    , cast(stop_d as date) as medication_stop_date
    , cast(lower(patient) as varchar) as patient_id

    , cast(lower(encounter) as varchar) as encounter_id
    , cast(case
        when code_display is null then null
        when code_pos = 0 then code_display

    , cast(case
        when code_display is null then null
        when code_pos = 0 then null

    , cast(case
```

## Mapping hints
- start date is the first 10 characters of recordedDate (R4) or assertedDate (STU3); there is no stop date.
- patient is patient.reference without the urn:uuid: prefix. The resource has no encounter reference: use the patient's Encounter whose period.start equals that timestamp.
- code and description are code.coding[0]; system is SNOMED-CT or RxNorm according to the coding system URL; type is type; category is category[0].
- reaction 1 and 2 are reaction[0] and reaction[1]: manifestation[0].coding[0].code and .display, severity in upper case. Commas in text become spaces.
text:
```sql
WITH allergies AS (

    SELECT
        id AS resource_id
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.recordedDate') AS recorded_raw
        , CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.recordedDate') AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AS recorded_ts
        , replace(json_extract_string(resource, '$.patient.reference'), 'urn:uuid:', '') AS patient_id
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') AS allergy_code
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].system') AS system_url
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display') AS allergy_description
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.type') AS allergy_type
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.category[0]') AS allergy_category
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].code') AS reaction_1_code
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].display') AS reaction_1_description
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[0].severity') AS reaction_1_severity
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].coding[0].code') AS reaction_2_code
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].coding[0].display') AS reaction_2_description
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[1].severity') AS reaction_2_severity
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'allergyintolerance') }}

)

, encounters AS (

    SELECT
        replace(json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'), 'urn:uuid:', '') AS patient_id
        , CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start') AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AS start_ts
        , min(json_extract_string(resource, '$.id')) AS encounter_id
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'encounter') }}
    GROUP BY 1, 2

)

SELECT
    CAST(CAST(a.recorded_ts AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS allergy_start_date
    , CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS allergy_stop_date
    , CAST(a.patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id
    , CAST(e.encounter_id AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id
    , CAST(a.allergy_code AS VARCHAR) AS allergy_code
    , CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN a.system_url = 'http://snomed.info/sct' THEN 'SNOMED-CT'
            WHEN a.system_url = 'http://www.nlm.nih.gov/research/umls/rxnorm' THEN 'RxNorm'
            WHEN lower(a.system_url) LIKE '%snomed%' THEN 'SNOMED-CT'
            WHEN lower(a.system_url) LIKE '%rxnorm%' THEN 'RxNorm'
            ELSE a.system_url
        END AS VARCHAR) AS allergy_code_system
    , CAST(replace(a.allergy_description, ',', ' ') AS VARCHAR) AS allergy_description
    , CAST(a.allergy_type AS VARCHAR) AS allergy_type
    , CAST(a.allergy_category AS VARCHAR) AS allergy_category
    , CAST(a.reaction_1_code AS VARCHAR) AS reaction_1_code
    , CAST(replace(a.reaction_1_description, ',', ' ') AS VARCHAR) AS reaction_1_description
    , CAST(upper(a.reaction_1_severity) AS VARCHAR) AS reaction_1_severity
    , CAST(a.reaction_2_code AS VARCHAR) AS reaction_2_code
    , CAST(replace(a.reaction_2_description, ',', ' ') AS VARCHAR) AS reaction_2_description
    , CAST(upper(a.reaction_2_severity) AS VARCHAR) AS reaction_2_severity
FROM allergies AS a
LEFT JOIN encounters AS e
    ON a.patient_id = e.patient_id
    AND a.recorded_ts = e.start_ts
```

## Mapping hints
- start date is the first 10 characters of recordedDate (R4) or assertedDate (STU3); there is no stop date.
- patient is patient.reference without the urn:uuid: prefix. The resource has no encounter reference: use the patient's Encounter whose period.start equals that timestamp.
- code and description are code.coding[0]; system is SNOMED-CT or RxNorm according to the coding system URL; type is type; category is category[0].
- reaction 1 and 2 are reaction[0] and reaction[1]: manifestation[0].coding[0].code and .display, severity in upper case. Commas in text become spaces.
text:
```sql
WITH allergy_src AS (

    SELECT
        a.id AS source_id
        , json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.assertedDate') AS asserted_raw
        , replace(json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.patient.reference'), 'urn:uuid:', '') AS patient_id
        , json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') AS allergy_code
        , json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.coding[0].system') AS system_url
        , json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.coding[0].display') AS allergy_description
        , json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.type') AS allergy_type
        , json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.category[0]') AS allergy_category
        , json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].code') AS reaction_1_code
        , json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].display') AS reaction_1_description
        , json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.reaction[0].severity') AS reaction_1_severity
        , json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].coding[0].code') AS reaction_2_code
        , json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].coding[0].display') AS reaction_2_description
        , json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.reaction[1].severity') AS reaction_2_severity
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'allergyintolerance') }} AS a

)

, allergy_ts AS (

    SELECT
        *
        , TRY_CAST(asserted_raw AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AS asserted_ts
    FROM allergy_src

)

, encounter_src AS (

    SELECT
        replace(json_extract_string(e.resource, '$.subject.reference'), 'urn:uuid:', '') AS patient_id
        , TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(e.resource, '$.period.start') AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AS start_ts
        , e.id AS encounter_id
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'encounter') }} AS e

)

, encounter_dedup AS (

    SELECT
        patient_id
        , start_ts
        , MIN(encounter_id) AS encounter_id
    FROM encounter_src
    WHERE start_ts IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY patient_id, start_ts

)

SELECT
    CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN a.asserted_ts IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(a.asserted_ts AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS DATE)
            ELSE TRY_CAST(substr(a.asserted_raw, 1, 10) AS DATE)
        END AS DATE
    ) AS allergy_start_date
    , CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS allergy_stop_date
    , CAST(a.patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id
    , CAST(e.encounter_id AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id
    , CAST(a.allergy_code AS VARCHAR) AS allergy_code
    , CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN lower(a.system_url) LIKE '%snomed%' THEN 'SNOMED-CT'
            WHEN lower(a.system_url) LIKE '%rxnorm%' THEN 'RxNorm'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS allergy_code_system
    , CAST(replace(a.allergy_description, ',', ' ') AS VARCHAR) AS allergy_description
    , CAST(a.allergy_type AS VARCHAR) AS allergy_type
    , CAST(a.allergy_category AS VARCHAR) AS allergy_category
    , CAST(a.reaction_1_code AS VARCHAR) AS reaction_1_code
    , CAST(replace(a.reaction_1_description, ',', ' ') AS VARCHAR) AS reaction_1_description
    , CAST(upper(a.reaction_1_severity) AS VARCHAR) AS reaction_1_severity
    , CAST(a.reaction_2_code AS VARCHAR) AS reaction_2_code
    , CAST(replace(a.reaction_2_description, ',', ' ') AS VARCHAR) AS reaction_2_description
    , CAST(upper(a.reaction_2_severity) AS VARCHAR) AS reaction_2_severity
FROM allergy_ts AS a
LEFT JOIN encounter_dedup AS e
    ON e.patient_id = a.patient_id
    AND e.start_ts = a.asserted_ts
```

```sql
    SELECT
        resource,
        CAST(json_extract(resource, '$.code.coding') AS JSON[]) AS codings
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'condition') }}
    WHERE json_extract_string(resource, '$.resourceType') = 'Condition'

)

, picked AS (

    SELECT
        resource,
        COALESCE(
            list_filter(codings, x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.system') = 'http://snomed.info/sct')[1],
            codings[1]
        ) AS coding
    FROM src

)

, raw_vals AS (

    SELECT
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.onsetDateTime') AS onset_raw,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.abatementDateTime') AS abatement_raw,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference') AS subject_ref,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.encounter.reference') AS encounter_ref,
        json_extract_string(coding, '$.code') AS code_val,
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(coding, '$.display'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text')
        ) AS description_val
    FROM picked

)

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN onset_raw IS NULL THEN NULL
        WHEN length(onset_raw) = 10 THEN CAST(onset_raw AS DATE)
        ELSE CAST(timezone('UTC', CAST(onset_raw AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) AS DATE)
    END AS condition_start_date,
    CASE
        WHEN abatement_raw IS NULL THEN NULL
        WHEN length(abatement_raw) = 10 THEN CAST(abatement_raw AS DATE)
        ELSE CAST(timezone('UTC', CAST(abatement_raw AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) AS DATE)
    END AS condition_stop_date,
    CAST(lower(regexp_replace(subject_ref, '^.*[:/]', '')) AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id,
    CAST(lower(regexp_replace(encounter_ref, '^.*[:/]', '')) AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id,
    CAST(code_val AS VARCHAR) AS condition_code,
    CAST(description_val AS VARCHAR) AS condition_description
FROM raw_vals
```

```sql
            ELSE code_display
        END AS VARCHAR
```

```sql
WITH allergy_raw AS (

    SELECT
        id AS source_id
        , resource
        , regexp_replace(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.patient.reference')
            , '^(urn:uuid:|Patient/)'
            , ''
        ) AS patient_id
        , CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.recordedDate') AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AS recorded_ts
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'allergyintolerance') }}

)

, encounter_raw AS (

    SELECT
        id AS encounter_id
        , regexp_replace(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference')
            , '^(urn:uuid:|Patient/)'
            , ''
        ) AS patient_id
        , CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start') AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AS start_ts
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'encounter') }}

)

, encounter_pick AS (

    SELECT
        patient_id
        , start_ts
        , MIN(encounter_id) AS encounter_id
    FROM encounter_raw
    GROUP BY patient_id, start_ts

)

, allergy_parsed AS (

    SELECT
        source_id
        , patient_id
        , recorded_ts
        , CAST(timezone('UTC', recorded_ts) AS DATE) AS allergy_start_date
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') AS allergy_code
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].system') AS raw_system
        , COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display')
            , json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text')
        ) AS allergy_description
        , LOWER(json_extract_string(resource, '$.type')) AS allergy_type
        , LOWER(json_extract_string(resource, '$.category[0]')) AS allergy_category
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].code') AS reaction_1_code
        , COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].display')
            , json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].text')
        ) AS reaction_1_description
        , UPPER(json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[0].severity')) AS reaction_1_severity
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].coding[0].code') AS reaction_2_code
        , COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].coding[0].display')
            , json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].text')
        ) AS reaction_2_description
        , UPPER(json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[1].severity')) AS reaction_2_severity
    FROM allergy_raw

)

SELECT
    a.allergy_start_date AS allergy_start_date
    , CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS allergy_stop_date
    , CAST(a.patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id
    , CAST(e.encounter_id AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id
    , CAST(a.allergy_code AS VARCHAR) AS allergy_code
    , CAST(
        CASE a.raw_system
            WHEN 'http://snomed.info/sct' THEN 'SNOMED-CT'
            WHEN 'http://www.nlm.nih.gov/research/umls/rxnorm' THEN 'RxNorm'
            ELSE a.raw_system
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS allergy_code_system
    , CAST(a.allergy_description AS VARCHAR) AS allergy_description
    , CAST(a.allergy_type AS VARCHAR) AS allergy_type
    , CAST(a.allergy_category AS VARCHAR) AS allergy_category
    , CAST(a.reaction_1_code AS VARCHAR) AS reaction_1_code
    , CAST(a.reaction_1_description AS VARCHAR) AS reaction_1_description
    , CAST(a.reaction_1_severity AS VARCHAR) AS reaction_1_severity
    , CAST(a.reaction_2_code AS VARCHAR) AS reaction_2_code
    , CAST(a.reaction_2_description AS VARCHAR) AS reaction_2_description
    , CAST(a.reaction_2_severity AS VARCHAR) AS reaction_2_severity
FROM allergy_parsed AS a
LEFT JOIN encounter_pick AS e
    ON a.patient_id = e.patient_id
    AND a.recorded_ts = e.start_ts
```

```sql
WITH src AS (

    SELECT
        NULLIF(TRIM("Member id"), '') AS patient_id
        , NULLIF(TRIM("Date of birth"), '') AS dob_raw
        , NULLIF(TRIM("Date of death"), '') AS dod_raw
        , NULLIF(TRIM("Home_County"), '') AS county
        , NULLIF(TRIM("Home_State"), '') AS state_raw
        , NULLIF(TRIM("Home_Zip code"), '') AS zip
        , NULLIF(TRIM("Race code"), '') AS race_raw
        , NULLIF(TRIM("Ethnicity"), '') AS ethnicity_raw
        , NULLIF(TRIM("Gender code"), '') AS gender_raw
        , NULLIF(TRIM("Birth sex"), '') AS birth_sex_raw
        , NULLIF(TRIM("Name"), '') AS full_name
    FROM {{ source('raw_claims', 'members') }}

)

, dedup AS (

    SELECT
        *
        , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY patient_id ORDER BY dob_raw) AS rn
    FROM src
    WHERE patient_id IS NOT NULL

)

, cte_names AS (

    SELECT
        d.*
        , SPLIT_PART(full_name, ' ', 1) AS tok1
        , NULLIF(TRIM(SUBSTR(full_name, LENGTH(SPLIT_PART(full_name, ' ', 1)) + 1)), '') AS rest
    FROM dedup AS d
    WHERE rn = 1

)

, cte_parsed AS (

    SELECT
        n.*
        , CASE WHEN tok1 LIKE '%.' AND rest IS NOT NULL THEN tok1 END AS prefix_val
        , CASE WHEN tok1 LIKE '%.' AND rest IS NOT NULL
               THEN SPLIT_PART(rest, ' ', 1)
               ELSE tok1 END AS first_val
        , CASE WHEN tok1 LIKE '%.' AND rest IS NOT NULL
               THEN NULLIF(TRIM(SUBSTR(rest, LENGTH(SPLIT_PART(rest, ' ', 1)) + 1)), '')
               ELSE rest END AS last_val
    FROM cte_names AS n

)

, cte_state AS (

    SELECT
        p.*
        , (
            SELECT MIN(m.state_name)
            FROM {{ ref('stg_map__states') }} AS m
            WHERE LOWER(m.state_abbreviation) = LOWER(p.state_raw)
               OR LOWER(m.state_name) = LOWER(p.state_raw)
        ) AS state_full
    FROM cte_parsed AS p

)

SELECT
    CAST(patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id
    , CAST(COALESCE(TRY_CAST(dob_raw AS DATE), TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(dob_raw AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE)) AS DATE) AS birth_date
    , CAST(COALESCE(TRY_CAST(dod_raw AS DATE), TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(dod_raw AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE)) AS DATE) AS death_date
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS ssn
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS drivers_license_number
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS passport_number
    , CAST(prefix_val AS VARCHAR) AS patient_prefix
    , CAST(first_val AS VARCHAR) AS patient_first_name
    , CAST(last_val AS VARCHAR) AS patient_last_name
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS patient_suffix
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS maiden_name
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS marital_status
    , CAST(LOWER(race_raw) AS VARCHAR) AS race
    , CAST(LOWER(REPLACE(ethnicity_raw, ' ', '')) AS VARCHAR) AS ethnicity
    , CAST(
        CASE UPPER(LEFT(COALESCE(gender_raw, birth_sex_raw), 1))
            WHEN 'F' THEN 'F'
            WHEN 'M' THEN 'M'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS VARCHAR) AS patient_gender
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS birthplace
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS patient_address
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS patient_city
    , CAST(COALESCE(state_full, state_raw) AS VARCHAR) AS patient_state
    , CAST(county AS VARCHAR) AS patient_county
    , CAST(zip AS VARCHAR) AS patient_zip
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS patient_latitude
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS patient_longitude
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS healthcare_expenses
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS healthcare_coverage
FROM cte_state
```

```sql
WITH cte_obs AS (

    SELECT
        id
        , resource
        , UNNEST(
            CASE
                WHEN json_array_length(json_extract(resource, '$.component')) > 0
                    THEN CAST(json_extract(resource, '$.component') AS JSON[])
                ELSE [resource]
            END
        ) AS part
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'observation') }}
    WHERE json_extract_string(resource, '$.resourceType') = 'Observation'

)

, cte_fields AS (

    SELECT
        CAST(
            CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.effectiveDateTime') AS TIMESTAMPTZ)
            AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP
        ) AS observation_datetime
        , regexp_replace(json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'), '^.*[:/]', '') AS patient_id
        , regexp_replace(json_extract_string(resource, '$.context.reference'), '^.*[:/]', '') AS encounter_id
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.category[0].coding[0].code') AS observation_category
        , json_extract_string(part, '$.code.coding[0].code') AS observation_code
        , COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(part, '$.code.coding[0].display')
            , json_extract_string(part, '$.code.text')
        ) AS observation_description
        , json_extract_string(part, '$.valueQuantity.value') AS quantity_value
        , COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(part, '$.valueCodeableConcept.coding[0].display')
            , json_extract_string(part, '$.valueCodeableConcept.text')
            , json_extract_string(part, '$.valueString')
        ) AS text_value
        , json_extract_string(part, '$.valueQuantity.unit') AS observation_units
    FROM cte_obs

)

SELECT
    observation_datetime
    , CAST(observation_datetime AS DATE) AS observation_date
    , CAST(patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id
    , CAST(encounter_id AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id
    , CAST(observation_category AS VARCHAR) AS observation_category
    , CAST(observation_code AS VARCHAR) AS observation_code
    , CAST(observation_description AS VARCHAR) AS observation_description
    , CAST(COALESCE(quantity_value, text_value) AS VARCHAR) AS observation_value
    , CAST(observation_units AS VARCHAR) AS observation_units
    , CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN quantity_value IS NOT NULL THEN 'numeric'
            ELSE 'text'
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS observation_value_type
FROM cte_fields
```

```sql
WITH src AS (

    SELECT
        try_strptime(nullif(trim(start_date), '') || ' ' || nullif(trim(start_time), ''), '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S') AS start_ts
        , try_strptime(nullif(trim(stop_date), '') || ' ' || nullif(trim(stop_time), ''), '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S') AS stop_ts
        , nullif(lower(trim(patient)), '') AS patient_id
        , nullif(lower(trim(payer)), '') AS payer_id
        , nullif(lower(trim(encounter)), '') AS encounter_id
        , nullif(trim(code_display), '') AS code_display
        , base_cost
        , payer_coverage
        , dispenses
        , totalcost
        , nullif(trim(reason), '') AS reason
    FROM {{ source('raw_d2', 'medications') }}

)

SELECT
    CAST(start_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS medication_start_datetime
    , CAST(start_ts AS DATE) AS medication_start_date
    , CAST(stop_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS medication_stop_datetime
    , CAST(stop_ts AS DATE) AS medication_stop_date
    , CAST(patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id
    , CAST(payer_id AS VARCHAR) AS payer_id
    , CAST(encounter_id AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id
    , CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN strpos(code_display, ' | ') > 0
                THEN nullif(trim(substr(code_display, 1, strpos(code_display, ' | ') - 1)), '')
            ELSE code_display
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS medication_code
    , CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN strpos(code_display, ' | ') > 0
                THEN nullif(trim(substr(code_display, strpos(code_display, ' | ') + 3)), '')
            ELSE NULL
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS medication_description
    , CAST(base_cost AS FLOAT) AS medication_base_cost
    , CAST(payer_coverage AS FLOAT) AS medication_payer_coverage
    , CAST(dispenses AS FLOAT) AS dispenses
    , CAST(totalcost AS FLOAT) AS medication_total_cost
    , CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN strpos(reason, ' | ') > 0
                THEN nullif(trim(substr(reason, 1, strpos(reason, ' | ') - 1)), '')
            ELSE reason
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS medication_reason_code
    , CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN strpos(reason, ' | ') > 0
                THEN nullif(trim(substr(reason, strpos(reason, ' | ') + 3)), '')
            ELSE NULL
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS medication_reason_description
```

```sql
WITH cte_claim_lines AS (

    SELECT
        NULLIF(TRIM("Procedure date"), '') AS procedure_date_raw
        , NULLIF(TRIM("Patient account number"), '') AS patient_id
        , NULLIF(TRIM("Procedure code"), '') AS procedure_code
        , NULLIF(TRIM("Procedure description"), '') AS procedure_description
    FROM {{ source('raw_claims', 'claims') }}
    WHERE NULLIF(TRIM("Procedure code"), '') IS NOT NULL

)

SELECT
    CAST(CAST(procedure_date_raw AS DATE) AS TIMESTAMP) AS procedure_start_datetime
    , CAST(procedure_date_raw AS DATE) AS procedure_start_date

    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS procedure_base_cost
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_reason_code
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_reason_description
FROM cte_claim_lines
```

## Mapping hints
- Timestamps are split into <column>_date (MM/DD/YYYY) and <column>_time (HH:MM:SS), both in UTC.
- Date columns are text written DD-Mon-YYYY (03-Sep-1942).
- code_display is the code, ' | ', then the description: split at the first ' | '.
- reason is the reason code, ' | ', then the reason description (NULL when there is no reason).
- All other columns keep the acquirer's source column names in lower case.
text:
```sql
WITH src AS (

    SELECT
        nullif(trim(start_date), '') AS start_date
        , nullif(trim(start_time), '') AS start_time
        , nullif(trim(stop_date), '') AS stop_date
        , nullif(trim(stop_time), '') AS stop_time
        , nullif(lower(trim(patient)), '') AS patient
        , nullif(lower(trim(payer)), '') AS payer
        , nullif(lower(trim(encounter)), '') AS encounter
        , code_display
        , base_cost
        , payer_coverage
        , dispenses
        , totalcost
        , nullif(trim(reason), '') AS reason
    FROM {{ source('raw_d2', 'medications') }}

)

, parsed AS (

    SELECT
        CAST(strptime(start_date || ' ' || start_time, '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S') AS TIMESTAMP) AS medication_start_datetime
        , CAST(strptime(stop_date || ' ' || stop_time, '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S') AS TIMESTAMP) AS medication_stop_datetime
        , patient AS patient_id
        , payer AS payer_id
        , encounter AS encounter_id
        , CASE WHEN strpos(code_display, ' | ') > 0
               THEN trim(substr(code_display, 1, strpos(code_display, ' | ') - 1))
               ELSE trim(code_display) END AS medication_code
        , CASE WHEN strpos(code_display, ' | ') > 0
               THEN substr(code_display, strpos(code_display, ' | ') + 3)
               ELSE NULL END AS medication_description
        , CAST(base_cost AS FLOAT) AS medication_base_cost
        , CAST(payer_coverage AS FLOAT) AS medication_payer_coverage
        , CAST(dispenses AS FLOAT) AS dispenses
        , CAST(totalcost AS FLOAT) AS medication_total_cost
        , CASE WHEN reason IS NULL THEN NULL
               WHEN strpos(reason, ' | ') > 0
               THEN trim(substr(reason, 1, strpos(reason, ' | ') - 1))
               ELSE trim(reason) END AS medication_reason_code
        , CASE WHEN reason IS NOT NULL AND strpos(reason, ' | ') > 0
               THEN substr(reason, strpos(reason, ' | ') + 3)
               ELSE NULL END AS medication_reason_description
    FROM src

)

SELECT
    medication_start_datetime
    , CAST(medication_start_datetime AS DATE) AS medication_start_date
    , medication_stop_datetime
    , CAST(medication_stop_datetime AS DATE) AS medication_stop_date
    , CAST(patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id
    , CAST(payer_id AS VARCHAR) AS payer_id
    , CAST(encounter_id AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id
    , CAST(medication_code AS VARCHAR) AS medication_code
    , CAST(medication_description AS VARCHAR) AS medication_description
    , medication_base_cost
    , medication_payer_coverage
    , dispenses
    , medication_total_cost
    , CAST(medication_reason_code AS VARCHAR) AS medication_reason_code
    , CAST(medication_reason_description AS VARCHAR) AS medication_reason_description
FROM parsed
```

## Mapping hints
- start date is the first 10 characters of recordedDate (R4) or assertedDate (STU3); there is no stop date.
- patient is patient.reference without the urn:uuid: prefix. The resource has no encounter reference: use the patient's Encounter whose period.start equals that timestamp.
- code and description are code.coding[0]; system is SNOMED-CT or RxNorm according to the coding system URL; type is type; category is category[0].
- reaction 1 and 2 are reaction[0] and reaction[1]: manifestation[0].coding[0].code and .display, severity in upper case. Commas in text become spaces.
text:
```sql
WITH allergies AS (

    SELECT
        a.id AS resource_id
        , a.resource AS r
        , replace(json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.patient.reference'), 'urn:uuid:', '') AS patient_id
        , CAST(json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.recordedDate') AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AS recorded_ts
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'allergyintolerance') }} AS a
    WHERE json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.resourceType') = 'AllergyIntolerance'

)

, encounters AS (

    SELECT
        replace(json_extract_string(e.resource, '$.subject.reference'), 'urn:uuid:', '') AS patient_id
        , CAST(json_extract_string(e.resource, '$.period.start') AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AS start_ts
        , MIN(e.id) AS encounter_id
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'encounter') }} AS e
    WHERE json_extract_string(e.resource, '$.resourceType') = 'Encounter'
    GROUP BY 1, 2

)

SELECT
    CAST(timezone('UTC', a.recorded_ts) AS DATE) AS allergy_start_date
    , CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS allergy_stop_date
    , CAST(a.patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id
    , CAST(e.encounter_id AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id
    , CAST(json_extract_string(a.r, '$.code.coding[0].code') AS VARCHAR) AS allergy_code
    , CAST(CASE json_extract_string(a.r, '$.code.coding[0].system')
        WHEN 'http://snomed.info/sct' THEN 'SNOMED-CT'
        WHEN 'http://www.nlm.nih.gov/research/umls/rxnorm' THEN 'RxNorm'
      END AS VARCHAR) AS allergy_code_system
    , CAST(replace(json_extract_string(a.r, '$.code.coding[0].display'), ',', ' ') AS VARCHAR) AS allergy_description
    , CAST(json_extract_string(a.r, '$.type') AS VARCHAR) AS allergy_type
    , CAST(json_extract_string(a.r, '$.category[0]') AS VARCHAR) AS allergy_category
    , CAST(json_extract_string(a.r, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].code') AS VARCHAR) AS reaction_1_code
    , CAST(replace(json_extract_string(a.r, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].display'), ',', ' ') AS VARCHAR) AS reaction_1_description
    , CAST(upper(json_extract_string(a.r, '$.reaction[0].severity')) AS VARCHAR) AS reaction_1_severity
    , CAST(json_extract_string(a.r, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].coding[0].code') AS VARCHAR) AS reaction_2_code
    , CAST(replace(json_extract_string(a.r, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].coding[0].display'), ',', ' ') AS VARCHAR) AS reaction_2_description
    , CAST(upper(json_extract_string(a.r, '$.reaction[1].severity')) AS VARCHAR) AS reaction_2_severity
FROM allergies AS a
LEFT JOIN encounters AS e
    ON e.patient_id = a.patient_id
    AND e.start_ts = a.recorded_ts
```

## Mapping hints
- start date is the first 10 characters of recordedDate (R4) or assertedDate (STU3); there is no stop date.
- patient is patient.reference without the urn:uuid: prefix. The resource has no encounter reference: use the patient's Encounter whose period.start equals that timestamp.
- code and description are code.coding[0]; system is SNOMED-CT or RxNorm according to the coding system URL; type is type; category is category[0].
- reaction 1 and 2 are reaction[0] and reaction[1]: manifestation[0].coding[0].code and .display, severity in upper case. Commas in text become spaces.
text:
```sql
WITH allergies AS (

    SELECT
        id AS resource_id
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.assertedDate') AS asserted_date
        , replace(json_extract_string(resource, '$.patient.reference'), 'urn:uuid:', '') AS patient_id
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') AS allergy_code
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].system') AS system_url
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display') AS allergy_description
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.type') AS allergy_type
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.category[0]') AS allergy_category
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].code') AS reaction_1_code
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].display') AS reaction_1_description
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[0].severity') AS reaction_1_severity
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].coding[0].code') AS reaction_2_code
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].coding[0].display') AS reaction_2_description
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[1].severity') AS reaction_2_severity
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'allergyintolerance') }}

)

, encounters AS (

    SELECT
        replace(json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'), 'urn:uuid:', '') AS patient_id
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start') AS period_start
        , min(coalesce(json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'), id)) AS encounter_id
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'encounter') }}
    GROUP BY 1, 2

)

SELECT
    CAST(substr(a.asserted_date, 1, 10) AS DATE) AS allergy_start_date
    , CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS allergy_stop_date
    , CAST(a.patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id
    , CAST(e.encounter_id AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id
    , CAST(a.allergy_code AS VARCHAR) AS allergy_code
    , CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN lower(a.system_url) LIKE '%snomed%' THEN 'SNOMED-CT'
            WHEN lower(a.system_url) LIKE '%rxnorm%' THEN 'RxNorm'
            ELSE a.system_url
        END AS VARCHAR) AS allergy_code_system
    , CAST(replace(a.allergy_description, ',', ' ') AS VARCHAR) AS allergy_description
    , CAST(a.allergy_type AS VARCHAR) AS allergy_type
    , CAST(a.allergy_category AS VARCHAR) AS allergy_category
    , CAST(a.reaction_1_code AS VARCHAR) AS reaction_1_code
    , CAST(replace(a.reaction_1_description, ',', ' ') AS VARCHAR) AS reaction_1_description
    , CAST(upper(a.reaction_1_severity) AS VARCHAR) AS reaction_1_severity
    , CAST(a.reaction_2_code AS VARCHAR) AS reaction_2_code
    , CAST(replace(a.reaction_2_description, ',', ' ') AS VARCHAR) AS reaction_2_description
    , CAST(upper(a.reaction_2_severity) AS VARCHAR) AS reaction_2_severity
FROM allergies AS a
LEFT JOIN encounters AS e
    ON a.patient_id = e.patient_id
    AND a.asserted_date = e.period_start
```

```sql
WITH src AS (

    SELECT
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'),
            id
        ) AS resource_id
        , from_json(
            resource
            , '{
                "gender": "VARCHAR",
                "birthDate": "VARCHAR",
                "deceasedDateTime": "VARCHAR",
                "identifier": [{"type": {"coding": [{"code": "VARCHAR"}]}, "value": "VARCHAR"}],
                "name": [{"use": "VARCHAR", "family": "VARCHAR", "given": ["VARCHAR"], "prefix": ["VARCHAR"], "suffix": ["VARCHAR"]}],
                "address": [{
                    "line": ["VARCHAR"],
                    "city": "VARCHAR",
                    "state": "VARCHAR",
                    "postalCode": "VARCHAR",
                    "extension": [{"url": "VARCHAR", "extension": [{"url": "VARCHAR", "valueDecimal": "DOUBLE"}]}]
                }],
                "maritalStatus": {"coding": [{"code": "VARCHAR"}]},
                "extension": [{
                    "url": "VARCHAR",
                    "valueCode": "VARCHAR",
                    "valueAddress": {"city": "VARCHAR", "state": "VARCHAR", "country": "VARCHAR"},
                    "extension": [{"url": "VARCHAR", "valueCoding": {"code": "VARCHAR", "display": "VARCHAR"}, "valueString": "VARCHAR"}]
                }]
            }'
        ) AS p
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'patient') }}

)

, parts AS (

    SELECT
        resource_id
        , p
        , list_filter(p.identifier, i -> i['type']['coding'][1]['code'] = 'SS')[1].value AS ssn_raw
        , list_filter(p.identifier, i -> i['type']['coding'][1]['code'] = 'DL')[1].value AS dl_raw
        , list_filter(p.identifier, i -> i['type']['coding'][1]['code'] = 'PPN')[1].value AS ppn_raw
        , COALESCE(
            list_filter(p.name, n -> n.use = 'official')[1]
            , list_filter(p.name, n -> COALESCE(n.use, '') <> 'maiden')[1]
            , p.name[1]
        ) AS official_name
        , list_filter(p.name, n -> n.use = 'maiden')[1] AS maiden_nm
        , p.address[1] AS addr
        , list_filter(p.address[1].extension, e -> e.url LIKE '%geolocation')[1] AS geo
        , list_filter(p.extension, e -> e.url LIKE '%us-core-race')[1] AS race_ext
        , list_filter(p.extension, e -> e.url LIKE '%us-core-ethnicity')[1] AS eth_ext
        , list_filter(p.extension, e -> e.url LIKE '%patient-birthPlace')[1] AS bp_ext
        , list_filter(p.extension, e -> e.url LIKE '%us-core-birthsex')[1] AS sex_ext
    FROM src

)

, derived AS (

    SELECT
        resource_id
        , p
        , ssn_raw
        , dl_raw
        , ppn_raw
        , official_name
        , maiden_nm
        , addr
        , bp_ext.valueAddress AS bp
        , sex_ext.valueCode AS birthsex
        , list_filter(geo.extension, x -> x.url = 'latitude')[1].valueDecimal AS lat
        , list_filter(geo.extension, x -> x.url = 'longitude')[1].valueDecimal AS lon
        , list_filter(race_ext.extension, x -> x.url = 'ombCategory')[1].valueCoding AS race_coding
        , list_filter(race_ext.extension, x -> x.url = 'text')[1].valueString AS race_text
        , list_filter(eth_ext.extension, x -> x.url = 'ombCategory')[1].valueCoding AS eth_coding
        , list_filter(eth_ext.extension, x -> x.url = 'text')[1].valueString AS eth_text
    FROM parts

)

SELECT
    CAST(d.resource_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id
    , TRY_CAST(LEFT(TRIM(d.p.birthDate), 10) AS DATE) AS birth_date
    , CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN d.p.deceasedDateTime IS NULL OR TRIM(d.p.deceasedDateTime) = '' THEN NULL
            WHEN LENGTH(TRIM(d.p.deceasedDateTime)) = 10
                THEN TRY_CAST(TRIM(d.p.deceasedDateTime) AS DATE)
            WHEN regexp_matches(TRIM(d.p.deceasedDateTime), '(Z|z|[+-][0-9]{2}:?[0-9]{2})$')
                THEN CAST(TRY_CAST(TRIM(d.p.deceasedDateTime) AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS DATE)
            ELSE CAST(TRY_CAST(TRIM(d.p.deceasedDateTime) AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE)
        END AS DATE
    ) AS death_date
    , CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(d.ssn_raw), '') AS VARCHAR) AS ssn
    , CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(d.dl_raw), '') AS VARCHAR) AS drivers_license_number
    , CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(d.ppn_raw), '') AS VARCHAR) AS passport_number
    , CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(d.official_name.prefix[1]), '') AS VARCHAR) AS patient_prefix
    , CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(array_to_string(d.official_name.given, ' ')), '') AS VARCHAR) AS patient_first_name
    , CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(d.official_name.family), '') AS VARCHAR) AS patient_last_name
    , CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(d.official_name.suffix[1]), '') AS VARCHAR) AS patient_suffix
    , CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(d.maiden_nm.family), '') AS VARCHAR) AS maiden_name
    , CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(d.p.maritalStatus.coding[1].code), '') AS VARCHAR) AS marital_status
    , CAST(
        CASE d.race_coding.code
            WHEN '2106-3' THEN 'white'
            WHEN '2054-5' THEN 'black'
            WHEN '2028-9' THEN 'asian'
            WHEN '1002-5' THEN 'native'
            WHEN '2076-8' THEN 'hawaiian'
            WHEN '2131-1' THEN 'other'
            ELSE LOWER(NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(d.race_coding.display, d.race_text)), ''))
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS race
    , CAST(
        CASE d.eth_coding.code
            WHEN '2186-5' THEN 'nonhispanic'
            WHEN '2135-2' THEN 'hispanic'
            ELSE LOWER(REPLACE(NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(d.eth_coding.display, d.eth_text)), ''), ' ', ''))
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS ethnicity
    , CAST(
        CASE LOWER(COALESCE(d.p.gender, ''))
            WHEN 'male' THEN 'M'
            WHEN 'female' THEN 'F'
            ELSE NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(d.birthsex)), '')
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS patient_gender
    , CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN d.bp IS NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE d.bp.city || '  ' || d.bp.state || '  ' || d.bp.country
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS birthplace
    , CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(array_to_string(d.addr.line, ' ')), '') AS VARCHAR) AS patient_address
    , CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(d.addr.city), '') AS VARCHAR) AS patient_city
    , CAST(COALESCE(m.state_name, NULLIF(TRIM(d.addr.state), '')) AS VARCHAR) AS patient_state
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS patient_county
    , CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(d.addr.postalCode), '') AS VARCHAR) AS patient_zip
    , CAST(d.lat AS FLOAT) AS patient_latitude
    , CAST(d.lon AS FLOAT) AS patient_longitude
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS healthcare_expenses
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS healthcare_coverage
FROM derived AS d
LEFT JOIN {{ ref('stg_map__states') }} AS m
    ON UPPER(TRIM(d.addr.state)) = UPPER(m.state_abbreviation)
```

## Mapping hints
- patient_id is the resource id. birth_date is birthDate. death_date is the first 10 characters of deceasedDateTime (the local date).
- ssn, drivers licence and passport are identifier[] entries whose type.coding[0].code is SS, DL and PPN.
- Names come from the name[] entry with use = official (prefix[0], given[0], family, suffix[0]); the maiden name is the family of the entry with use = maiden.
- marital status is maritalStatus.coding[0].code. gender: male becomes M, female becomes F.
- race is the ombCategory display of the us-core-race extension, written as the acquirer writes it: White = white, Black or African American = black, Asian = asian, American Indian or Alaska Native = native, Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander = hawaiian, anything else = other. ethnicity: Hispanic or Latino = hispanic, otherwise nonhispanic.
- birthplace is city, state and country of the birthPlace extension joined by two spaces.
- address is address[0].line[0]; city and postalCode as given; the state is an abbreviation and the acquirer stores the full name (stg_map__states); latitude and longitude are in the geolocation extension of address[0].
- The county and the two healthcare amounts are not in the resource: return NULL.

```sql
with src as (

    select
        id as raw_id,
        resource as r
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'patient') }}

),

parsed as (

    select
        coalesce(json_extract_string(r, '$.id'), raw_id) as patient_id,
        json_extract_string(r, '$.birthDate') as birth_raw,
        json_extract_string(r, '$.deceasedDateTime') as death_raw,
        json_extract_string(r, '$.gender') as gender_raw,
        json_extract_string(r, '$.maritalStatus.coding[0].code') as marital_raw,
        json_extract(r, '$.address[0]') as addr,
        cast(json_extract(r, '$.identifier') as json[]) as idents,
        cast(json_extract(r, '$.name') as json[]) as names,
        cast(json_extract(r, '$.extension') as json[]) as exts
    from src

),

picked as (

    select
        patient_id,
        birth_raw,
        death_raw,
        gender_raw,
        marital_raw,
        addr,
        list_filter(idents, x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.type.coding[0].code') = 'SS')[1] as ssn_ident,
        list_filter(idents, x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.type.coding[0].code') = 'DL')[1] as dl_ident,
        list_filter(idents, x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.type.coding[0].code') = 'PPN')[1] as ppn_ident,
        list_filter(names, x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.use') = 'official')[1] as official_name,
        list_filter(names, x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.use') = 'maiden')[1] as maiden_entry,
        list_filter(exts, x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.url') like '%us-core-race')[1] as race_ext,
        list_filter(exts, x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.url') like '%us-core-ethnicity')[1] as eth_ext,
        list_filter(exts, x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.url') like '%patient-birthPlace')[1] as bp_ext,
        list_filter(
            cast(json_extract(addr, '$.extension') as json[]),
            x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.url') like '%geolocation'
        )[1] as geo_ext
    from parsed

),

detail as (

    select
        patient_id,
        birth_raw,
        death_raw,
        gender_raw,
        marital_raw,
        addr,
        ssn_ident,
        dl_ident,
        ppn_ident,
        official_name,
        maiden_entry,
        bp_ext,
        json_extract_string(
            list_filter(
                cast(json_extract(race_ext, '$.extension') as json[]),
                y -> json_extract_string(y, '$.url') = 'ombCategory'
            )[1],
            '$.valueCoding.display'
        ) as race_display,
        json_extract_string(
            list_filter(
                cast(json_extract(eth_ext, '$.extension') as json[]),
                y -> json_extract_string(y, '$.url') = 'ombCategory'
            )[1],
            '$.valueCoding.display'
        ) as eth_display,
        json_extract_string(
            list_filter(
                cast(json_extract(geo_ext, '$.extension') as json[]),
                y -> json_extract_string(y, '$.url') = 'latitude'
            )[1],
            '$.valueDecimal'
        ) as lat_raw,
        json_extract_string(
            list_filter(
                cast(json_extract(geo_ext, '$.extension') as json[]),
                y -> json_extract_string(y, '$.url') = 'longitude'
            )[1],
            '$.valueDecimal'
        ) as lon_raw
    from picked

)

select
    d.patient_id::varchar as patient_id,
    cast(d.birth_raw as date) as birth_date,
    case
        when d.death_raw is null then null
        when regexp_matches(d.death_raw, '(Z|[+-][0-9]{2}:?[0-9]{2})$')
            then cast(cast(d.death_raw as timestamptz) at time zone 'UTC' as date)
        else cast(substr(d.death_raw, 1, 10) as date)
    end as death_date,
    cast(json_extract_string(d.ssn_ident, '$.value') as varchar) as ssn,
    cast(json_extract_string(d.dl_ident, '$.value') as varchar) as drivers_license_number,
    cast(json_extract_string(d.ppn_ident, '$.value') as varchar) as passport_number,
    cast(json_extract_string(d.official_name, '$.prefix[0]') as varchar) as patient_prefix,
    cast(json_extract_string(d.official_name, '$.given[0]') as varchar) as patient_first_name,
    cast(json_extract_string(d.official_name, '$.family') as varchar) as patient_last_name,
    cast(json_extract_string(d.official_name, '$.suffix[0]') as varchar) as patient_suffix,
    cast(json_extract_string(d.maiden_entry, '$.family') as varchar) as maiden_name,
    cast(d.marital_raw as varchar) as marital_status,
    cast(case
        when d.race_display is null then null
        when d.race_display = 'White' then 'white'
        when d.race_display = 'Black or African American' then 'black'
        when d.race_display = 'Asian' then 'asian'
        when d.race_display = 'American Indian or Alaska Native' then 'native'
        when d.race_display = 'Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander' then 'hawaiian'
        else 'other'
    end as varchar) as race,
    cast(case
        when d.eth_display = 'Hispanic or Latino' then 'hispanic'
        else 'nonhispanic'
    end as varchar) as ethnicity,
    cast(case lower(d.gender_raw)
        when 'male' then 'M'
        when 'female' then 'F'
        else null
    end as varchar) as patient_gender,
    cast(
        case
            when d.bp_ext is null then null
            else concat_ws(
                '  ',
                json_extract_string(d.bp_ext, '$.valueAddress.city'),
                json_extract_string(d.bp_ext, '$.valueAddress.state'),
                json_extract_string(d.bp_ext, '$.valueAddress.country')
            )
        end as varchar
    ) as birthplace,
    cast(json_extract_string(d.addr, '$.line[0]') as varchar) as patient_address,
    cast(json_extract_string(d.addr, '$.city') as varchar) as patient_city,
    cast(coalesce(s.state_name, json_extract_string(d.addr, '$.state')) as varchar) as patient_state,
    cast(null as varchar) as patient_county,
    cast(json_extract_string(d.addr, '$.postalCode') as varchar) as patient_zip,
    cast(cast(d.lat_raw as double) as float) as patient_latitude,
    cast(cast(d.lon_raw as double) as float) as patient_longitude,
    cast(null as float) as healthcare_expenses,
    cast(null as float) as healthcare_coverage
from detail d
left join {{ ref('stg_map__states') }} s
    on upper(trim(json_extract_string(d.addr, '$.state'))) = upper(s.state_abbreviation)
```

```sql
WITH src AS (
    SELECT
        resource,
        COALESCE(json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'), id) AS rid,
        from_json(json_extract(resource, '$.name'), '["JSON"]') AS names,
        from_json(json_extract(resource, '$.identifier'), '["JSON"]') AS idents,
        from_json(json_extract(resource, '$.extension'), '["JSON"]') AS exts
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'patient') }}
),

picked AS (
    SELECT
        resource,
        rid,
        COALESCE(
            list_filter(names, x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.use') = 'official')[1],
            names[1]
        ) AS official_name,
        list_filter(names, x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.use') = 'maiden')[1] AS maiden_name_obj,
        list_filter(idents, x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.type.coding[0].code') = 'SS')[1] AS ssn_obj,
        list_filter(idents, x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.type.coding[0].code') = 'DL')[1] AS dl_obj,
        list_filter(idents, x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.type.coding[0].code') = 'PPN')[1] AS ppn_obj,
        list_filter(exts, x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.url') LIKE '%us-core-race')[1] AS race_ext,
        list_filter(exts, x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.url') LIKE '%us-core-ethnicity')[1] AS eth_ext,
        list_filter(exts, x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.url') LIKE '%patient-birthPlace')[1] AS bp_ext
    FROM src
),

parsed AS (
    SELECT
        rid,
        resource,
        json_extract_string(official_name, '$.family') AS family,
        json_extract_string(official_name, '$.given[0]') AS given,
        json_extract_string(official_name, '$.prefix[0]') AS prefix,
        json_extract_string(official_name, '$.suffix[0]') AS suffix,
        json_extract_string(maiden_name_obj, '$.family') AS maiden,
        json_extract_string(ssn_obj, '$.value') AS ssn,
        json_extract_string(dl_obj, '$.value') AS dl,
        json_extract_string(ppn_obj, '$.value') AS ppn,
        list_filter(
            from_json(json_extract(race_ext, '$.extension'), '["JSON"]'),
            x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.url') = 'ombCategory'
        )[1] AS race_omb,
        json_extract_string(
            list_filter(
                from_json(json_extract(race_ext, '$.extension'), '["JSON"]'),
                x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.url') = 'text'
            )[1], '$.valueString'
        ) AS race_text,
        list_filter(
            from_json(json_extract(eth_ext, '$.extension'), '["JSON"]'),
            x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.url') = 'ombCategory'
        )[1] AS eth_omb,
        json_extract_string(
            list_filter(
                from_json(json_extract(eth_ext, '$.extension'), '["JSON"]'),
                x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.url') = 'text'
            )[1], '$.valueString'
        ) AS eth_text,
        json_extract_string(bp_ext, '$.valueAddress.city') AS bp_city,
        json_extract_string(bp_ext, '$.valueAddress.state') AS bp_state,
        json_extract_string(bp_ext, '$.valueAddress.country') AS bp_country,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.birthDate') AS birth_raw,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.deceasedDateTime') AS death_raw,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.gender') AS gender_raw,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.maritalStatus.coding[0].code') AS marital_raw,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].line[0]') AS addr_line,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].city') AS addr_city,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].state') AS addr_state,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].postalCode') AS addr_zip,
        list_filter(
            from_json(json_extract(resource, '$.address[0].extension'), '["JSON"]'),
            x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.url') LIKE '%geolocation'
        )[1] AS geo
    FROM picked
),

geo AS (
    SELECT
        p.*,
        list_filter(
            from_json(json_extract(geo, '$.extension'), '["JSON"]'),
            x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.url') = 'latitude'
        )[1] AS lat_obj,
        list_filter(
            from_json(json_extract(geo, '$.extension'), '["JSON"]'),
            x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.url') = 'longitude'
        )[1] AS lon_obj
    FROM parsed AS p
)

SELECT
    CAST(g.rid AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id,
    CAST(TRY_CAST(substr(g.birth_raw, 1, 10) AS DATE) AS DATE) AS birth_date,
    CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN g.death_raw IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN length(g.death_raw) <= 10 THEN TRY_CAST(g.death_raw AS DATE)
            ELSE CAST(TRY_CAST(g.death_raw AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS DATE)
        END AS DATE
    ) AS death_date,
    CAST(g.ssn AS VARCHAR) AS ssn,
    CAST(g.dl AS VARCHAR) AS drivers_license_number,
    CAST(g.ppn AS VARCHAR) AS passport_number,
    CAST(g.prefix AS VARCHAR) AS patient_prefix,
    CAST(g.given AS VARCHAR) AS patient_first_name,
    CAST(g.family AS VARCHAR) AS patient_last_name,
    CAST(g.suffix AS VARCHAR) AS patient_suffix,
    CAST(g.maiden AS VARCHAR) AS maiden_name,
    CAST(NULLIF(trim(g.marital_raw), '') AS VARCHAR) AS marital_status,
    CAST(
        CASE json_extract_string(g.race_omb, '$.valueCoding.code')
            WHEN '2106-3' THEN 'white'
            WHEN '2054-5' THEN 'black'
            WHEN '2028-9' THEN 'asian'
            WHEN '1002-5' THEN 'native'
            WHEN '2076-8' THEN 'hawaiian'
            WHEN '2131-1' THEN 'other'
            ELSE CASE lower(COALESCE(g.race_text, json_extract_string(g.race_omb, '$.valueCoding.display')))
                WHEN 'white' THEN 'white'
                WHEN 'black or african american' THEN 'black'
                WHEN 'asian' THEN 'asian'
                WHEN 'american indian or alaska native' THEN 'native'
                WHEN 'native hawaiian or other pacific islander' THEN 'hawaiian'
                WHEN 'other' THEN 'other'
                ELSE lower(COALESCE(g.race_text, json_extract_string(g.race_omb, '$.valueCoding.display')))
            END
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS race,
    CAST(
        CASE json_extract_string(g.eth_omb, '$.valueCoding.code')
            WHEN '2135-2' THEN 'hispanic'
            WHEN '2186-5' THEN 'nonhispanic'
            ELSE CASE lower(COALESCE(g.eth_text, json_extract_string(g.eth_omb, '$.valueCoding.display')))
                WHEN 'hispanic or latino' THEN 'hispanic'
                WHEN 'not hispanic or latino' THEN 'nonhispanic'
                ELSE NULL
            END
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS ethnicity,
    CAST(
        CASE lower(g.gender_raw)
            WHEN 'male' THEN 'M'
            WHEN 'female' THEN 'F'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS patient_gender,
    CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN g.bp_city IS NULL AND g.bp_state IS NULL AND g.bp_country IS NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE concat_ws('  ', g.bp_city, g.bp_state, g.bp_country)
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS birthplace,
    CAST(g.addr_line AS VARCHAR) AS patient_address,
    CAST(g.addr_city AS VARCHAR) AS patient_city,
    CAST(COALESCE(s.state_name, g.addr_state) AS VARCHAR) AS patient_state,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS patient_county,
    CAST(g.addr_zip AS VARCHAR) AS patient_zip,
    CAST(json_extract_string(g.lat_obj, '$.valueDecimal') AS FLOAT) AS patient_latitude,
    CAST(json_extract_string(g.lon_obj, '$.valueDecimal') AS FLOAT) AS patient_longitude,
    CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS healthcare_expenses,
    CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS healthcare_coverage
FROM geo AS g
LEFT JOIN {{ ref('stg_map__states') }} AS s
    ON upper(g.addr_state) = upper(s.state_abbreviation)
```

```sql
WITH src AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'), id) AS patient_id
        , resource
        , CAST(json_extract(resource, '$.extension') AS JSON[]) AS exts
        , CAST(json_extract(resource, '$.identifier') AS JSON[]) AS idents
        , CAST(json_extract(resource, '$.name') AS JSON[]) AS names
        , json_extract(resource, '$.address[0]') AS addr
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'patient') }}
)

, parts AS (
    SELECT
        patient_id
        , resource
        , addr
        , list_filter(exts, x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.url') = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-race')[1] AS race_ext
        , list_filter(exts, x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.url') = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-ethnicity')[1] AS eth_ext
        , list_filter(exts, x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.url') = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/patient-birthPlace')[1] AS bp_ext
        , list_filter(idents, x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.type.coding[0].code') = 'SS')[1] AS ssn_id
        , list_filter(idents, x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.type.coding[0].code') = 'DL')[1] AS dl_id
        , list_filter(idents, x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.type.coding[0].code') = 'PPN')[1] AS ppn_id
        , COALESCE(
            list_filter(names, x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.use') = 'official')[1]
            , names[1]
          ) AS official_name
        , list_filter(names, x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.use') = 'maiden')[1] AS maiden_name_obj
        , list_filter(
            CAST(json_extract(addr, '$.extension') AS JSON[])
            , x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.url') = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/geolocation'
          )[1] AS geo_ext
    FROM src
)

, parts2 AS (
    SELECT
        *
        , list_filter(CAST(json_extract(race_ext, '$.extension') AS JSON[]), x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.url') = 'ombCategory')[1] AS race_omb
        , list_filter(CAST(json_extract(eth_ext, '$.extension') AS JSON[]), x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.url') = 'ombCategory')[1] AS eth_omb
        , list_filter(CAST(json_extract(geo_ext, '$.extension') AS JSON[]), x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.url') = 'latitude')[1] AS lat_obj
        , list_filter(CAST(json_extract(geo_ext, '$.extension') AS JSON[]), x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.url') = 'longitude')[1] AS lon_obj
    FROM parts
)

, flat AS (
    SELECT
        patient_id
        , CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.birthDate') AS DATE) AS birth_date
        , CASE
            WHEN json_extract_string(resource, '$.deceasedDateTime') IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN length(json_extract_string(resource, '$.deceasedDateTime')) = 10
                THEN CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.deceasedDateTime') AS DATE)
            ELSE CAST(
                (CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.deceasedDateTime') AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')
                AS DATE)
          END AS death_date
        , json_extract_string(ssn_id, '$.value') AS ssn
        , json_extract_string(dl_id, '$.value') AS drivers_license_number
        , json_extract_string(ppn_id, '$.value') AS passport_number
        , json_extract_string(official_name, '$.prefix[0]') AS patient_prefix
        , json_extract_string(official_name, '$.given[0]') AS patient_first_name
        , json_extract_string(official_name, '$.family') AS patient_last_name
        , json_extract_string(official_name, '$.suffix[0]') AS patient_suffix
        , json_extract_string(maiden_name_obj, '$.family') AS maiden_name
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.maritalStatus.coding[0].code') AS marital_status
        , CASE json_extract_string(race_omb, '$.valueCoding.code')
            WHEN '2106-3' THEN 'white'
            WHEN '2054-5' THEN 'black'
            WHEN '2028-9' THEN 'asian'
            WHEN '1002-5' THEN 'native'
            WHEN '2076-8' THEN 'hawaiian'
            WHEN '2131-1' THEN 'other'
            ELSE NULL
          END AS race
        , CASE json_extract_string(eth_omb, '$.valueCoding.code')
            WHEN '2135-2' THEN 'hispanic'
            WHEN '2186-5' THEN 'nonhispanic'
            ELSE NULL
          END AS ethnicity
        , CASE lower(json_extract_string(resource, '$.gender'))
            WHEN 'male' THEN 'M'
            WHEN 'female' THEN 'F'
            ELSE NULL
          END AS patient_gender
        , CASE
            WHEN bp_ext IS NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE concat_ws('  '
                , json_extract_string(bp_ext, '$.valueAddress.city')
                , json_extract_string(bp_ext, '$.valueAddress.state')
                , json_extract_string(bp_ext, '$.valueAddress.country'))
          END AS birthplace
        , json_extract_string(addr, '$.line[0]') AS patient_address
        , json_extract_string(addr, '$.city') AS patient_city
        , json_extract_string(addr, '$.state') AS raw_state
        , trim(json_extract_string(addr, '$.postalCode')) AS patient_zip
        , CAST(json_extract_string(lat_obj, '$.valueDecimal') AS FLOAT) AS patient_latitude
        , CAST(json_extract_string(lon_obj, '$.valueDecimal') AS FLOAT) AS patient_longitude
    FROM parts2
)

SELECT
    f.patient_id AS patient_id
    , f.birth_date AS birth_date
    , f.death_date AS death_date
    , f.ssn AS ssn
    , f.drivers_license_number AS drivers_license_number
    , f.passport_number AS passport_number
    , f.patient_prefix AS patient_prefix
    , f.patient_first_name AS patient_first_name
    , f.patient_last_name AS patient_last_name
    , f.patient_suffix AS patient_suffix
    , f.maiden_name AS maiden_name
    , f.marital_status AS marital_status
    , f.race AS race
    , f.ethnicity AS ethnicity
    , f.patient_gender AS patient_gender
    , f.birthplace AS birthplace
    , f.patient_address AS patient_address
    , f.patient_city AS patient_city
    , COALESCE(s.state_name, f.raw_state) AS patient_state
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS patient_county
    , f.patient_zip AS patient_zip
    , f.patient_latitude AS patient_latitude
    , f.patient_longitude AS patient_longitude
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS healthcare_expenses
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS healthcare_coverage
FROM flat AS f
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        upper(state_abbreviation) AS state_abbreviation
        , min(state_name) AS state_name
    FROM {{ ref('stg_map__states') }}
    GROUP BY upper(state_abbreviation)
) AS s
    ON upper(f.raw_state) = s.state_abbreviation
```
