```sql
WITH src AS (

    SELECT
        id AS source_id
        , resource
        , from_json(resource -> '$.extension', '["JSON"]') AS ext
        , from_json(resource -> '$.identifier', '["JSON"]') AS idn
        , from_json(resource -> '$.name', '["JSON"]') AS nm
        , from_json(resource -> '$.address', '["JSON"]') AS addr
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'patient') }}
    WHERE coalesce(json_extract_string(resource, '$.resourceType'), 'Patient') = 'Patient'

)

, parts AS (

    SELECT
        source_id
        , resource
        , list_filter(idn, x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.type.coding[0].code') = 'SS')[1] AS ssn_id
        , list_filter(idn, x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.type.coding[0].code') = 'DL')[1] AS dl_id
        , list_filter(idn, x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.type.coding[0].code') = 'PPN')[1] AS ppn_id
        , coalesce(
            list_filter(nm, x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.use') = 'official')[1]
            , nm[1]
        ) AS official_name
        , list_filter(nm, x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.use') = 'maiden')[1] AS maiden_nm
        , addr[1] AS a1
        , list_filter(ext, x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.url') LIKE '%us-core-race')[1] AS race_ext
        , list_filter(ext, x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.url') LIKE '%us-core-ethnicity')[1] AS eth_ext
        , list_filter(ext, x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.url') LIKE '%us-core-birthsex')[1] AS sex_ext
        , list_filter(ext, x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.url') LIKE '%patient-birthPlace')[1] AS bp_ext
    FROM src

)

, parts2 AS (

    SELECT
        p.*
        , list_filter(
            from_json(race_ext -> '$.extension', '["JSON"]')
            , y -> json_extract_string(y, '$.url') = 'ombCategory'
        )[1] AS race_omb
        , list_filter(
            from_json(eth_ext -> '$.extension', '["JSON"]')
            , y -> json_extract_string(y, '$.url') = 'ombCategory'
        )[1] AS eth_omb
        , list_filter(
            from_json(a1 -> '$.extension', '["JSON"]')
            , y -> json_extract_string(y, '$.url') LIKE '%geolocation'
        )[1] AS geo
    FROM parts AS p

)

, parts3 AS (

    SELECT
        p.*
        , json_extract_string(race_omb, '$.valueCoding.code') AS race_code
        , lower(coalesce(
            json_extract_string(race_omb, '$.valueCoding.display')
            , json_extract_string(
                list_filter(
                    from_json(race_ext -> '$.extension', '["JSON"]')
                    , y -> json_extract_string(y, '$.url') = 'text'
                )[1]
                , '$.valueString'
            )
        )) AS race_text
        , json_extract_string(eth_omb, '$.valueCoding.code') AS eth_code
        , lower(coalesce(
            json_extract_string(eth_omb, '$.valueCoding.display')
            , json_extract_string(
                list_filter(
                    from_json(eth_ext -> '$.extension', '["JSON"]')
                    , y -> json_extract_string(y, '$.url') = 'text'
                )[1]
                , '$.valueString'
            )
        )) AS eth_text
        , list_filter(
            from_json(geo -> '$.extension', '["JSON"]')
            , y -> json_extract_string(y, '$.url') = 'latitude'
        )[1] AS lat_obj
        , list_filter(
            from_json(geo -> '$.extension', '["JSON"]')
            , y -> json_extract_string(y, '$.url') = 'longitude'
        )[1] AS lon_obj
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.deceasedDateTime') AS deceased_raw
    FROM parts2 AS p

)

, shaped AS (

    SELECT
        lower(trim(regexp_replace(
            coalesce(json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'), source_id)
            , '^(urn:uuid:|Patient/)', ''
        ))) AS patient_id
        , try_cast(json_extract_string(resource, '$.birthDate') AS DATE) AS birth_date
        , CASE
            WHEN deceased_raw IS NULL OR trim(deceased_raw) = '' THEN NULL
            WHEN length(trim(deceased_raw)) = 10 THEN try_cast(trim(deceased_raw) AS DATE)
            ELSE CAST(timezone('UTC', try_cast(trim(deceased_raw) AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) AS DATE)
        END AS death_date
        , nullif(trim(json_extract_string(ssn_id, '$.value')), '') AS ssn
        , nullif(trim(json_extract_string(dl_id, '$.value')), '') AS drivers_license_number
        , nullif(trim(json_extract_string(ppn_id, '$.value')), '') AS passport_number
        , nullif(trim(json_extract_string(official_name, '$.prefix[0]')), '') AS patient_prefix
        , nullif(trim(json_extract_string(official_name, '$.given[0]')), '') AS patient_first_name
        , nullif(trim(json_extract_string(official_name, '$.family')), '') AS patient_last_name
        , nullif(trim(json_extract_string(official_name, '$.suffix[0]')), '') AS patient_suffix
        , nullif(trim(json_extract_string(maiden_nm, '$.family')), '') AS maiden_name
        , nullif(trim(coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.maritalStatus.coding[0].code')
            , json_extract_string(resource, '$.maritalStatus.text')
        )), '') AS marital_status
        , CASE
            WHEN race_code = '2106-3' THEN 'white'
            WHEN race_code = '2054-5' THEN 'black'
            WHEN race_code = '2028-9' THEN 'asian'
            WHEN race_code = '1002-5' THEN 'native'
            WHEN race_code = '2076-8' THEN 'hawaiian'
            WHEN race_code IS NOT NULL THEN 'other'
            WHEN race_text = 'white' THEN 'white'
            WHEN race_text LIKE 'black%' THEN 'black'
            WHEN race_text = 'asian' THEN 'asian'
            WHEN race_text LIKE 'american indian%' THEN 'native'
            WHEN race_text LIKE 'native hawaiian%' THEN 'hawaiian'
            WHEN race_text IS NOT NULL THEN 'other'
        END AS race
        , CASE
            WHEN eth_code = '2135-2' THEN 'hispanic'
            WHEN eth_code = '2186-5' THEN 'nonhispanic'
            WHEN eth_text LIKE 'not hispanic%' THEN 'nonhispanic'
            WHEN eth_text LIKE 'hispanic%' THEN 'hispanic'
        END AS ethnicity
        , CASE
            WHEN lower(json_extract_string(resource, '$.gender')) = 'male' THEN 'M'
            WHEN lower(json_extract_string(resource, '$.gender')) = 'female' THEN 'F'
            WHEN upper(json_extract_string(sex_ext, '$.valueCode')) IN ('M', 'F')
                THEN upper(json_extract_string(sex_ext, '$.valueCode'))
        END AS patient_gender
        , nullif(concat_ws(
            '  '
            , nullif(json_extract_string(bp_ext, '$.valueAddress.city'), '')
            , nullif(json_extract_string(bp_ext, '$.valueAddress.state'), '')
            , nullif(json_extract_string(bp_ext, '$.valueAddress.country'), '')
        ), '') AS birthplace
        , nullif(trim(json_extract_string(a1, '$.line[0]')), '') AS patient_address
        , nullif(trim(json_extract_string(a1, '$.city')), '') AS patient_city
        , nullif(trim(json_extract_string(a1, '$.state')), '') AS state_raw
        , nullif(trim(json_extract_string(a1, '$.postalCode')), '') AS patient_zip
        , CAST(json_extract_string(lat_obj, '$.valueDecimal') AS FLOAT) AS patient_latitude
        , CAST(json_extract_string(lon_obj, '$.valueDecimal') AS FLOAT) AS patient_longitude
    FROM parts3

)

SELECT
    s.patient_id::VARCHAR AS patient_id
    , s.birth_date::DATE AS birth_date
    , s.death_date::DATE AS death_date
    , s.ssn::VARCHAR AS ssn
    , s.drivers_license_number::VARCHAR AS drivers_license_number
    , s.passport_number::VARCHAR AS passport_number
    , s.patient_prefix::VARCHAR AS patient_prefix
    , s.patient_first_name::VARCHAR AS patient_first_name
    , s.patient_last_name::VARCHAR AS patient_last_name
    , s.patient_suffix::VARCHAR AS patient_suffix
    , s.maiden_name::VARCHAR AS maiden_name
    , s.marital_status::VARCHAR AS marital_status
    , s.race::VARCHAR AS race
    , s.ethnicity::VARCHAR AS ethnicity
    , s.patient_gender::VARCHAR AS patient_gender
    , s.birthplace::VARCHAR AS birthplace
    , s.patient_address::VARCHAR AS patient_address
    , s.patient_city::VARCHAR AS patient_city
    , coalesce(m.state_name, s.state_raw)::VARCHAR AS patient_state
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS patient_county
    , s.patient_zip::VARCHAR AS patient_zip
    , s.patient_latitude::FLOAT AS patient_latitude
    , s.patient_longitude::FLOAT AS patient_longitude
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS healthcare_expenses
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS healthcare_coverage
FROM shaped AS s
LEFT JOIN {{ ref('stg_map__states') }} AS m
    ON upper(trim(m.state_abbreviation)) = upper(s.state_raw)
```

## Mapping hints
- patient_id is the resource id. birth_date is birthDate. death_date is the first 10 characters of deceasedDateTime (the local date).
- ssn, drivers licence and passport are identifier[] entries whose type.coding[0].code is SS, DL and PPN.
- Names come from the name[] entry with use = official (prefix[0], given[0], family, suffix[0]); the maiden name is the family of the entry with use = maiden.
- marital status is maritalStatus.coding[0].code. gender: male becomes M, female becomes F.
- race is the ombCategory display of the us-core-race extension, written as the acquirer writes it: White = white, Black or African American = black, Asian = asian, American Indian or Alaska Native = native, Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander = hawaiian, anything else = other. ethnicity: Hispanic or Latino = hispanic, otherwise nonhispanic.
- birthplace is city, state and country of the birthPlace extension joined by two spaces.
- address is address[0].line[0]; city and postalCode as given; the state is an abbreviation and the acquirer stores the full name (stg_map__states); latitude and longitude are in the geolocation extension of address[0].
- The county and the two healthcare amounts are not in the resource: return NULL.

```sql
with src as (

    select
        id as raw_id,
        cast(resource as json) as r
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'patient') }}

),

parsed as (

    select
        raw_id,
        r,
        cast(json_extract(r, '$.extension') as json[]) as exts,
        cast(json_extract(r, '$.identifier') as json[]) as idents,
        cast(json_extract(r, '$.name') as json[]) as names,
        json_extract(r, '$.address[0]') as addr
    from src

),

picked as (

    select
        raw_id,
        r,
        addr,
        list_filter(exts, x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.url') = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-race')[1] as race_ext,
        list_filter(exts, x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.url') = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-ethnicity')[1] as eth_ext,
        list_filter(exts, x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.url') = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/patient-birthPlace')[1] as bp_ext,
        list_filter(idents, x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.type.coding[0].code') = 'SS')[1] as ssn_id,
        list_filter(idents, x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.type.coding[0].code') = 'DL')[1] as dl_id,
        list_filter(idents, x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.type.coding[0].code') = 'PPN')[1] as ppn_id,
        list_filter(names, x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.use') = 'official')[1] as official_name,
        list_filter(names, x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.use') = 'maiden')[1] as maiden_name_entry,
        list_filter(
            cast(json_extract(addr, '$.extension') as json[]),
            x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.url') = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/geolocation'
        )[1] as geo_ext
    from parsed

),

detail as (

    select
        raw_id,
        r,
        addr,
        ssn_id,
        dl_id,
        ppn_id,
        official_name,
        maiden_name_entry,
        bp_ext,
        json_extract_string(
            list_filter(cast(json_extract(race_ext, '$.extension') as json[]),
                        x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.url') = 'ombCategory')[1],
            '$.valueCoding.display') as race_display,
        json_extract_string(
            list_filter(cast(json_extract(eth_ext, '$.extension') as json[]),
                        x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.url') = 'ombCategory')[1],
            '$.valueCoding.display') as eth_display,
        json_extract_string(
            list_filter(cast(json_extract(geo_ext, '$.extension') as json[]),
                        x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.url') = 'latitude')[1],
            '$.valueDecimal') as lat_txt,
        json_extract_string(
            list_filter(cast(json_extract(geo_ext, '$.extension') as json[]),
                        x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.url') = 'longitude')[1],
            '$.valueDecimal') as lon_txt,
        json_extract_string(r, '$.deceasedDateTime') as deceased_txt
    from picked

)

select
    cast(coalesce(json_extract_string(d.r, '$.id'), d.raw_id) as varchar) as patient_id,
    cast(try_cast(json_extract_string(d.r, '$.birthDate') as date) as date) as birth_date,
    cast(
        case
            when d.deceased_txt is null then null
            when length(d.deceased_txt) <= 10 then try_cast(d.deceased_txt as date)
            else cast(try_cast(d.deceased_txt as timestamptz) at time zone 'UTC' as date)
        end
    as date) as death_date,
    cast(json_extract_string(d.ssn_id, '$.value') as varchar) as ssn,
    cast(json_extract_string(d.dl_id, '$.value') as varchar) as drivers_license_number,
    cast(json_extract_string(d.ppn_id, '$.value') as varchar) as passport_number,
    cast(json_extract_string(d.official_name, '$.prefix[0]') as varchar) as patient_prefix,
    cast(json_extract_string(d.official_name, '$.given[0]') as varchar) as patient_first_name,
    cast(json_extract_string(d.official_name, '$.family') as varchar) as patient_last_name,
    cast(json_extract_string(d.official_name, '$.suffix[0]') as varchar) as patient_suffix,
    cast(json_extract_string(d.maiden_name_entry, '$.family') as varchar) as maiden_name,
    cast(json_extract_string(d.r, '$.maritalStatus.coding[0].code') as varchar) as marital_status,
    cast(case d.race_display
        when 'White' then 'white'
        when 'Black or African American' then 'black'
        when 'Asian' then 'asian'
        when 'American Indian or Alaska Native' then 'native'
        when 'Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander' then 'hawaiian'
        else 'other'
    end as varchar) as race,
    cast(case when d.eth_display = 'Hispanic or Latino' then 'hispanic' else 'nonhispanic' end as varchar) as ethnicity,
    cast(case json_extract_string(d.r, '$.gender')
        when 'male' then 'M'
        when 'female' then 'F'
        else null
    end as varchar) as patient_gender,
    cast(concat_ws('  ',
        json_extract_string(d.bp_ext, '$.valueAddress.city'),
        json_extract_string(d.bp_ext, '$.valueAddress.state'),
        json_extract_string(d.bp_ext, '$.valueAddress.country')
    ) as varchar) as birthplace,
    cast(json_extract_string(d.addr, '$.line[0]') as varchar) as patient_address,
    cast(json_extract_string(d.addr, '$.city') as varchar) as patient_city,
    cast(coalesce(s.state_name, json_extract_string(d.addr, '$.state')) as varchar) as patient_state,
    cast(null as varchar) as patient_county,
    cast(json_extract_string(d.addr, '$.postalCode') as varchar) as patient_zip,
    cast(try_cast(d.lat_txt as double) as float) as patient_latitude,
    cast(try_cast(d.lon_txt as double) as float) as patient_longitude,
    cast(null as float) as healthcare_expenses,
    cast(null as float) as healthcare_coverage
from detail d
left join {{ ref('stg_map__states') }} s
    on upper(trim(s.state_abbreviation)) = upper(trim(json_extract_string(d.addr, '$.state')))
```

```sql
WITH src AS (

    SELECT
        id AS raw_id
        , CAST(resource AS JSON) AS r
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'encounter') }}

)

, providers AS (

    -- one provider id per (organization, name); ambiguous matches are left NULL
    SELECT
        lower(trim("ORGANIZATION")) AS organization_id
        , lower(trim("NAME")) AS provider_name
        , CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT lower(trim("Id"))) = 1 THEN min(lower(trim("Id"))) END AS provider_id
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'providers') }}
    GROUP BY 1, 2

)

, parsed AS (

    SELECT
        lower(trim(COALESCE(json_extract_string(r, '$.id'), raw_id))) AS encounter_id
        , COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(r, '$.period.start'),
            json_extract_string(r, '$.participant[0].period.start')
        ) AS start_raw
        , COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(r, '$.period.end'),
            json_extract_string(r, '$.participant[0].period.end')
        ) AS stop_raw
        , lower(trim(regexp_replace(json_extract_string(r, '$.subject.reference'), '^.*[:/|]', ''))) AS patient_id
        , lower(trim(regexp_replace(json_extract_string(r, '$.serviceProvider.reference'), '^.*[:/|]', ''))) AS organization_id
        , lower(trim(regexp_replace(
            json_extract_string(r, '$.participant[0].individual.display'),
            '^(Dr|Mr|Mrs|Ms|Miss|Prof)\.?\s+', ''
          ))) AS provider_name
        , upper(json_extract_string(r, '$.class.code')) AS class_code
        , json_extract_string(r, '$.type[0].coding[0].code') AS encounter_code
        , COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(r, '$.type[0].coding[0].display'),
            json_extract_string(r, '$.type[0].text')
          ) AS encounter_description
        , json_extract_string(r, '$.reasonCode[0].coding[0].code') AS encounter_reason_code
        , json_extract_string(r, '$.reasonCode[0].coding[0].display') AS encounter_reason_description
    FROM src

)

, typed AS (

    SELECT
        p.*
        , CAST(CAST(start_raw AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_ts
        , CAST(CAST(stop_raw AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP) AS stop_ts
    FROM parsed AS p

)

SELECT
    t.encounter_id AS encounter_id
    , t.start_ts AS encounter_start_datetime
    , CAST(t.start_ts AS DATE) AS encounter_start_date
    -- default to start when stop is missing
    , COALESCE(t.stop_ts, t.start_ts) AS encounter_stop_datetime
    -- same convention as the acquirer: stop date is taken from the start
    , COALESCE(CAST(t.start_ts AS DATE), CAST(COALESCE(t.stop_ts, t.start_ts) AS DATE)) AS encounter_stop_date
    , t.patient_id AS patient_id
    , t.organization_id AS organization_id
    , pr.provider_id AS provider_id
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS payer_id
    , CASE
        WHEN t.class_code = 'EMER' THEN 'emergency'
        WHEN t.class_code = 'IMP' THEN 'inpatient'
        WHEN t.class_code = 'AMB' THEN
            CASE
                WHEN t.encounter_code IN ('162673000', '170258001', '410620009', '390906007') THEN 'wellness'
                WHEN t.encounter_code = '308335008' THEN 'outpatient'
                WHEN t.encounter_code = '702927004' THEN 'urgentcare'
                ELSE 'ambulatory'
            END
        WHEN t.class_code = 'HH' THEN 'home'
        WHEN t.class_code = 'VR' THEN 'virtual'
        ELSE lower(t.class_code)
      END AS encounter_class
    , t.encounter_code AS encounter_code
    , t.encounter_description AS encounter_description
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS base_encounter_cost
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS total_encounter_cost
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS encounter_payer_coverage
    , t.encounter_reason_code AS encounter_reason_code
    , t.encounter_reason_description AS encounter_reason_description
FROM typed AS t
LEFT JOIN providers AS pr
    ON pr.organization_id = t.organization_id
    AND pr.provider_name = t.provider_name
```

```sql
WITH enc AS (
    SELECT
        lower(trim(COALESCE(json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'), id))) AS encounter_id
        , COALESCE(json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start'),
                   json_extract_string(resource, '$.participant[0].period.start')) AS start_raw
        , COALESCE(json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.end'),
                   json_extract_string(resource, '$.participant[0].period.end')) AS stop_raw
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference') AS patient_ref
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.serviceProvider.reference') AS org_ref
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.participant[0].individual.display') AS practitioner_display
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.class.code') AS class_code
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].code') AS type_code
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].display') AS type_display
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].text') AS type_text
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonCode[0].coding[0].code') AS reason_code
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonCode[0].coding[0].display') AS reason_display
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'encounter') }}
)

, enc_clean AS (
    SELECT
        encounter_id
        , CAST(CAST(start_raw AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_ts
        , CAST(CAST(stop_raw AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP) AS stop_ts
        , lower(trim(regexp_replace(patient_ref, '^(urn:uuid:|Patient/)', ''))) AS patient_id
        , lower(trim(COALESCE(
            NULLIF(split_part(org_ref, '|', 2), ''),
            regexp_replace(org_ref, '^(urn:uuid:|Organization/)', '')
        ))) AS organization_id
        , trim(regexp_replace(practitioner_display, '^(Dr|Mr|Mrs|Ms|Miss)\.?\s+', '')) AS practitioner_name
        , class_code
        , type_code
        , COALESCE(type_display, type_text) AS type_description
        , reason_code
        , reason_display
    FROM enc
)

, prov_by_org AS (
    SELECT
        trim("NAME") AS provider_name
        , lower(trim("ORGANIZATION")) AS organization_id
        , min(lower(trim("Id"))) AS provider_id
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'providers') }}
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)

, prov_by_name AS (
    SELECT
        trim("NAME") AS provider_name
        , min(lower(trim("Id"))) AS provider_id
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'providers') }}
    GROUP BY 1
    HAVING count(DISTINCT "Id") = 1
)

, joined AS (
    SELECT
        e.*
        , COALESCE(po.provider_id, pn.provider_id) AS provider_id
    FROM enc_clean AS e
    LEFT JOIN prov_by_org AS po
        ON e.practitioner_name = po.provider_name
        AND e.organization_id = po.organization_id
    LEFT JOIN prov_by_name AS pn
        ON e.practitioner_name = pn.provider_name
)

SELECT
    CAST(encounter_id AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id
    , CAST(start_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS encounter_start_datetime
    , CAST(start_ts AS DATE) AS encounter_start_date
    , CAST(COALESCE(stop_ts, start_ts) AS TIMESTAMP) AS encounter_stop_datetime
    , CAST(COALESCE(stop_ts, start_ts) AS DATE) AS encounter_stop_date
    , CAST(patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id
    , CAST(organization_id AS VARCHAR) AS organization_id
    , CAST(provider_id AS VARCHAR) AS provider_id
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS payer_id
    , CAST(CASE
        WHEN upper(class_code) = 'AMB' AND type_code IN ('162673000', '410620009') THEN 'wellness'
        WHEN upper(class_code) = 'AMB' AND type_code = '308335008' THEN 'outpatient'
        WHEN upper(class_code) = 'AMB' AND type_code = '702927004' THEN 'urgentcare'
        WHEN upper(class_code) = 'AMB' THEN 'ambulatory'
        WHEN upper(class_code) = 'EMER' THEN 'emergency'
        WHEN upper(class_code) = 'IMP' THEN 'inpatient'
        WHEN upper(class_code) = 'HH' THEN 'home'
        WHEN upper(class_code) = 'VR' THEN 'virtual'
        ELSE lower(class_code)
      END AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_class
    , CAST(type_code AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_code
    , CAST(type_description AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_description
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS base_encounter_cost
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS total_encounter_cost
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS encounter_payer_coverage
    , CAST(reason_code AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_reason_code
    , CAST(reason_display AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_reason_description
FROM joined
```

```sql
WITH cte_src AS (

    SELECT
        id AS raw_id
        , CAST(resource AS JSON) AS r
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'encounter') }}

)

, cte_fields AS (

    SELECT
        lower(COALESCE(json_extract_string(r, '$.id'), raw_id)) AS encounter_id
        , COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(r, '$.period.start'),
            json_extract_string(r, '$.participant[0].period.start')
        ) AS start_txt
        , COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(r, '$.period.end'),
            json_extract_string(r, '$.participant[0].period.end')
        ) AS stop_txt
        , lower(regexp_extract(json_extract_string(r, '$.subject.reference'), '([^:/|]+)$', 1)) AS patient_id
        , lower(regexp_extract(json_extract_string(r, '$.serviceProvider.reference'), '([^:/|]+)$', 1)) AS organization_id
        , lower(trim(regexp_replace(
            COALESCE(json_extract_string(r, '$.participant[0].individual.display'), ''),
            '^(Dr|Mr|Mrs|Ms|Miss)\.?\s+', ''))) AS practitioner_name
        , json_extract_string(r, '$.class.code') AS fhir_class
        , json_extract_string(r, '$.type[0].coding[0].code') AS encounter_code
        , COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(r, '$.type[0].coding[0].display'),
            json_extract_string(r, '$.type[0].text')
        ) AS encounter_description
        , json_extract_string(r, '$.reasonCode[0].coding[0].code') AS encounter_reason_code
        , json_extract_string(r, '$.reasonCode[0].coding[0].display') AS encounter_reason_description
    FROM cte_src

)

, cte_providers AS (

    SELECT
        lower(trim("NAME")) AS provider_name
        , lower("ORGANIZATION") AS organization_id
        , lower(min("Id")) AS provider_id
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'providers') }}
    GROUP BY lower(trim("NAME")), lower("ORGANIZATION")
    HAVING count(*) = 1

)

, cte_times AS (

    SELECT
        f.*
        , CASE
            WHEN start_txt IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN regexp_matches(start_txt, '(Z|[+-][0-9]{2}:?[0-9]{2})$')
                THEN CAST(CAST(start_txt AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP)
            ELSE CAST(start_txt AS TIMESTAMP)
          END AS start_ts
        , CASE
            WHEN stop_txt IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN regexp_matches(stop_txt, '(Z|[+-][0-9]{2}:?[0-9]{2})$')
                THEN CAST(CAST(stop_txt AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP)
            ELSE CAST(stop_txt AS TIMESTAMP)
          END AS stop_ts
    FROM cte_fields AS f

)

SELECT
    CAST(t.encounter_id AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id
    , CAST(t.start_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS encounter_start_datetime
    , CAST(t.start_ts AS DATE) AS encounter_start_date
    , CAST(COALESCE(t.stop_ts, t.start_ts) AS TIMESTAMP) AS encounter_stop_datetime
    , CAST(COALESCE(CAST(t.start_ts AS DATE), CAST(t.stop_ts AS DATE)) AS DATE) AS encounter_stop_date
    , CAST(t.patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id
    , CAST(t.organization_id AS VARCHAR) AS organization_id
    , CAST(p.provider_id AS VARCHAR) AS provider_id
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS payer_id
    , CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN t.fhir_class = 'AMB' AND t.encounter_code IN ('162673000', '410620009') THEN 'wellness'
            WHEN t.fhir_class = 'AMB' AND t.encounter_code = '702927004' THEN 'urgentcare'
            WHEN t.fhir_class = 'AMB' AND t.encounter_code = '308335008' THEN 'outpatient'
            WHEN t.fhir_class = 'AMB' THEN 'ambulatory'
            WHEN t.fhir_class = 'EMER' THEN 'emergency'
            WHEN t.fhir_class = 'IMP' THEN 'inpatient'
            WHEN t.fhir_class = 'HH' THEN 'home'
            WHEN t.fhir_class = 'VR' THEN 'virtual'
            ELSE lower(t.fhir_class)
        END AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_class
    , CAST(t.encounter_code AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_code
    , CAST(t.encounter_description AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_description
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS base_encounter_cost
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS total_encounter_cost
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS encounter_payer_coverage
    , CAST(t.encounter_reason_code AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_reason_code
    , CAST(t.encounter_reason_description AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_reason_description
FROM cte_times AS t
LEFT JOIN cte_providers AS p
    ON p.provider_name = t.practitioner_name
    AND p.organization_id = t.organization_id
```

## Mapping hints
- encounter_id is the resource id; the patient is subject.reference without the urn:uuid: prefix; start and stop are period.start and period.end (they carry a UTC offset; the contract wants UTC).
- organization is the identifier after the | in serviceProvider.reference. The provider is not given by id: participant[0].individual.display is 'Dr. ' plus the provider's NAME in the shared providers table (match on name and organization).
- encounter class: class.code EMER = emergency, IMP = inpatient; for AMB look at type[0].coding[0].code: 702927004 = urgentcare, 162673000 / 410620009 / 308646001 = wellness, otherwise ambulatory.
- code and description are type[0].coding[0].code and .display; the reason is reasonCode[0].coding[0] in R4 and reason[0].coding[0] in STU3.
- The acquirer's text has every comma replaced by a space. Payer and the three cost columns are not in the resource: return NULL.
text:
```sql
WITH providers AS (
    SELECT
        trim(replace("NAME", ',', ' ')) AS provider_name
        , "ORGANIZATION" AS organization_id
        , MIN("Id") AS provider_id
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'providers') }}
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)

, enc AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'), id) AS encounter_id
        , CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start') AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS start_dt
        , CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.end') AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS stop_dt
        , regexp_replace(json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'), '^urn:uuid:', '') AS patient_id
        , split_part(json_extract_string(resource, '$.serviceProvider.reference'), '|', 2) AS organization_id
        , trim(replace(regexp_replace(json_extract_string(resource, '$.participant[0].individual.display'), '^Dr\. ', ''), ',', ' ')) AS provider_name
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.class.code') AS class_code
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].code') AS type_code
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].display') AS type_display
        , COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonCode[0].coding[0].code'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.reason[0].coding[0].code')
        ) AS reason_code
        , COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonCode[0].coding[0].display'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.reason[0].coding[0].display')
        ) AS reason_display
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'encounter') }}
)

SELECT
    CAST(e.encounter_id AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id
    , CAST(e.start_dt AS TIMESTAMP) AS encounter_start_datetime
    , CAST(e.start_dt AS DATE) AS encounter_start_date
    , CAST(COALESCE(e.stop_dt, e.start_dt) AS TIMESTAMP) AS encounter_stop_datetime
    , CAST(COALESCE(CAST(e.start_dt AS DATE), CAST(e.stop_dt AS DATE)) AS DATE) AS encounter_stop_date
    , CAST(e.patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id
    , CAST(e.organization_id AS VARCHAR) AS organization_id
    , CAST(p.provider_id AS VARCHAR) AS provider_id
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS payer_id
    , CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN e.class_code = 'EMER' THEN 'emergency'
            WHEN e.class_code = 'IMP' THEN 'inpatient'
            WHEN e.class_code = 'AMB' THEN
                CASE
                    WHEN e.type_code = '702927004' THEN 'urgentcare'
                    WHEN e.type_code IN ('162673000', '410620009', '308646001') THEN 'wellness'
                    ELSE 'ambulatory'
                END
            ELSE lower(e.class_code)
        END AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_class
    , CAST(replace(e.type_code, ',', ' ') AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_code
    , CAST(replace(e.type_display, ',', ' ') AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_description
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS base_encounter_cost
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS total_encounter_cost
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS encounter_payer_coverage
    , CAST(replace(e.reason_code, ',', ' ') AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_reason_code
    , CAST(replace(e.reason_display, ',', ' ') AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_reason_description
FROM enc e
LEFT JOIN providers p
    ON p.provider_name = e.provider_name
    AND p.organization_id = e.organization_id
```

```sql
WITH enc AS (

    SELECT
        LOWER(COALESCE(json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'), id)) AS encounter_id
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start') AS start_raw
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.end') AS stop_raw
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference') AS subject_ref
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.serviceProvider.reference') AS org_ref
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.participant[0].individual.display') AS practitioner_display
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.class.code') AS class_code
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].code') AS type_code
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].display') AS type_display
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonCode[0].coding[0].code') AS reason_code
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonCode[0].coding[0].display') AS reason_display
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'encounter') }}
    WHERE json_extract_string(resource, '$.resourceType') = 'Encounter'

)

, cte_providers AS (

    SELECT
        LOWER(TRIM("NAME")) AS provider_name
        , LOWER("ORGANIZATION") AS organization_id
        , MIN(LOWER("Id")) AS provider_id
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'providers') }}
    GROUP BY 1, 2
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "Id") = 1

)

, cte_enc_clean AS (

    SELECT
        encounter_id
        , CAST(CAST(start_raw AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_ts
        , CAST(CAST(stop_raw AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP) AS stop_ts
        , LOWER(regexp_replace(subject_ref, '^.*[:/|]', '')) AS patient_id
        , LOWER(regexp_replace(org_ref, '^.*[:/|]', '')) AS organization_id
        , LOWER(TRIM(regexp_replace(practitioner_display, '^(Dr|Mr|Mrs|Ms|Miss)\.?\s+', ''))) AS provider_name
        , CASE
            WHEN class_code = 'AMB' AND type_code = '702927004' THEN 'urgentcare'
            WHEN class_code = 'AMB' AND type_code IN ('162673000', '410620009', '185349003') THEN 'wellness'
            WHEN class_code = 'AMB' AND type_code = '308335008' THEN 'outpatient'
            WHEN class_code = 'AMB' THEN 'ambulatory'
            WHEN class_code = 'EMER' THEN 'emergency'
            WHEN class_code = 'IMP' THEN 'inpatient'
            WHEN class_code = 'HH' THEN 'home'
            WHEN class_code = 'VR' THEN 'virtual'
            ELSE LOWER(class_code)
          END AS encounter_class
        , type_code AS encounter_code
        , type_display AS encounter_description
        , reason_code AS encounter_reason_code
        , reason_display AS encounter_reason_description
    FROM enc

)

SELECT
    e.encounter_id AS encounter_id
    , e.start_ts AS encounter_start_datetime
    , CAST(e.start_ts AS DATE) AS encounter_start_date
    , COALESCE(e.stop_ts, e.start_ts) AS encounter_stop_datetime
    , COALESCE(CAST(e.start_ts AS DATE), CAST(e.stop_ts AS DATE)) AS encounter_stop_date
    , e.patient_id AS patient_id
    , e.organization_id AS organization_id
    , p.provider_id AS provider_id
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS payer_id
    , e.encounter_class AS encounter_class
    , e.encounter_code AS encounter_code
    , e.encounter_description AS encounter_description
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS base_encounter_cost
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS total_encounter_cost
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS encounter_payer_coverage
    , e.encounter_reason_code AS encounter_reason_code
    , e.encounter_reason_description AS encounter_reason_description
FROM cte_enc_clean AS e
LEFT JOIN cte_providers AS p
    ON e.provider_name = p.provider_name
    AND e.organization_id = p.organization_id
```

## Mapping hints
- encounter_id is the resource id; the patient is subject.reference without the urn:uuid: prefix; start and stop are period.start and period.end (they carry a UTC offset; the contract wants UTC).
- organization is the identifier after the | in serviceProvider.reference. The provider is not given by id: participant[0].individual.display is 'Dr. ' plus the provider's NAME in the shared providers table (match on name and organization).
- encounter class: class.code EMER = emergency, IMP = inpatient; for AMB look at type[0].coding[0].code: 702927004 = urgentcare, 162673000 / 410620009 / 308646001 = wellness, otherwise ambulatory.
- code and description are type[0].coding[0].code and .display; the reason is reasonCode[0].coding[0] in R4 and reason[0].coding[0] in STU3.
- The acquirer's text has every comma replaced by a space. Payer and the three cost columns are not in the resource: return NULL.
text:
```sql
WITH enc AS (

    SELECT
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.id') AS encounter_id
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start') AS start_raw
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.end') AS stop_raw
        , replace(json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'), 'urn:uuid:', '') AS patient_id
        , split_part(json_extract_string(resource, '$.serviceProvider.reference'), '|', 2) AS organization_id
        , regexp_replace(json_extract_string(resource, '$.participant[0].individual.display'), '^Dr\. ', '') AS provider_name
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.class.code') AS class_code
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].code') AS type_code
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].display') AS type_display
        , COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonCode[0].coding[0].code'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.reason[0].coding[0].code')
        ) AS reason_code
        , COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonCode[0].coding[0].display'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.reason[0].coding[0].display')
        ) AS reason_display
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'encounter') }}

)

, prov AS (

    SELECT
        "NAME" AS provider_name
        , "ORGANIZATION" AS organization_id
        , MIN("Id") AS provider_id
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'providers') }}
    GROUP BY "NAME", "ORGANIZATION"

)

, cte_times AS (

    SELECT
        enc.*
        , CAST((CAST(start_raw AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_dt
        , CAST((CAST(stop_raw AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS TIMESTAMP) AS stop_dt
    FROM enc

)

SELECT
    t.encounter_id AS encounter_id
    , t.start_dt AS encounter_start_datetime
    , CAST(t.start_dt AS DATE) AS encounter_start_date
    -- default to start when stop is null, as the acquirer does
    , COALESCE(t.stop_dt, t.start_dt) AS encounter_stop_datetime
    -- the acquirer's convention: stop date is derived from the start datetime
    , COALESCE(CAST(t.start_dt AS DATE), CAST(t.stop_dt AS DATE)) AS encounter_stop_date
    , t.patient_id AS patient_id
    , t.organization_id AS organization_id
    , p.provider_id AS provider_id
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS payer_id
    , CASE
        WHEN t.class_code = 'EMER' THEN 'emergency'
        WHEN t.class_code = 'IMP' THEN 'inpatient'
        WHEN t.class_code = 'AMB' THEN
            CASE
                WHEN t.type_code = '702927004' THEN 'urgentcare'
                WHEN t.type_code IN ('162673000', '410620009', '308646001') THEN 'wellness'
                ELSE 'ambulatory'
            END
        ELSE lower(t.class_code)
      END AS encounter_class
    , t.type_code AS encounter_code
    , replace(t.type_display, ',', ' ') AS encounter_description
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS base_encounter_cost
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS total_encounter_cost
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS encounter_payer_coverage
    , t.reason_code AS encounter_reason_code
    , replace(t.reason_display, ',', ' ') AS encounter_reason_description
FROM cte_times AS t
LEFT JOIN prov AS p
    ON p.provider_name = t.provider_name
    AND p.organization_id = t.organization_id
```

```sql
WITH src AS (
    SELECT
        resource,
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.onsetDateTime'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.onsetPeriod.start'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.recordedDate')
        ) AS onset_raw,
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.abatementDateTime'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.abatementPeriod.end')
        ) AS abate_raw
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'condition') }}
    WHERE json_extract_string(resource, '$.resourceType') = 'Condition'
)

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN onset_raw IS NULL THEN NULL
        WHEN length(onset_raw) <= 10 THEN CAST(onset_raw AS DATE)
        ELSE CAST((CAST(onset_raw AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)
    END AS condition_start_date,
    CASE
        WHEN abate_raw IS NULL THEN NULL
        WHEN length(abate_raw) <= 10 THEN CAST(abate_raw AS DATE)
        ELSE CAST((CAST(abate_raw AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)
    END AS condition_stop_date,
    CAST(lower(regexp_replace(json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'), '^.*[:/]', '')) AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id,
    CAST(lower(regexp_replace(json_extract_string(resource, '$.encounter.reference'), '^.*[:/]', '')) AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id,
    CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') AS VARCHAR) AS condition_code,
    CAST(COALESCE(
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display'),
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text')
    ) AS VARCHAR) AS condition_description
FROM src
```

## Mapping hints
- start and stop dates are the first 10 characters of onsetDateTime and abatementDateTime (the local date, not the UTC date).
- patient is subject.reference and the encounter is encounter.reference (R4) or context.reference (STU3), both without the urn:uuid: prefix.
- code and description are code.coding[0].code and .display; the acquirer's text has every comma replaced by a space.
text:
```sql
WITH src AS (

    SELECT
        id
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.onsetDateTime') AS onset_raw
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.abatementDateTime') AS abatement_raw
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference') AS subject_ref
        , COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.encounter.reference')
            , json_extract_string(resource, '$.context.reference')
        ) AS encounter_ref
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') AS code_raw
        , COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display')
            , json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text')
        ) AS description_raw
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'condition') }}
    WHERE json_extract_string(resource, '$.resourceType') = 'Condition'

)

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN onset_raw IS NULL OR onset_raw = '' THEN NULL
        WHEN length(onset_raw) = 10 THEN CAST(onset_raw AS DATE)
        ELSE CAST((CAST(onset_raw AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)
    END AS condition_start_date
    , CASE
        WHEN abatement_raw IS NULL OR abatement_raw = '' THEN NULL
        WHEN length(abatement_raw) = 10 THEN CAST(abatement_raw AS DATE)
        ELSE CAST((CAST(abatement_raw AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)
    END AS condition_stop_date
    , CAST(regexp_replace(subject_ref, '^(urn:uuid:|Patient/)', '') AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id
    , CAST(regexp_replace(encounter_ref, '^(urn:uuid:|Encounter/)', '') AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id
    , CAST(code_raw AS VARCHAR) AS condition_code
    , CAST(replace(description_raw, ',', ' ') AS VARCHAR) AS condition_description
FROM src
```

```sql
    SELECT
        id
        , resource
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.onsetDateTime') AS onset_raw
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.recordedDate') AS recorded_raw
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.abatementDateTime') AS abatement_raw
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference') AS subject_ref
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.encounter.reference') AS encounter_ref
        , from_json(json_extract(resource, '$.code.coding'), '["JSON"]') AS codings
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text') AS code_text
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'condition') }}
    WHERE json_extract_string(resource, '$.resourceType') = 'Condition'

)

, picked AS (

    SELECT
        *
        , coalesce(
            list_filter(codings, x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.system') = 'http://snomed.info/sct')[1]
            , codings[1]
        ) AS coding
        , coalesce(onset_raw, recorded_raw) AS start_raw
    FROM src

)

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN start_raw IS NULL THEN NULL
        WHEN length(start_raw) = 10 THEN CAST(start_raw AS DATE)
        ELSE CAST((CAST(start_raw AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)
    END AS condition_start_date
    , CASE
        WHEN abatement_raw IS NULL THEN NULL
        WHEN length(abatement_raw) = 10 THEN CAST(abatement_raw AS DATE)
        ELSE CAST((CAST(abatement_raw AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)
    END AS condition_stop_date
    , CAST(lower(regexp_extract(subject_ref, '([^:/]+)$', 1)) AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id
    , CAST(lower(regexp_extract(encounter_ref, '([^:/]+)$', 1)) AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id
    , CAST(json_extract_string(coding, '$.code') AS VARCHAR) AS condition_code
    , CAST(coalesce(json_extract_string(coding, '$.display'), code_text) AS VARCHAR) AS condition_description
FROM picked
```

```sql
        , row_number() OVER (
            PARTITION BY r.proc_id
            ORDER BY CASE WHEN c.cond_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, r.idx
        ) AS rn
    FROM cte_reason_refs AS r
    LEFT JOIN cte_cond AS c
        ON r.ref_id = c.cond_id

)

, cte_base AS (

    SELECT
        p.proc_id
        , CAST(coalesce(
            json_extract_string(p.resource, '$.performedPeriod.start')
            , json_extract_string(p.resource, '$.performedDateTime')
        ) AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AS start_tz
        , CAST(json_extract_string(p.resource, '$.performedPeriod.end') AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AS stop_tz
        , replace(json_extract_string(p.resource, '$.subject.reference'), 'urn:uuid:', '') AS patient_id
        , replace(json_extract_string(p.resource, '$.encounter.reference'), 'urn:uuid:', '') AS encounter_id
        , json_extract_string(p.resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') AS procedure_code
        , coalesce(
            json_extract_string(p.resource, '$.code.coding[0].display')
            , json_extract_string(p.resource, '$.code.text')
        ) AS procedure_description
    FROM cte_proc AS p

)

SELECT
    CAST(b.start_tz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP) AS procedure_start_datetime
    , CAST(CAST(b.start_tz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS procedure_start_date
    , CAST(b.stop_tz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP) AS procedure_stop_datetime
    , CAST(CAST(b.stop_tz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS procedure_stop_date
    , CAST(b.patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id
    , CAST(b.encounter_id AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id
    , CAST(b.procedure_code AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_code
    , CAST(b.procedure_description AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_description
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS procedure_base_cost
    , CAST(rp.reason_code AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_reason_code
    , CAST(rp.reason_description AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_reason_description
FROM cte_base AS b
LEFT JOIN cte_reason_pick AS rp
    ON b.proc_id = rp.proc_id
    AND rp.rn = 1
```

```sql
WITH cte_conditions AS (

    SELECT
        lower(coalesce(json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'), id)) AS condition_id
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') AS condition_code
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display') AS condition_description
        , row_number() OVER (
            PARTITION BY lower(coalesce(json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'), id))
            ORDER BY id
        ) AS rn
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'condition') }}

)

, cte_conditions_unique AS (

    SELECT
        condition_id
        , condition_code
        , condition_description
    FROM cte_conditions
    WHERE rn = 1

)

, cte_procedures_raw AS (

    SELECT
        id AS source_id
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedPeriod.start') AS start_raw
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedPeriod.end') AS stop_raw
        , lower(replace(json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'), 'urn:uuid:', '')) AS patient_id
        , lower(replace(json_extract_string(resource, '$.encounter.reference'), 'urn:uuid:', '')) AS encounter_id
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') AS procedure_code
        , coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display')
            , json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text')
        ) AS procedure_description
        , lower(replace(json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonReference[0].reference'), 'urn:uuid:', '')) AS reason_condition_id
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'procedure') }}

)

, cte_procedures_times AS (

    SELECT
        source_id
        , CASE
            WHEN start_raw IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN regexp_matches(start_raw, '(Z|[+-][0-9]{2}:?[0-9]{2})$')
                THEN CAST(CAST(start_raw AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP)
            ELSE CAST(start_raw AS TIMESTAMP)
          END AS procedure_start_datetime
        , CASE
            WHEN stop_raw IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN regexp_matches(stop_raw, '(Z|[+-][0-9]{2}:?[0-9]{2})$')
                THEN CAST(CAST(stop_raw AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP)
            ELSE CAST(stop_raw AS TIMESTAMP)
          END AS procedure_stop_datetime
        , patient_id
        , encounter_id
        , procedure_code
        , procedure_description
        , reason_condition_id
    FROM cte_procedures_raw

)

SELECT
    CAST(p.procedure_start_datetime AS TIMESTAMP) AS procedure_start_datetime
    , CAST(p.procedure_start_datetime AS DATE) AS procedure_start_date
    , CAST(p.procedure_stop_datetime AS TIMESTAMP) AS procedure_stop_datetime
    , CAST(p.procedure_stop_datetime AS DATE) AS procedure_stop_date
    , CAST(p.patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id
    , CAST(p.encounter_id AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id
    , CAST(p.procedure_code AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_code
    , CAST(p.procedure_description AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_description
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS procedure_base_cost
    , CAST(c.condition_code AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_reason_code
    , CAST(c.condition_description AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_reason_description
FROM cte_procedures_times AS p
LEFT JOIN cte_conditions_unique AS c
    ON p.reason_condition_id = c.condition_id
```

```sql
WITH cte_procedure AS (

    SELECT
        id AS source_id
        , resource
        , COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedPeriod.start')
            , json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedDateTime')
        ) AS start_raw
        , COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedPeriod.end')
            , json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedDateTime')
        ) AS stop_raw
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference') AS patient_ref
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.encounter.reference') AS encounter_ref
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') AS code_raw
        , COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display')
            , json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text')
        ) AS description_raw
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonReference[0].reference') AS reason_ref
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'procedure') }}

)

, cte_condition AS (

    SELECT
        lower(regexp_replace(
            COALESCE(json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'), id)
            , '^.*[:/]', ''
        )) AS condition_id
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') AS condition_code
        , COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display')
            , json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text')
        ) AS condition_description
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'condition') }}
    QUALIFY row_number() OVER (
        PARTITION BY lower(regexp_replace(
            COALESCE(json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'), id)
            , '^.*[:/]', ''
        ))
        ORDER BY id
    ) = 1

)

, cte_joined AS (

    SELECT
        p.source_id
        , CAST(CAST(p.start_raw AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP) AS procedure_start_datetime
        , CAST(CAST(p.stop_raw AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP) AS procedure_stop_datetime
        , lower(regexp_replace(p.patient_ref, '^.*[:/]', '')) AS patient_id
        , lower(regexp_replace(p.encounter_ref, '^.*[:/]', '')) AS encounter_id
        , p.code_raw AS procedure_code
        , p.description_raw AS procedure_description
        , c.condition_code AS procedure_reason_code
        , c.condition_description AS procedure_reason_description
    FROM cte_procedure AS p
    LEFT JOIN cte_condition AS c
        ON lower(regexp_replace(p.reason_ref, '^.*[:/]', '')) = c.condition_id

)

SELECT
    procedure_start_datetime
    , CAST(procedure_start_datetime AS DATE) AS procedure_start_date
    , procedure_stop_datetime
    , CAST(procedure_stop_datetime AS DATE) AS procedure_stop_date
    , CAST(patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id
    , CAST(encounter_id AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id
    , CAST(procedure_code AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_code
    , CAST(procedure_description AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_description
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS procedure_base_cost
    , CAST(procedure_reason_code AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_reason_code
    , CAST(procedure_reason_description AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_reason_description
FROM cte_joined
```

```sql
WITH proc AS (

    SELECT
        id AS proc_key
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedPeriod.start') AS start_raw
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedPeriod.end') AS end_raw
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference') AS patient_ref
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.encounter.reference') AS encounter_ref
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') AS code_raw
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display') AS display_raw
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text') AS text_raw
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'procedure') }}

)

, reason_refs AS (

    SELECT
        p.id AS proc_key
        , json_extract_string(t.r, '$.reference') AS reason_ref
        , json_extract_string(t.r, '$.display') AS reason_display
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'procedure') }} AS p
        , UNNEST(CAST(json_extract(p.resource, '$.reasonReference') AS JSON[])) AS t(r)

)

, cond AS (

    SELECT
        lower(id) AS cond_id
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') AS cond_code
        , coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display')
            , json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text')
        ) AS cond_display
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'condition') }}

)

, reason_pick AS (

    SELECT
        rr.proc_key
        , c.cond_code AS reason_code
        , coalesce(c.cond_display, rr.reason_display) AS reason_description
        , row_number() OVER (
            PARTITION BY rr.proc_key
            ORDER BY c.cond_code, coalesce(c.cond_display, rr.reason_display), rr.reason_ref
        ) AS rn
    FROM reason_refs AS rr
    LEFT JOIN cond AS c
        ON lower(regexp_extract(rr.reason_ref, '([^:/]+)$', 1)) = c.cond_id

)

SELECT
    CAST(CAST(p.start_raw AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP) AS procedure_start_datetime
    , CAST(CAST(CAST(p.start_raw AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS procedure_start_date
    , CAST(CAST(p.end_raw AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP) AS procedure_stop_datetime
    , CAST(CAST(CAST(p.end_raw AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS procedure_stop_date
    , CAST(lower(regexp_extract(p.patient_ref, '([^:/]+)$', 1)) AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id
    , CAST(lower(regexp_extract(p.encounter_ref, '([^:/]+)$', 1)) AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id
    , CAST(p.code_raw AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_code
    , CAST(coalesce(p.display_raw, p.text_raw) AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_description
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS procedure_base_cost
    , CAST(rp.reason_code AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_reason_code
    , CAST(rp.reason_description AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_reason_description
FROM proc AS p
LEFT JOIN reason_pick AS rp
    ON p.proc_key = rp.proc_key
    AND rp.rn = 1
```

## Mapping hints
- start and stop are performedPeriod.start and .end (or performedDateTime for both); they carry a UTC offset and the contract wants UTC.
- patient is subject.reference, the encounter is encounter.reference (R4) or context.reference (STU3), without the urn:uuid: prefix.
- code and description are code.coding[0]; commas in text become spaces. The reason is the code of the Condition that reasonReference[0].reference points to. The cost is not in the resource: NULL.
text:
```sql
WITH cte_condition AS (

    SELECT
        id AS condition_id
        , MAX(json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code')) AS reason_code
        , MAX(json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display')) AS reason_description
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'condition') }}
    GROUP BY id

)

, cte_procedure AS (

    SELECT
        id AS procedure_id
        , COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedPeriod.start')
            , json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedDateTime')
        ) AS start_raw
        , COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedPeriod.end')
            , json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedDateTime')
        ) AS stop_raw
        , regexp_replace(json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'), '^(urn:uuid:|Patient/)', '') AS patient_id
        , regexp_replace(
            COALESCE(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.encounter.reference')
                , json_extract_string(resource, '$.context.reference')
            )
            , '^(urn:uuid:|Encounter/)', ''
        ) AS encounter_id
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') AS procedure_code
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display') AS procedure_description
        , regexp_replace(json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonReference[0].reference'), '^(urn:uuid:|Condition/)', '') AS reason_condition_id
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'procedure') }}

)

, cte_converted AS (

    SELECT
        p.procedure_id
        , CAST((CAST(p.start_raw AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS TIMESTAMP) AS procedure_start_datetime
        , CAST((CAST(p.stop_raw AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS TIMESTAMP) AS procedure_stop_datetime
        , p.patient_id
        , p.encounter_id
        , p.procedure_code
        , replace(p.procedure_description, ',', ' ') AS procedure_description
        , c.reason_code AS procedure_reason_code
        , replace(c.reason_description, ',', ' ') AS procedure_reason_description
    FROM cte_procedure AS p
    LEFT JOIN cte_condition AS c
        ON p.reason_condition_id = c.condition_id

)

SELECT
    procedure_start_datetime
    , CAST(procedure_start_datetime AS DATE) AS procedure_start_date
    , procedure_stop_datetime
    , CAST(procedure_stop_datetime AS DATE) AS procedure_stop_date
    , CAST(patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id
    , CAST(encounter_id AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id
    , CAST(procedure_code AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_code
    , CAST(procedure_description AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_description
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS procedure_base_cost
    , CAST(procedure_reason_code AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_reason_code
    , CAST(procedure_reason_description AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_reason_description
FROM cte_converted
```

## Mapping hints
- start and stop are performedPeriod.start and .end (or performedDateTime for both); they carry a UTC offset and the contract wants UTC.
- patient is subject.reference, the encounter is encounter.reference (R4) or context.reference (STU3), without the urn:uuid: prefix.
- code and description are code.coding[0]; commas in text become spaces. The reason is the code of the Condition that reasonReference[0].reference points to. The cost is not in the resource: NULL.
text:
```sql
WITH cte_procedure AS (

    SELECT
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.id') AS resource_id
        , COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedPeriod.start')
            , json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedDateTime')
        ) AS start_raw
        , COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedPeriod.end')
            , json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedDateTime')
        ) AS stop_raw
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference') AS patient_ref
        , COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.encounter.reference')
            , json_extract_string(resource, '$.context.reference')
        ) AS encounter_ref
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') AS code_raw
        , COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display')
            , json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text')
        ) AS description_raw
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonReference[0].reference') AS reason_ref
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonReference[0].display') AS reason_display_ref
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'procedure') }}

)

, cte_condition AS (

    SELECT
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.id') AS condition_id
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') AS condition_code
        , COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display')
            , json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text')
        ) AS condition_description
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'condition') }}
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY json_extract_string(resource, '$.id')
        ORDER BY json_extract_string(resource, '$.id')
    ) = 1

)

, cte_joined AS (

    SELECT
        p.*
        , c.condition_code
        , c.condition_description
    FROM cte_procedure AS p
    LEFT JOIN cte_condition AS c
        ON regexp_replace(p.reason_ref, '^(urn:uuid:|Condition/)', '') = c.condition_id

)

, cte_final AS (

    SELECT
        timezone('UTC', CAST(start_raw AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) AS procedure_start_datetime
        , timezone('UTC', CAST(stop_raw AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) AS procedure_stop_datetime
        , regexp_replace(patient_ref, '^(urn:uuid:|Patient/)', '') AS patient_id
        , regexp_replace(encounter_ref, '^(urn:uuid:|Encounter/)', '') AS encounter_id
        , code_raw AS procedure_code
        , replace(description_raw, ',', ' ') AS procedure_description
        , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS procedure_base_cost
        , condition_code AS procedure_reason_code
        , replace(
            CASE WHEN reason_ref IS NULL THEN NULL
                 ELSE COALESCE(condition_description, reason_display_ref) END
            , ',', ' ') AS procedure_reason_description
    FROM cte_joined

)

SELECT
    CAST(procedure_start_datetime AS TIMESTAMP) AS procedure_start_datetime
    , CAST(procedure_start_datetime AS DATE) AS procedure_start_date
    , CAST(procedure_stop_datetime AS TIMESTAMP) AS procedure_stop_datetime
    , CAST(procedure_stop_datetime AS DATE) AS procedure_stop_date
    , CAST(patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id
    , CAST(encounter_id AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id
    , CAST(procedure_code AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_code
    , CAST(procedure_description AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_description
    , CAST(procedure_base_cost AS FLOAT) AS procedure_base_cost
    , CAST(procedure_reason_code AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_reason_code
    , CAST(procedure_reason_description AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_reason_description
FROM cte_final
```

```sql
WITH src AS (

    SELECT
        id
        , CAST(resource AS JSON) AS resource
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'observation') }}
    WHERE json_extract_string(resource, '$.resourceType') = 'Observation'

)

, parent_rows AS (

    -- resources without components: the resource itself is the observation
    SELECT
        id
        , resource
        , resource AS node
    FROM src
    WHERE COALESCE(json_array_length(json_extract(resource, '$.component')), 0) = 0

)

, component_rows AS (

    -- resources with components: one observation per component (as in the acquirer's flat rows)
    SELECT
        id
        , resource
        , UNNEST(from_json(json_extract(resource, '$.component'), '["json"]')) AS node
    FROM src
    WHERE COALESCE(json_array_length(json_extract(resource, '$.component')), 0) > 0

)

, all_nodes AS (

    SELECT * FROM parent_rows
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM component_rows

)
```

```sql
WITH src AS (

    SELECT
        id
        , resource
        , CASE
            WHEN json_array_length(json_extract(resource, '$.component')) > 0
                THEN from_json(json_extract(resource, '$.component'), '["JSON"]')
            ELSE [resource]
          END AS items
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'observation') }}
    WHERE json_extract_string(resource, '$.resourceType') = 'Observation'

)

, exploded AS (

    SELECT
        id
        , resource
        , unnest(items) AS item
    FROM src

)

, extracted AS (

    SELECT
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.effectiveDateTime') AS eff_raw
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference') AS subject_ref
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.encounter.reference') AS encounter_ref
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.category[0].coding[0].code') AS category_raw
        , json_extract_string(item, '$.code.coding[0].code') AS code_raw
        , coalesce(
            json_extract_string(item, '$.code.coding[0].display')
            , json_extract_string(item, '$.code.text')
          ) AS description_raw
        , json_extract_string(item, '$.valueQuantity.value') AS quantity_value
        , json_extract_string(item, '$.valueQuantity.unit') AS quantity_unit
        , coalesce(
            json_extract_string(item, '$.valueCodeableConcept.text')
            , json_extract_string(item, '$.valueCodeableConcept.coding[0].display')
            , json_extract_string(item, '$.valueString')
            , json_extract_string(item, '$.valueBoolean')
            , json_extract_string(item, '$.valueInteger')
          ) AS text_value
    FROM exploded

)

, cleaned AS (

    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN eff_raw IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN length(eff_raw) = 10 THEN eff_raw || 'T00:00:00+00:00'
            WHEN regexp_matches(eff_raw, '(Z|[+-][0-9][0-9]:?[0-9][0-9])$') THEN eff_raw
            ELSE eff_raw || '+00:00'
        END AS eff_utc_text
        , regexp_replace(subject_ref, '^(urn:uuid:|Patient/)', '') AS patient_id
        , regexp_replace(encounter_ref, '^(urn:uuid:|Encounter/)', '') AS encounter_id
        , category_raw AS observation_category
        , code_raw AS observation_code
        , regexp_replace(replace(description_raw, ',', ' '), '[\r\n]+', ' ', 'g') AS observation_description
        , CASE
            WHEN quantity_value IS NOT NULL THEN quantity_value
            ELSE regexp_replace(replace(text_value, ',', ' '), '[\r\n]+', ' ', 'g')
          END AS observation_value
        , CASE
            WHEN quantity_value IS NOT NULL THEN quantity_unit
            ELSE NULL
          END AS observation_units
        , CASE
            WHEN quantity_value IS NOT NULL THEN 'numeric'
            ELSE 'text'
          END AS observation_value_type
    FROM extracted

)

SELECT
    CAST((try_cast(eff_utc_text AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS TIMESTAMP) AS observation_datetime
    , CAST(CAST((try_cast(eff_utc_text AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS observation_date
    , CAST(patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id
    , CAST(encounter_id AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id
    , CAST(observation_category AS VARCHAR) AS observation_category
    , CAST(observation_code AS VARCHAR) AS observation_code
    , CAST(observation_description AS VARCHAR) AS observation_description
    , CAST(observation_value AS VARCHAR) AS observation_value
    , CAST(observation_units AS VARCHAR) AS observation_units
    , CAST(observation_value_type AS VARCHAR) AS observation_value_type
FROM cleaned
```

```sql
WITH obs AS (

    SELECT
        id
        , resource
        , COALESCE(json_array_length(resource -> '$.component'), 0) AS n_components
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'observation') }}
    WHERE resource ->> '$.resourceType' = 'Observation'

)

, nodes AS (

    -- observations without components: the resource itself is the record
    SELECT
        resource
        , resource AS node
    FROM obs
    WHERE n_components = 0

    UNION ALL

    -- observations with components (blood pressure, surveys): one record per component
    SELECT
        o.resource
        , t.comp AS node
    FROM obs AS o
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(CAST(o.resource -> '$.component' AS JSON[])) AS t(comp)
    WHERE o.n_components > 0

)

, extracted AS (

    SELECT
        CAST(resource ->> '$.effectiveDateTime' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS observation_datetime
        , replace(resource ->> '$.subject.reference', 'urn:uuid:', '') AS patient_id
        , replace(resource ->> '$.encounter.reference', 'urn:uuid:', '') AS encounter_id
        , resource ->> '$.category[0].coding[0].code' AS observation_category
        , node ->> '$.code.coding[0].code' AS observation_code
        , COALESCE(node ->> '$.code.coding[0].display', node ->> '$.code.text') AS observation_description
        , COALESCE(
            node ->> '$.valueQuantity.value'
            , node ->> '$.valueString'
            , node ->> '$.valueCodeableConcept.text'
            , node ->> '$.valueCodeableConcept.coding[0].display'
        ) AS observation_value
        , node ->> '$.valueQuantity.unit' AS observation_units
        , CASE
            WHEN node ->> '$.valueQuantity.value' IS NOT NULL THEN 'numeric'
            ELSE 'text'
        END AS observation_value_type
    FROM nodes

)

SELECT
    CAST(observation_datetime AS TIMESTAMP) AS observation_datetime
    , CAST(observation_datetime AS DATE) AS observation_date
    , CAST(patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id
    , CAST(encounter_id AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id
    , CAST(observation_category AS VARCHAR) AS observation_category
    , CAST(observation_code AS VARCHAR) AS observation_code
    , CAST(replace(observation_description, ',', ' ') AS VARCHAR) AS observation_description
    , CAST(replace(observation_value, ',', ' ') AS VARCHAR) AS observation_value
    , CAST(observation_units AS VARCHAR) AS observation_units
    , CAST(observation_value_type AS VARCHAR) AS observation_value_type
FROM extracted
```

## Mapping hints
- One row per value: an Observation with component[] gives one row per component (code and value from the component, date, patient, encounter and category from the parent); an Observation without components gives one row.
- date is effectiveDateTime (UTC); patient is subject.reference, the encounter is encounter.reference (R4) or context.reference (STU3), without the urn:uuid: prefix; category is category[0].coding[0].code.
- A valueQuantity gives type numeric, units = valueQuantity.unit and the value as text with exactly one decimal digit (163.34 is written 163.3, 71 is written 71.0). Other values give type text: the display of valueCodeableConcept.coding[0], or valueString.
- In DuckDB write (x->'$.path') IS NULL with the parentheses. Commas in text become spaces.
text:
```sql
WITH src AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        resource
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'observation') }}
)

, items AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        resource,
        resource AS item
    FROM src
    WHERE COALESCE(json_array_length(resource->'$.component'), 0) = 0

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        id,
        resource,
        UNNEST(from_json(resource->'$.component', '["JSON"]')) AS item
    FROM src
    WHERE COALESCE(json_array_length(resource->'$.component'), 0) > 0
)

, flat AS (
    SELECT
        timezone('UTC', TRY_CAST(resource->>'$.effectiveDateTime' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) AS observation_datetime,
        regexp_replace(resource->>'$.subject.reference', '^(urn:uuid:|Patient/)', '') AS patient_id,
        regexp_replace(
            COALESCE(resource->>'$.encounter.reference', resource->>'$.context.reference'),
            '^(urn:uuid:|Encounter/)', ''
        ) AS encounter_id,
        resource->>'$.category[0].coding[0].code' AS observation_category,
        item->>'$.code.coding[0].code' AS observation_code,
        item->>'$.code.coding[0].display' AS observation_description,
        (item->'$.valueQuantity') IS NULL AS no_quantity,
        TRY_CAST(item->>'$.valueQuantity.value' AS DOUBLE) AS qty_value,
        item->>'$.valueQuantity.unit' AS qty_unit,
        COALESCE(
            item->>'$.valueCodeableConcept.coding[0].display',
            item->>'$.valueCodeableConcept.text',
            item->>'$.valueString'
        ) AS text_value
    FROM items
)

SELECT
    observation_datetime::TIMESTAMP AS observation_datetime,
    CAST(observation_datetime AS DATE) AS observation_date,
    CAST(patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id,
    CAST(encounter_id AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id,
    CAST(observation_category AS VARCHAR) AS observation_category,
    CAST(observation_code AS VARCHAR) AS observation_code,
    CAST(replace(observation_description, ',', ' ') AS VARCHAR) AS observation_description,
    CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN NOT no_quantity THEN printf('%.1f', qty_value)
            ELSE replace(text_value, ',', ' ')
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS observation_value,
    CAST(
        CASE WHEN NOT no_quantity THEN replace(qty_unit, ',', ' ') ELSE NULL END
        AS VARCHAR
    ) AS observation_units,
    CAST(
        CASE WHEN NOT no_quantity THEN 'numeric' ELSE 'text' END
        AS VARCHAR
    ) AS observation_value_type
FROM flat
```

```sql
WITH src AS (

    SELECT
        id
        , resource
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'observation') }}

)

, plain_items AS (

    SELECT
        resource
        , resource AS node
    FROM src
    WHERE json_extract(resource, '$.component') IS NULL

)

, component_items AS (

    SELECT
        s.resource AS resource
        , c.value AS node
    FROM src AS s
    CROSS JOIN json_each(s.resource, '$.component') AS c

)

, items AS (

    SELECT * FROM plain_items
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM component_items

)

, extracted AS (

    SELECT
        CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.effectiveDateTime') AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS observation_datetime
        , lower(replace(json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'), 'urn:uuid:', '')) AS patient_id
        , lower(replace(json_extract_string(resource, '$.encounter.reference'), 'urn:uuid:', '')) AS encounter_id
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.category[0].coding[0].code') AS observation_category
        , json_extract_string(node, '$.code.coding[0].code') AS observation_code
        , replace(
            coalesce(
                json_extract_string(node, '$.code.coding[0].display')
                , json_extract_string(node, '$.code.text')
            )
            , ',', ' ') AS observation_description
        , json_extract_string(node, '$.valueQuantity.value') AS quantity_value
        , replace(
            coalesce(
                json_extract_string(node, '$.valueCodeableConcept.text')
                , json_extract_string(node, '$.valueCodeableConcept.coding[0].display')
                , json_extract_string(node, '$.valueString')
            )
            , ',', ' ') AS text_value
        , json_extract_string(node, '$.valueQuantity.unit') AS observation_units
    FROM items

)

SELECT
    CAST(observation_datetime AS TIMESTAMP) AS observation_datetime
    , CAST(observation_datetime AS DATE) AS observation_date
    , CAST(patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id
    , CAST(encounter_id AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id
    , CAST(observation_category AS VARCHAR) AS observation_category
    , CAST(observation_code AS VARCHAR) AS observation_code
    , CAST(observation_description AS VARCHAR) AS observation_description
    , CAST(coalesce(quantity_value, text_value) AS VARCHAR) AS observation_value
    , CAST(observation_units AS VARCHAR) AS observation_units
    , CAST(CASE WHEN quantity_value IS NOT NULL THEN 'numeric' ELSE 'text' END AS VARCHAR) AS observation_value_type
FROM extracted
```

```sql
, encounters AS (

    INNER JOIN encounters AS e
```
