## Mapping hints
- One row per value: an Observation with component[] gives one row per component (code and value from the component, date, patient, encounter and category from the parent); an Observation without components gives one row.
- date is effectiveDateTime (UTC); patient is subject.reference, the encounter is encounter.reference (R4) or context.reference (STU3), without the urn:uuid: prefix; category is category[0].coding[0].code.
- A valueQuantity gives type numeric, units = valueQuantity.unit and the value as text with exactly one decimal digit (163.34 is written 163.3, 71 is written 71.0). Other values give type text: the display of valueCodeableConcept.coding[0], or valueString.
- In DuckDB write (x->'$.path') IS NULL with the parentheses. Commas in text become spaces.
text:
```sql
WITH src AS (

    SELECT
        resource AS r
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'observation') }}
    WHERE json_extract_string(resource, '$.resourceType') = 'Observation'

)

, exploded AS (

    SELECT
        r
        , unnest(
            CASE
                WHEN coalesce(json_array_length(r->'$.component'), 0) > 0
                    THEN CAST(r->'$.component' AS JSON[])
                ELSE [CAST(NULL AS JSON)]
            END
        ) AS c
    FROM src

)

, nodes AS (

    SELECT
        r
        , CASE WHEN c IS NULL THEN r ELSE c END AS n
    FROM exploded

)

, extracted AS (

    SELECT
        json_extract_string(r, '$.effectiveDateTime') AS eff
        , json_extract_string(r, '$.subject.reference') AS patient_ref
        , coalesce(
            json_extract_string(r, '$.encounter.reference')
            , json_extract_string(r, '$.context.reference')
        ) AS encounter_ref
        , json_extract_string(r, '$.category[0].coding[0].code') AS category_code
        , json_extract_string(n, '$.code.coding[0].code') AS code_value
        , coalesce(
            json_extract_string(n, '$.code.coding[0].display')
            , json_extract_string(n, '$.code.text')
        ) AS code_display
        , (n->'$.valueQuantity') IS NOT NULL AS has_quantity
        , try_cast(json_extract_string(n, '$.valueQuantity.value') AS DOUBLE) AS qty_value
        , json_extract_string(n, '$.valueQuantity.unit') AS qty_unit
        , coalesce(
            json_extract_string(n, '$.valueCodeableConcept.coding[0].display')
            , json_extract_string(n, '$.valueString')
        ) AS text_value
    FROM nodes

)

SELECT
    CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN eff IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN length(eff) = 10 THEN CAST((eff || ' 00:00:00+00') AS TIMESTAMPTZ)
            WHEN regexp_matches(eff, '(Z|[+-][0-9][0-9](:?[0-9][0-9])?)$') THEN CAST(eff AS TIMESTAMPTZ)
            ELSE CAST((replace(eff, 'T', ' ') || '+00') AS TIMESTAMPTZ)
        END AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
        AS TIMESTAMP
    ) AS observation_datetime
    , CAST(
        CAST(
            CASE
                WHEN eff IS NULL THEN NULL
                WHEN length(eff) = 10 THEN CAST((eff || ' 00:00:00+00') AS TIMESTAMPTZ)
                WHEN regexp_matches(eff, '(Z|[+-][0-9][0-9](:?[0-9][0-9])?)$') THEN CAST(eff AS TIMESTAMPTZ)
                ELSE CAST((replace(eff, 'T', ' ') || '+00') AS TIMESTAMPTZ)
            END AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
            AS TIMESTAMP
        ) AS DATE
    ) AS observation_date
    , CAST(regexp_replace(patient_ref, '^(urn:uuid:|Patient/)', '') AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id
    , CAST(regexp_replace(encounter_ref, '^(urn:uuid:|Encounter/)', '') AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id
    , CAST(category_code AS VARCHAR) AS observation_category
    , CAST(code_value AS VARCHAR) AS observation_code
    , CAST(replace(code_display, ',', ' ') AS VARCHAR) AS observation_description
    , CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN has_quantity THEN printf('%.1f', qty_value)
            ELSE replace(text_value, ',', ' ')
        END
        AS VARCHAR
    ) AS observation_value
    , CAST(
        CASE WHEN has_quantity THEN replace(qty_unit, ',', ' ') ELSE NULL END
        AS VARCHAR
    ) AS observation_units
    , CAST(CASE WHEN has_quantity THEN 'numeric' ELSE 'text' END AS VARCHAR) AS observation_value_type
FROM extracted
```

```sql
with allergy as (

    select
        a.id as source_id,
        cast(json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.recordedDate') as timestamptz) at time zone 'UTC' as recorded_ts,
        replace(json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.patient.reference'), 'urn:uuid:', '') as patient_id,
        json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') as allergy_code,
        json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.coding[0].system') as code_system_uri,
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.coding[0].display'),
            json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.text')
        ) as allergy_description,
        lower(json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.type')) as allergy_type,
        lower(json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.category[0]')) as allergy_category,
        json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].code') as reaction_1_code,
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].display'),
            json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].text')
        ) as reaction_1_description,
        upper(json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.reaction[0].severity')) as reaction_1_severity,
        json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].coding[0].code') as reaction_2_code,
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].coding[0].display'),
            json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].text')
        ) as reaction_2_description,
        upper(json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.reaction[1].severity')) as reaction_2_severity
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'allergyintolerance') }} as a

),

enc as (

    select
        e.id as encounter_id,
        replace(json_extract_string(e.resource, '$.subject.reference'), 'urn:uuid:', '') as patient_id,
        cast(json_extract_string(e.resource, '$.period.start') as timestamptz) at time zone 'UTC' as start_ts
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'encounter') }} as e

),

matched as (

    select
        al.source_id,
        en.encounter_id,
        row_number() over (
            partition by al.source_id
            order by abs(epoch(al.recorded_ts) - epoch(en.start_ts)), en.encounter_id
        ) as rn
    from allergy as al
    join enc as en
        on en.patient_id = al.patient_id
        and cast(en.start_ts as date) = cast(al.recorded_ts as date)

)

select
    cast(al.recorded_ts as date) as allergy_start_date,
    cast(null as date) as allergy_stop_date,
    cast(al.patient_id as varchar) as patient_id,
    cast(m.encounter_id as varchar) as encounter_id,
    cast(al.allergy_code as varchar) as allergy_code,
    cast(case al.code_system_uri
        when 'http://snomed.info/sct' then 'SNOMED-CT'
        when 'http://www.nlm.nih.gov/research/umls/rxnorm' then 'RxNorm'
        else al.code_system_uri
    end as varchar) as allergy_code_system,
    cast(al.allergy_description as varchar) as allergy_description,
    cast(al.allergy_type as varchar) as allergy_type,
    cast(al.allergy_category as varchar) as allergy_category,
    cast(al.reaction_1_code as varchar) as reaction_1_code,
    cast(al.reaction_1_description as varchar) as reaction_1_description,
    cast(al.reaction_1_severity as varchar) as reaction_1_severity,
    cast(al.reaction_2_code as varchar) as reaction_2_code,
    cast(al.reaction_2_description as varchar) as reaction_2_description,
    cast(al.reaction_2_severity as varchar) as reaction_2_severity
from allergy as al
left join matched as m
    on m.source_id = al.source_id
    and m.rn = 1
```

```sql
WITH allergies AS (

    SELECT
        id AS allergy_resource_id
        , regexp_replace(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.patient.reference')
            , '^(urn:uuid:|Patient/)'
            , ''
        ) AS patient_id
        , CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.recordedDate') AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AS recorded_ts
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') AS allergy_code
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].system') AS raw_system
        , coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display')
            , json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text')
        ) AS allergy_description
        , lower(json_extract_string(resource, '$.type')) AS allergy_type
        , lower(json_extract_string(resource, '$.category[0]')) AS allergy_category
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].code') AS reaction_1_code
        , coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].display')
            , json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].text')
        ) AS reaction_1_description
        , upper(json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[0].severity')) AS reaction_1_severity
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].coding[0].code') AS reaction_2_code
        , coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].coding[0].display')
            , json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].text')
        ) AS reaction_2_description
        , upper(json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[1].severity')) AS reaction_2_severity
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'allergyintolerance') }}

)

, encounters AS (

    SELECT
        id AS encounter_id
        , regexp_replace(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference')
            , '^(urn:uuid:|Patient/)'
            , ''
        ) AS patient_id
        , CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start') AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AS start_ts
        , CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.end') AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AS end_ts
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'encounter') }}

)

, matched AS (

    SELECT
        a.allergy_resource_id
        , e.encounter_id
        , row_number() OVER (
            PARTITION BY a.allergy_resource_id
            ORDER BY
                CASE WHEN e.start_ts = a.recorded_ts THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
                , e.start_ts DESC
                , e.encounter_id
        ) AS rn
    FROM allergies AS a
    INNER JOIN encounters AS e
        ON a.patient_id = e.patient_id
        AND a.recorded_ts >= e.start_ts
        AND a.recorded_ts <= coalesce(e.end_ts, e.start_ts)

)

SELECT
    CAST((a.recorded_ts AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS allergy_start_date
    , CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS allergy_stop_date
    , CAST(a.patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id
    , CAST(m.encounter_id AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id
    , CAST(a.allergy_code AS VARCHAR) AS allergy_code
    , CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN lower(a.raw_system) LIKE '%snomed%' THEN 'SNOMED-CT'
            WHEN lower(a.raw_system) LIKE '%rxnorm%' THEN 'RxNorm'
            ELSE a.raw_system
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS allergy_code_system
    , CAST(a.allergy_description AS VARCHAR) AS allergy_description
    , CAST(a.allergy_type AS VARCHAR) AS allergy_type
    , CAST(a.allergy_category AS VARCHAR) AS allergy_category
    , CAST(a.reaction_1_code AS VARCHAR) AS reaction_1_code
    , CAST(a.reaction_1_description AS VARCHAR) AS reaction_1_description
    , CAST(a.reaction_1_severity AS VARCHAR) AS reaction_1_severity
    , CAST(a.reaction_2_code AS VARCHAR) AS reaction_2_code
    , CAST(a.reaction_2_description AS VARCHAR) AS reaction_2_description
    , CAST(a.reaction_2_severity AS VARCHAR) AS reaction_2_severity
FROM allergies AS a
LEFT JOIN matched AS m
    ON a.allergy_resource_id = m.allergy_resource_id
    AND m.rn = 1
```

## Mapping hints
- start date is the first 10 characters of recordedDate (R4) or assertedDate (STU3); there is no stop date.
- patient is patient.reference without the urn:uuid: prefix. The resource has no encounter reference: use the patient's Encounter whose period.start equals that timestamp.
- code and description are code.coding[0]; system is SNOMED-CT or RxNorm according to the coding system URL; type is type; category is category[0].
- reaction 1 and 2 are reaction[0] and reaction[1]: manifestation[0].coding[0].code and .display, severity in upper case. Commas in text become spaces.
text:
```sql
WITH allergy_raw AS (

    SELECT
        id AS source_id
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.recordedDate') AS recorded_date
        , replace(json_extract_string(resource, '$.patient.reference'), 'urn:uuid:', '') AS patient_id
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') AS allergy_code
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].system') AS code_system_url
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display') AS allergy_description
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.type') AS allergy_type
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.category[0]') AS allergy_category
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].code') AS reaction_1_code
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].display') AS reaction_1_description
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[0].severity') AS reaction_1_severity
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].coding[0].code') AS reaction_2_code
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].coding[0].display') AS reaction_2_description
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[1].severity') AS reaction_2_severity
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'allergyintolerance') }}

)

, allergy_ts AS (

    SELECT
        *
        , CASE
            WHEN length(recorded_date) > 10 THEN CAST(recorded_date AS TIMESTAMPTZ)
        END AS recorded_ts
    FROM allergy_raw

)

, encounter_raw AS (

    SELECT
        id AS encounter_id
        , replace(json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'), 'urn:uuid:', '') AS patient_id
        , CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start') AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AS start_ts
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'encounter') }}

)

, encounter_dedup AS (

    SELECT
        patient_id
        , start_ts
        , min(encounter_id) AS encounter_id
    FROM encounter_raw
    WHERE start_ts IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY patient_id, start_ts

)

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN a.recorded_ts IS NOT NULL
            THEN CAST((a.recorded_ts AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)
        ELSE CAST(substr(a.recorded_date, 1, 10) AS DATE)
    END AS allergy_start_date
    , CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS allergy_stop_date
    , CAST(a.patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id
    , CAST(e.encounter_id AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id
    , CAST(a.allergy_code AS VARCHAR) AS allergy_code
    , CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN a.code_system_url = 'http://snomed.info/sct' THEN 'SNOMED-CT'
            WHEN a.code_system_url = 'http://www.nlm.nih.gov/research/umls/rxnorm' THEN 'RxNorm'
            ELSE a.code_system_url
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS allergy_code_system
    , CAST(replace(a.allergy_description, ',', ' ') AS VARCHAR) AS allergy_description
    , CAST(a.allergy_type AS VARCHAR) AS allergy_type
    , CAST(a.allergy_category AS VARCHAR) AS allergy_category
    , CAST(a.reaction_1_code AS VARCHAR) AS reaction_1_code
    , CAST(replace(a.reaction_1_description, ',', ' ') AS VARCHAR) AS reaction_1_description
    , CAST(upper(a.reaction_1_severity) AS VARCHAR) AS reaction_1_severity
    , CAST(a.reaction_2_code AS VARCHAR) AS reaction_2_code
    , CAST(replace(a.reaction_2_description, ',', ' ') AS VARCHAR) AS reaction_2_description
    , CAST(upper(a.reaction_2_severity) AS VARCHAR) AS reaction_2_severity
FROM allergy_ts AS a
LEFT JOIN encounter_dedup AS e
    ON a.patient_id = e.patient_id
    AND a.recorded_ts = e.start_ts
```

```sql
WITH allergy AS (

    SELECT
        id AS resource_id
        , replace(json_extract_string(resource, '$.patient.reference'), 'urn:uuid:', '') AS patient_id
        , CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.recordedDate') AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS recorded_ts
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].system') AS code_system_raw
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') AS allergy_code
        , coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display')
            , json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text')
        ) AS allergy_description
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.type') AS allergy_type
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.category[0]') AS allergy_category
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].code') AS reaction_1_code
        , coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].display')
            , json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].text')
        ) AS reaction_1_description
        , upper(json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[0].severity')) AS reaction_1_severity
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].coding[0].code') AS reaction_2_code
        , coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].coding[0].display')
            , json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].text')
        ) AS reaction_2_description
        , upper(json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[1].severity')) AS reaction_2_severity
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'allergyintolerance') }}
    WHERE json_extract_string(resource, '$.resourceType') = 'AllergyIntolerance'

)

, encounter AS (

    SELECT
        id AS encounter_id
        , replace(json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'), 'urn:uuid:', '') AS patient_id
        , CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start') AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS start_ts
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'encounter') }}
    WHERE json_extract_string(resource, '$.resourceType') = 'Encounter'

)

, matched AS (

    SELECT
        a.*
        , e.encounter_id
        , row_number() OVER (
            PARTITION BY a.resource_id
            ORDER BY e.encounter_id
        ) AS rn
    FROM allergy AS a
    LEFT JOIN encounter AS e
        ON a.patient_id = e.patient_id
        AND a.recorded_ts = e.start_ts

)

SELECT
    CAST(recorded_ts AS DATE) AS allergy_start_date
    , CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS allergy_stop_date
    , CAST(patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id
    , CAST(encounter_id AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id
    , CAST(allergy_code AS VARCHAR) AS allergy_code
    , CAST(
        CASE code_system_raw
            WHEN 'http://snomed.info/sct' THEN 'SNOMED-CT'
            WHEN 'http://www.nlm.nih.gov/research/umls/rxnorm' THEN 'RxNorm'
            ELSE code_system_raw
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS allergy_code_system
    , CAST(allergy_description AS VARCHAR) AS allergy_description
    , CAST(allergy_type AS VARCHAR) AS allergy_type
    , CAST(allergy_category AS VARCHAR) AS allergy_category
    , CAST(reaction_1_code AS VARCHAR) AS reaction_1_code
    , CAST(reaction_1_description AS VARCHAR) AS reaction_1_description
    , CAST(reaction_1_severity AS VARCHAR) AS reaction_1_severity
    , CAST(reaction_2_code AS VARCHAR) AS reaction_2_code
    , CAST(reaction_2_description AS VARCHAR) AS reaction_2_description
    , CAST(reaction_2_severity AS VARCHAR) AS reaction_2_severity
FROM matched
WHERE rn = 1
```

- start date is the first 10 characters of recordedDate (R4) or assertedDate (STU3); there is no stop date.
- patient is patient.reference without the urn:uuid: prefix. The resource has no encounter reference: use the patient's Encounter whose period.start equals that timestamp.
- code and description are code.coding[0]; system is SNOMED-CT or RxNorm according to the coding system URL; type is type; category is category[0].
- reaction 1 and 2 are reaction[0] and reaction[1]: manifestation[0].coding[0].code and .display, severity in upper case. Commas in text become spaces.

```sql
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.recordedDate') AS recorded_date

        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].system') AS code_system_url
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display') AS allergy_description
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.type') AS allergy_type
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.category[0]') AS allergy_category
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].code') AS reaction_1_code
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].display') AS reaction_1_description
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[0].severity') AS reaction_1_severity
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].coding[0].code') AS reaction_2_code
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].coding[0].display') AS reaction_2_description
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[1].severity') AS reaction_2_severity
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'allergyintolerance') }}

)

, encounters AS (

    SELECT
        replace(json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'), 'urn:uuid:', '') AS patient_id
        , CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start') AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AS start_ts
        , min(id) AS encounter_id
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'encounter') }}
    GROUP BY 1, 2

SELECT
    CAST(CAST(CAST(a.recorded_date AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS allergy_start_date
    , CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS allergy_stop_date
    , CAST(a.patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id
    , CAST(e.encounter_id AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id
    , CAST(a.allergy_code AS VARCHAR) AS allergy_code
    , CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN lower(a.code_system_url) LIKE '%snomed%' THEN 'SNOMED-CT'
            WHEN lower(a.code_system_url) LIKE '%rxnorm%' THEN 'RxNorm'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS VARCHAR) AS allergy_code_system
    , CAST(replace(a.allergy_description, ',', ' ') AS VARCHAR) AS allergy_description
    , CAST(a.allergy_type AS VARCHAR) AS allergy_type
    , CAST(a.allergy_category AS VARCHAR) AS allergy_category
    , CAST(a.reaction_1_code AS VARCHAR) AS reaction_1_code
    , CAST(replace(a.reaction_1_description, ',', ' ') AS VARCHAR) AS reaction_1_description
    , CAST(upper(a.reaction_1_severity) AS VARCHAR) AS reaction_1_severity
    , CAST(a.reaction_2_code AS VARCHAR) AS reaction_2_code
    , CAST(replace(a.reaction_2_description, ',', ' ') AS VARCHAR) AS reaction_2_description
    , CAST(upper(a.reaction_2_severity) AS VARCHAR) AS reaction_2_severity
FROM allergies AS a
LEFT JOIN encounters AS e
    ON e.patient_id = a.patient_id
    AND e.start_ts = CAST(a.recorded_date AS TIMESTAMPTZ)
```

```sql
WITH parsed AS (

    SELECT
        id AS raw_id
        , json_transform(
            resource
            , '{
                "id":"VARCHAR",
                "birthDate":"VARCHAR",
                "deceasedDateTime":"VARCHAR",
                "gender":"VARCHAR",
                "identifier":[{"type":{"coding":[{"code":"VARCHAR"}]},"value":"VARCHAR"}],
                "name":[{"use":"VARCHAR","family":"VARCHAR","given":["VARCHAR"],"prefix":["VARCHAR"],"suffix":["VARCHAR"]}],
                "address":[{"line":["VARCHAR"],"city":"VARCHAR","state":"VARCHAR","postalCode":"VARCHAR","extension":[{"url":"VARCHAR","extension":[{"url":"VARCHAR","valueDecimal":"DOUBLE"}]}]}],
                "maritalStatus":{"coding":[{"code":"VARCHAR"}]},
                "extension":[{"url":"VARCHAR","valueAddress":{"city":"VARCHAR","state":"VARCHAR","country":"VARCHAR"},"extension":[{"url":"VARCHAR","valueCoding":{"code":"VARCHAR"},"valueString":"VARCHAR"}]}]
            }'
        ) AS r
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'patient') }}

)

, extracted AS (

    SELECT
        coalesce(r.id, raw_id) AS patient_id
        , r.birthDate AS birth_raw
        , r.deceasedDateTime AS death_raw
        , r.gender AS gender_raw
        , list_filter(r.identifier, x -> x."type".coding[1].code = 'SB')[1].value AS ssn
        , list_filter(r.identifier, x -> x."type".coding[1].code = 'DL')[1].value AS drivers_license_number
        , list_filter(r.identifier, x -> x."type".coding[1].code = 'PPN')[1].value AS passport_number
        , coalesce(
            list_filter(r.name, n -> n.use = 'official')[1]
            , r.name[1]
        ) AS official_name
        , list_filter(r.name, n -> n.use = 'maiden')[1] AS maiden_name_rec
        , r.maritalStatus.coding[1].code AS marital_status
        , list_filter(r.extension, e -> e.url LIKE '%us-core-race')[1].extension AS race_ext
        , list_filter(r.extension, e -> e.url LIKE '%us-core-ethnicity')[1].extension AS eth_ext
        , list_filter(r.extension, e -> e.url LIKE '%birthPlace')[1].valueAddress AS birth_addr
        , r.address[1] AS addr
        , list_filter(r.address[1].extension, e -> e.url LIKE '%geolocation')[1].extension AS geo_ext
    FROM parsed

)

, shaped AS (

    SELECT
        patient_id
        , CASE
            WHEN birth_raw IS NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE CAST(left(birth_raw, 10) AS DATE)
          END AS birth_date
        , CASE
            WHEN death_raw IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN length(death_raw) <= 10 THEN CAST(death_raw AS DATE)
            ELSE CAST(CAST(death_raw AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS DATE)
          END AS death_date
        , ssn
        , drivers_license_number
        , passport_number
        , official_name.prefix[1] AS patient_prefix
        , official_name.given[1] AS patient_first_name
        , official_name.family AS patient_last_name
        , official_name.suffix[1] AS patient_suffix
        , maiden_name_rec.family AS maiden_name
        , marital_status
        , CASE list_filter(race_ext, e -> e.url = 'ombCategory')[1].valueCoding.code
            WHEN '2106-3' THEN 'white'
            WHEN '2054-5' THEN 'black'
            WHEN '2028-9' THEN 'asian'
            WHEN '1002-5' THEN 'native'
            WHEN '2076-8' THEN 'hawaiian'
            WHEN '2131-1' THEN 'other'
            ELSE lower(list_filter(race_ext, e -> e.url = 'text')[1].valueString)
          END AS race
        , CASE list_filter(eth_ext, e -> e.url = 'ombCategory')[1].valueCoding.code
            WHEN '2186-5' THEN 'nonhispanic'
            WHEN '2135-2' THEN 'hispanic'
            ELSE replace(lower(list_filter(eth_ext, e -> e.url = 'text')[1].valueString), ' ', '')
          END AS ethnicity
        , CASE lower(gender_raw)
            WHEN 'male' THEN 'M'
            WHEN 'female' THEN 'F'
            ELSE NULL
          END AS patient_gender
        , CASE
            WHEN birth_addr IS NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE concat_ws('  ', birth_addr.city, birth_addr.state, birth_addr.country)
          END AS birthplace
        , addr.line[1] AS patient_address
        , addr.city AS patient_city
        , addr.state AS state_raw
        , addr.postalCode AS patient_zip
        , CAST(list_filter(geo_ext, e -> e.url = 'latitude')[1].valueDecimal AS FLOAT) AS patient_latitude
        , CAST(list_filter(geo_ext, e -> e.url = 'longitude')[1].valueDecimal AS FLOAT) AS patient_longitude
    FROM extracted

)

SELECT
    s.patient_id AS patient_id
    , s.birth_date AS birth_date
    , s.death_date AS death_date
    , s.ssn AS ssn
    , s.drivers_license_number AS drivers_license_number
    , s.passport_number AS passport_number
    , s.patient_prefix AS patient_prefix
    , s.patient_first_name AS patient_first_name
    , s.patient_last_name AS patient_last_name
    , s.patient_suffix AS patient_suffix
    , s.maiden_name AS maiden_name
    , s.marital_status AS marital_status
    , s.race AS race
    , s.ethnicity AS ethnicity
    , s.patient_gender AS patient_gender
    , s.birthplace AS birthplace
    , s.patient_address AS patient_address
    , s.patient_city AS patient_city
    , coalesce(m.state_name, s.state_raw) AS patient_state
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS patient_county
    , s.patient_zip AS patient_zip
    , s.patient_latitude AS patient_latitude
    , s.patient_longitude AS patient_longitude
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS healthcare_expenses
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS healthcare_coverage
FROM shaped AS s
LEFT JOIN {{ ref('stg_map__states') }} AS m
    ON upper(s.state_raw) = upper(m.state_abbreviation)
```

```sql
with src as (

    select
        coalesce(json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'), id) as patient_id
        , resource
        , from_json(json_extract(resource, '$.name'), '["JSON"]') as names
        , from_json(json_extract(resource, '$.identifier'), '["JSON"]') as identifiers
        , from_json(json_extract(resource, '$.extension'), '["JSON"]') as exts
        , json_extract(resource, '$.address[0]') as addr
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'patient') }}
    where coalesce(json_extract_string(resource, '$.resourceType'), 'Patient') = 'Patient'

)

, parsed as (

    select
        patient_id
        , resource
        , addr
        , list_filter(names, x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.use') = 'official')[1] as official_name
        , list_filter(names, x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.use') = 'maiden')[1] as maiden_name_obj
        , list_filter(identifiers, x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.type.coding[0].code') = 'SB')[1] as ssn_obj
        , list_filter(identifiers, x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.type.coding[0].code') = 'DL')[1] as dl_obj
        , list_filter(identifiers, x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.type.coding[0].code') = 'PPN')[1] as ppn_obj
        , list_filter(exts, x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.url') like '%us-core-race')[1] as race_ext
        , list_filter(exts, x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.url') like '%us-core-ethnicity')[1] as eth_ext
        , list_filter(exts, x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.url') like '%birthPlace')[1] as bp_ext
        , list_filter(
            from_json(json_extract(addr, '$.extension'), '["JSON"]')
            , x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.url') like '%geolocation'
        )[1] as geo_ext
    from src

)

, parsed2 as (

    select
        *
        , list_filter(
            from_json(json_extract(race_ext, '$.extension'), '["JSON"]')
            , y -> json_extract_string(y, '$.url') = 'ombCategory'
        )[1] as race_omb
        , list_filter(
            from_json(json_extract(race_ext, '$.extension'), '["JSON"]')
            , y -> json_extract_string(y, '$.url') = 'text'
        )[1] as race_txt
        , list_filter(
            from_json(json_extract(eth_ext, '$.extension'), '["JSON"]')
            , y -> json_extract_string(y, '$.url') = 'ombCategory'
        )[1] as eth_omb
        , list_filter(
            from_json(json_extract(eth_ext, '$.extension'), '["JSON"]')
            , y -> json_extract_string(y, '$.url') = 'text'
        )[1] as eth_txt
        , list_filter(
            from_json(json_extract(geo_ext, '$.extension'), '["JSON"]')
            , y -> json_extract_string(y, '$.url') = 'latitude'
        )[1] as lat_obj
        , list_filter(
            from_json(json_extract(geo_ext, '$.extension'), '["JSON"]')
            , y -> json_extract_string(y, '$.url') = 'longitude'
        )[1] as lon_obj
    from parsed

)

, fields as (

    select
        patient_id
        , try_cast(json_extract_string(resource, '$.birthDate') as date) as birth_date
        , coalesce(
            try_cast(
                (try_cast(json_extract_string(resource, '$.deceasedDateTime') as timestamptz) at time zone 'UTC') as date
            )
            , try_cast(json_extract_string(resource, '$.deceasedDateTime') as date)
        ) as death_date
        , json_extract_string(ssn_obj, '$.value') as ssn
        , json_extract_string(dl_obj, '$.value') as drivers_license_number
        , json_extract_string(ppn_obj, '$.value') as passport_number
        , json_extract_string(official_name, '$.prefix[0]') as patient_prefix
        , json_extract_string(official_name, '$.given[0]') as patient_first_name
        , json_extract_string(official_name, '$.family') as patient_last_name
        , json_extract_string(official_name, '$.suffix[0]') as patient_suffix
        , json_extract_string(maiden_name_obj, '$.family') as maiden_name
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.maritalStatus.coding[0].code') as marital_status
        , case json_extract_string(race_omb, '$.valueCoding.code')
            when '2106-3' then 'white'
            when '2054-5' then 'black'
            when '2028-9' then 'asian'
            when '1002-5' then 'native'
            when '2076-8' then 'hawaiian'
            when '2131-1' then 'other'
            else case lower(coalesce(json_extract_string(race_txt, '$.valueString'), json_extract_string(race_omb, '$.valueCoding.display')))
                when 'white' then 'white'
                when 'black or african american' then 'black'
                when 'asian' then 'asian'
                when 'american indian or alaska native' then 'native'
                when 'native hawaiian or other pacific islander' then 'hawaiian'
                when 'other' then 'other'
            end
        end as race
        , case json_extract_string(eth_omb, '$.valueCoding.code')
            when '2186-5' then 'nonhispanic'
            when '2135-2' then 'hispanic'
            else case lower(coalesce(json_extract_string(eth_txt, '$.valueString'), json_extract_string(eth_omb, '$.valueCoding.display')))
                when 'not hispanic or latino' then 'nonhispanic'
                when 'hispanic or latino' then 'hispanic'
            end
        end as ethnicity
        , case lower(json_extract_string(resource, '$.gender'))
            when 'male' then 'M'
            when 'female' then 'F'
        end as patient_gender
        , json_extract_string(bp_ext, '$.valueAddress.city') as bp_city
        , json_extract_string(bp_ext, '$.valueAddress.state') as bp_state
        , json_extract_string(bp_ext, '$.valueAddress.country') as bp_country
        , json_extract_string(addr, '$.line[0]') as patient_address
        , json_extract_string(addr, '$.city') as patient_city
        , json_extract_string(addr, '$.state') as addr_state
        , json_extract_string(addr, '$.postalCode') as patient_zip
        , try_cast(json_extract_string(lat_obj, '$.valueDecimal') as float) as patient_latitude
        , try_cast(json_extract_string(lon_obj, '$.valueDecimal') as float) as patient_longitude
    from parsed2

)

    , f.birth_date::date as birth_date
    , f.death_date::date as death_date
    , f.ssn::varchar as ssn
    , f.drivers_license_number::varchar as drivers_license_number

    , f.patient_prefix::varchar as patient_prefix

    , f.marital_status::varchar as marital_status
    , f.race::varchar as race
    , f.ethnicity::varchar as ethnicity

    , case

    , f.patient_latitude::float as patient_latitude

    , cast(null as float) as healthcare_expenses

from fields as f
left join {{ ref('stg_map__states') }} as s

left join {{ ref('stg_map__states') }} as bs
```

```sql
with src as (

    select
        id as source_id,
        json_transform(
            resource,
            '{
              "id": "VARCHAR",
              "identifier": [ {"type": {"coding": [ {"code": "VARCHAR"} ] }, "value": "VARCHAR"} ],
              "name": [ {"use": "VARCHAR", "family": "VARCHAR", "given": ["VARCHAR"], "prefix": ["VARCHAR"], "suffix": ["VARCHAR"]} ],
              "extension": [ {
                  "url": "VARCHAR",
                  "valueCode": "VARCHAR",
                  "valueAddress": {"city": "VARCHAR", "state": "VARCHAR", "country": "VARCHAR"},
                  "extension": [ {"url": "VARCHAR", "valueString": "VARCHAR", "valueCoding": {"code": "VARCHAR", "display": "VARCHAR"} } ]
              } ],
              "gender": "VARCHAR",
              "birthDate": "VARCHAR",
              "deceasedDateTime": "VARCHAR",
              "address": [ {
                  "line": ["VARCHAR"],
                  "city": "VARCHAR",
                  "state": "VARCHAR",
                  "postalCode": "VARCHAR",
                  "extension": [ {"url": "VARCHAR", "extension": [ {"url": "VARCHAR", "valueDecimal": "DOUBLE"} ] } ]
              } ],
              "maritalStatus": {"coding": [ {"code": "VARCHAR"} ], "text": "VARCHAR"}
            }'
        ) as r
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'patient') }}

),

picked as (

    select
        coalesce(source_id, r.id) as patient_id,
        r.birthDate as birth_raw,
        r.deceasedDateTime as death_raw,
        r.gender as gender_raw,
        r.maritalStatus as marital_raw,

        list_filter(r.identifier, i -> list_contains(list_transform(i.type.coding, c -> c.code), 'SB'))[1].value as ssn,
        list_filter(r.identifier, i -> list_contains(list_transform(i.type.coding, c -> c.code), 'DL'))[1].value as drivers_license_number,
        list_filter(r.identifier, i -> list_contains(list_transform(i.type.coding, c -> c.code), 'PPN'))[1].value as passport_number,

        coalesce(list_filter(r.name, n -> n.use = 'official')[1], r.name[1]) as official_name,
        list_filter(r.name, n -> n.use = 'maiden')[1] as maiden_name_rec,

        list_filter(r.extension, e -> e.url like '%us-core-race')[1].extension as race_ext,
        list_filter(r.extension, e -> e.url like '%us-core-ethnicity')[1].extension as eth_ext,
        list_filter(r.extension, e -> e.url like '%us-core-birthsex')[1].valueCode as birthsex,
        list_filter(r.extension, e -> e.url like '%birthPlace')[1].valueAddress as birth_addr,

        r.address[1] as addr
    from src

),

shaped as (

    select
        patient_id,
        birth_raw,
        death_raw,
        gender_raw,
        marital_raw,
        ssn,
        drivers_license_number,
        passport_number,
        official_name,
        maiden_name_rec,
        birthsex,
        birth_addr,
        addr,
        list_filter(race_ext, x -> x.url = 'ombCategory')[1].valueCoding as race_coding,
        list_filter(race_ext, x -> x.url = 'text')[1].valueString as race_text,
        list_filter(eth_ext, x -> x.url = 'ombCategory')[1].valueCoding as eth_coding,
        list_filter(eth_ext, x -> x.url = 'text')[1].valueString as eth_text,
        list_filter(addr.extension, e -> e.url like '%geolocation')[1].extension as geo
    from picked

),

final_cols as (

    select
        lower(trim(patient_id)) as patient_id,

        try_cast(birth_raw as date) as birth_date,

        case
            when death_raw is null then null
            when length(trim(death_raw)) <= 10 then try_cast(trim(death_raw) as date)
            else cast(try_cast(death_raw as timestamptz) at time zone 'UTC' as date)
        end as death_date,

        ssn,
        drivers_license_number,
        passport_number,

        official_name.prefix[1] as patient_prefix,
        array_to_string(official_name.given, ' ') as patient_first_name,
        official_name.family as patient_last_name,
        official_name.suffix[1] as patient_suffix,
        maiden_name_rec.family as maiden_name,

        coalesce(marital_raw.coding[1].code, marital_raw.text) as marital_status,

        case race_coding.code
            when '2106-3' then 'white'
            when '2054-5' then 'black'
            when '2028-9' then 'asian'
            when '1002-5' then 'native'
            when '2076-8' then 'hawaiian'
            when '2131-1' then 'other'
            else case lower(coalesce(race_coding.display, race_text))
                when 'white' then 'white'
                when 'black or african american' then 'black'
                when 'asian' then 'asian'
                when 'american indian or alaska native' then 'native'
                when 'native hawaiian or other pacific islander' then 'hawaiian'
                when 'other' then 'other'
                else lower(coalesce(race_coding.display, race_text))
            end
        end as race,

        case eth_coding.code
            when '2186-5' then 'nonhispanic'
            when '2135-2' then 'hispanic'
            else case lower(coalesce(eth_coding.display, eth_text))
                when 'not hispanic or latino' then 'nonhispanic'
                when 'hispanic or latino' then 'hispanic'
                else lower(coalesce(eth_coding.display, eth_text))
            end
        end as ethnicity,

        case lower(coalesce(gender_raw, birthsex))
            when 'male' then 'M'
            when 'female' then 'F'
            when 'm' then 'M'
            when 'f' then 'F'
            else upper(coalesce(birthsex, gender_raw))
        end as patient_gender,

        case
            when birth_addr is null then null
            else concat_ws('  ', birth_addr.city, birth_addr.state, birth_addr.country)
        end as birthplace,

        array_to_string(addr.line, ' ') as patient_address,
        addr.city as patient_city,
        addr.state as raw_state,
        cast(null as varchar) as patient_county,
        addr.postalCode as patient_zip,

        cast(list_filter(geo, g -> g.url = 'latitude')[1].valueDecimal as float) as patient_latitude,
        cast(list_filter(geo, g -> g.url = 'longitude')[1].valueDecimal as float) as patient_longitude
    from shaped
```

```sql
WITH src AS (

    SELECT
        lower(coalesce(json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'), id)) AS patient_id
        , resource
        , from_json(json_extract(resource, '$.extension'), '["JSON"]') AS ext
        , from_json(json_extract(resource, '$.identifier'), '["JSON"]') AS ids
        , from_json(json_extract(resource, '$.name'), '["JSON"]') AS names
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'patient') }}
    WHERE coalesce(json_extract_string(resource, '$.resourceType'), 'Patient') = 'Patient'

)

, parts AS (

    SELECT
        patient_id
        , resource
        , list_filter(ext, x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.url') LIKE '%us-core-race')[1] AS race_ext
        , list_filter(ext, x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.url') LIKE '%us-core-ethnicity')[1] AS eth_ext
        , list_filter(ext, x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.url') LIKE '%birthPlace')[1] AS bp_ext
        , list_filter(ids, i -> json_extract_string(i, '$.type.coding[0].code') = 'SB')[1] AS ssn_id
        , list_filter(ids, i -> json_extract_string(i, '$.type.coding[0].code') = 'DL')[1] AS dl_id
        , list_filter(ids, i -> json_extract_string(i, '$.type.coding[0].code') = 'PPN')[1] AS ppn_id
        , coalesce(
            list_filter(names, n -> json_extract_string(n, '$.use') = 'official')[1]
            , names[1]
        ) AS official_name
        , list_filter(names, n -> json_extract_string(n, '$.use') = 'maiden')[1] AS maiden_nm
        , json_extract(resource, '$.address[0]') AS addr
    FROM src

)

, parts2 AS (

    SELECT
        p.*
        , list_filter(
            from_json(json_extract(race_ext, '$.extension'), '["JSON"]')
            , x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.url') = 'ombCategory'
        )[1] AS race_cat
        , list_filter(
            from_json(json_extract(eth_ext, '$.extension'), '["JSON"]')
            , x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.url') = 'ombCategory'
        )[1] AS eth_cat
        , list_filter(
            from_json(json_extract(addr, '$.extension'), '["JSON"]')
            , x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.url') LIKE '%geolocation'
        )[1] AS geo_ext
    FROM parts AS p

)

, parts3 AS (

    SELECT
        p.*
        , list_filter(
            from_json(json_extract(geo_ext, '$.extension'), '["JSON"]')
            , x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.url') = 'latitude'
        )[1] AS lat_ext
        , list_filter(
            from_json(json_extract(geo_ext, '$.extension'), '["JSON"]')
            , x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.url') = 'longitude'
        )[1] AS lon_ext
    FROM parts2 AS p

)

, flat AS (

    SELECT
        patient_id
        , try_cast(json_extract_string(resource, '$.birthDate') AS DATE) AS birth_date
        , CASE
            WHEN json_extract_string(resource, '$.deceasedDateTime') IS NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE CAST(
                timezone('UTC', try_cast(json_extract_string(resource, '$.deceasedDateTime') AS TIMESTAMPTZ))
                AS DATE)
          END AS death_date
        , json_extract_string(ssn_id, '$.value') AS ssn
        , json_extract_string(dl_id, '$.value') AS drivers_license_number
        , json_extract_string(ppn_id, '$.value') AS passport_number
        , json_extract_string(official_name, '$.prefix[0]') AS patient_prefix
        , json_extract_string(official_name, '$.given[0]') AS patient_first_name
        , json_extract_string(official_name, '$.family') AS patient_last_name
        , json_extract_string(official_name, '$.suffix[0]') AS patient_suffix
        , json_extract_string(maiden_nm, '$.family') AS maiden_name
        , coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.maritalStatus.coding[0].code')
            , json_extract_string(resource, '$.maritalStatus.text')
          ) AS marital_status
        , CASE json_extract_string(race_cat, '$.valueCoding.code')
            WHEN '2106-3' THEN 'white'
            WHEN '2054-5' THEN 'black'
            WHEN '2028-9' THEN 'asian'
            WHEN '1002-5' THEN 'native'
            WHEN '2076-8' THEN 'hawaiian'
            WHEN '2131-1' THEN 'other'
            ELSE lower(json_extract_string(race_cat, '$.valueCoding.display'))
          END AS race
        , CASE json_extract_string(eth_cat, '$.valueCoding.code')
            WHEN '2186-5' THEN 'nonhispanic'
            WHEN '2135-2' THEN 'hispanic'
            ELSE NULL
          END AS ethnicity
        , CASE lower(json_extract_string(resource, '$.gender'))
            WHEN 'male' THEN 'M'
            WHEN 'female' THEN 'F'
            ELSE NULL
          END AS patient_gender
        , concat_ws(
            '  '
            , json_extract_string(bp_ext, '$.valueAddress.city')
            , json_extract_string(bp_ext, '$.valueAddress.state')
            , json_extract_string(bp_ext, '$.valueAddress.country')
          ) AS birthplace
        , json_extract_string(addr, '$.line[0]') AS patient_address
        , json_extract_string(addr, '$.city') AS patient_city
        , json_extract_string(addr, '$.state') AS raw_state
        , json_extract_string(addr, '$.postalCode') AS patient_zip
        , try_cast(json_extract_string(lat_ext, '$.valueDecimal') AS FLOAT) AS patient_latitude
        , try_cast(json_extract_string(lon_ext, '$.valueDecimal') AS FLOAT) AS patient_longitude
    FROM parts3

)

SELECT
    f.patient_id::VARCHAR AS patient_id
    , f.birth_date::DATE AS birth_date
    , f.death_date::DATE AS death_date
    , f.ssn::VARCHAR AS ssn
    , f.drivers_license_number::VARCHAR AS drivers_license_number
    , f.passport_number::VARCHAR AS passport_number
    , f.patient_prefix::VARCHAR AS patient_prefix
    , f.patient_first_name::VARCHAR AS patient_first_name
    , f.patient_last_name::VARCHAR AS patient_last_name
    , f.patient_suffix::VARCHAR AS patient_suffix
    , f.maiden_name::VARCHAR AS maiden_name
    , f.marital_status::VARCHAR AS marital_status
    , f.race::VARCHAR AS race
    , f.ethnicity::VARCHAR AS ethnicity
    , f.patient_gender::VARCHAR AS patient_gender
    , nullif(f.birthplace, '')::VARCHAR AS birthplace
    , f.patient_address::VARCHAR AS patient_address
    , f.patient_city::VARCHAR AS patient_city
    , coalesce(m.state_name, f.raw_state)::VARCHAR AS patient_state
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS patient_county
    , f.patient_zip::VARCHAR AS patient_zip
    , f.patient_latitude::FLOAT AS patient_latitude
    , f.patient_longitude::FLOAT AS patient_longitude
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS healthcare_expenses
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS healthcare_coverage
FROM flat AS f
LEFT JOIN {{ ref('stg_map__states') }} AS m
    ON upper(f.raw_state) = upper(m.state_abbreviation)
```

## Mapping hints
- patient_id is the resource id. birth_date is birthDate. death_date is the first 10 characters of deceasedDateTime (the local date).
- ssn, drivers licence and passport are identifier[] entries whose type.coding[0].code is SS, DL and PPN.
- Names come from the name[] entry with use = official (prefix[0], given[0], family, suffix[0]); the maiden name is the family of the entry with use = maiden.
- marital status is maritalStatus.coding[0].code. gender: male becomes M, female becomes F.
- race is the ombCategory display of the us-core-race extension, written as the acquirer writes it: White = white, Black or African American = black, Asian = asian, American Indian or Alaska Native = native, Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander = hawaiian, anything else = other. ethnicity: Hispanic or Latino = hispanic, otherwise nonhispanic.
- birthplace is city, state and country of the birthPlace extension joined by two spaces.
- address is address[0].line[0]; city and postalCode as given; the state is an abbreviation and the acquirer stores the full name (stg_map__states); latitude and longitude are in the geolocation extension of address[0].
- The county and the two healthcare amounts are not in the resource: return NULL.
text:
```sql
WITH src AS (

    SELECT
        json_transform(
            resource,
            '{
                "id": "VARCHAR",
                "birthDate": "VARCHAR",
                "deceasedDateTime": "VARCHAR",
                "gender": "VARCHAR",
                "identifier": [{"type": {"coding": [{"code": "VARCHAR"}]}, "value": "VARCHAR"}],
                "name": [{"use": "VARCHAR", "family": "VARCHAR", "given": ["VARCHAR"], "prefix": ["VARCHAR"], "suffix": ["VARCHAR"]}],
                "maritalStatus": {"coding": [{"code": "VARCHAR"}]},
                "address": [{
                    "line": ["VARCHAR"],
                    "city": "VARCHAR",
                    "state": "VARCHAR",
                    "postalCode": "VARCHAR",
                    "extension": [{"url": "VARCHAR", "extension": [{"url": "VARCHAR", "valueDecimal": "DOUBLE"}]}]
                }],
                "extension": [{
                    "url": "VARCHAR",
                    "valueAddress": {"city": "VARCHAR", "state": "VARCHAR", "country": "VARCHAR"},
                    "extension": [{"url": "VARCHAR", "valueCoding": {"display": "VARCHAR"}}]
                }]
            }'
        ) AS p
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'patient') }}

)

, cte_fields AS (

    SELECT
        p.id AS patient_id
        , p.birthDate AS birth_raw
        , p.deceasedDateTime AS death_raw
        , list_filter(p.identifier, i -> i.type.coding[1].code IN ('SS', 'SB'))[1].value AS ssn
        , list_filter(p.identifier, i -> i.type.coding[1].code = 'DL')[1].value AS drivers_license_number
        , list_filter(p.identifier, i -> i.type.coding[1].code = 'PPN')[1].value AS passport_number
        , list_filter(p.name, n -> n."use" = 'official')[1] AS official_name
        , list_filter(p.name, n -> n."use" = 'maiden')[1].family AS maiden_name
        , p.maritalStatus.coding[1].code AS marital_status
        , list_filter(
            list_filter(p.extension, e -> e.url LIKE '%us-core-race')[1].extension,
            x -> x.url = 'ombCategory'
          )[1].valueCoding.display AS race_display
        , list_filter(
            list_filter(p.extension, e -> e.url LIKE '%us-core-ethnicity')[1].extension,
            x -> x.url = 'ombCategory'
          )[1].valueCoding.display AS ethnicity_display
        , p.gender AS gender_raw
        , list_filter(p.extension, e -> e.url LIKE '%birthPlace')[1].valueAddress AS birth_addr
        , p.address[1] AS addr
    FROM src

)

, cte_death AS (

    SELECT
        patient_id
        , CASE
            WHEN death_raw IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN length(death_raw) <= 10 THEN CAST(substr(death_raw, 1, 10) AS DATE)
            ELSE CAST(
                CAST(substr(death_raw, 1, 19) AS TIMESTAMP)
                - to_minutes(
                    CASE
                        WHEN regexp_extract(death_raw, '([+-])(\d{2}):?(\d{2})$', 1) = '' THEN 0
                        ELSE (CASE WHEN regexp_extract(death_raw, '([+-])(\d{2}):?(\d{2})$', 1) = '-' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END)
                            * (CAST(regexp_extract(death_raw, '([+-])(\d{2}):?(\d{2})$', 2) AS INTEGER) * 60
                               + CAST(regexp_extract(death_raw, '([+-])(\d{2}):?(\d{2})$', 3) AS INTEGER))
                    END
                  )
                AS DATE)
          END AS death_date
    FROM cte_fields

)

SELECT
    f.patient_id AS patient_id
    , CAST(f.birth_raw AS DATE) AS birth_date
    , d.death_date AS death_date
    , f.ssn AS ssn
    , f.drivers_license_number AS drivers_license_number
    , f.passport_number AS passport_number
    , f.official_name.prefix[1] AS patient_prefix
    , f.official_name.given[1] AS patient_first_name
    , f.official_name.family AS patient_last_name
    , f.official_name.suffix[1] AS patient_suffix
    , f.maiden_name AS maiden_name
    , f.marital_status AS marital_status
    , CASE f.race_display
        WHEN 'White' THEN 'white'
        WHEN 'Black or African American' THEN 'black'
        WHEN 'Asian' THEN 'asian'
        WHEN 'American Indian or Alaska Native' THEN 'native'
        WHEN 'Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander' THEN 'hawaiian'
        ELSE 'other'
      END AS race
    , CASE WHEN f.ethnicity_display = 'Hispanic or Latino' THEN 'hispanic' ELSE 'nonhispanic' END AS ethnicity
    , CASE f.gender_raw WHEN 'male' THEN 'M' WHEN 'female' THEN 'F' ELSE NULL END AS patient_gender
    , f.birth_addr.city || '  ' || f.birth_addr.state || '  ' || f.birth_addr.country AS birthplace
    , f.addr.line[1] AS patient_address
    , f.addr.city AS patient_city
    , COALESCE(s.state_name, f.addr.state) AS patient_state
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS patient_county
    , f.addr.postalCode AS patient_zip
    , CAST(
        list_filter(
            list_filter(f.addr.extension, e -> e.url LIKE '%geolocation')[1].extension,
            x -> x.url = 'latitude'
        )[1].valueDecimal AS FLOAT
      ) AS patient_latitude
    , CAST(
        list_filter(
            list_filter(f.addr.extension, e -> e.url LIKE '%geolocation')[1].extension,
            x -> x.url = 'longitude'
        )[1].valueDecimal AS FLOAT
      ) AS patient_longitude
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS healthcare_expenses
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS healthcare_coverage
FROM cte_fields AS f
INNER JOIN cte_death AS d
    ON f.patient_id = d.patient_id
LEFT JOIN {{ ref('stg_map__states') }} AS s
    ON upper(trim(f.addr.state)) = upper(trim(s.state_abbreviation))
```

## Mapping hints
- patient_id is the resource id. birth_date is birthDate. death_date is the first 10 characters of deceasedDateTime (the local date).
- ssn, drivers licence and passport are identifier[] entries whose type.coding[0].code is SS, DL and PPN.
- Names come from the name[] entry with use = official (prefix[0], given[0], family, suffix[0]); the maiden name is the family of the entry with use = maiden.
- marital status is maritalStatus.coding[0].code. gender: male becomes M, female becomes F.
- race is the ombCategory display of the us-core-race extension, written as the acquirer writes it: White = white, Black or African American = black, Asian = asian, American Indian or Alaska Native = native, Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander = hawaiian, anything else = other. ethnicity: Hispanic or Latino = hispanic, otherwise nonhispanic.
- birthplace is city, state and country of the birthPlace extension joined by two spaces.
- address is address[0].line[0]; city and postalCode as given; the state is an abbreviation and the acquirer stores the full name (stg_map__states); latitude and longitude are in the geolocation extension of address[0].
- The county and the two healthcare amounts are not in the resource: return NULL.
text:
```sql
with src as (

    select
        coalesce(resource ->> '$.id', id) as patient_id
        , resource
        , from_json(resource -> '$.extension', '["JSON"]') as exts
        , from_json(resource -> '$.identifier', '["JSON"]') as idents
        , from_json(resource -> '$.name', '["JSON"]') as names
        , resource -> '$.address[0]' as addr
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'patient') }}

)

, parsed as (

    select
        patient_id
        , resource
        , addr
        , list_filter(idents, i -> json_extract_string(i, '$.type.coding[0].code') in ('SS', 'SB')
            or json_extract_string(i, '$.system') = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/us-ssn')[1] as ssn_ident
        , list_filter(idents, i -> json_extract_string(i, '$.type.coding[0].code') = 'DL')[1] as dl_ident
        , list_filter(idents, i -> json_extract_string(i, '$.type.coding[0].code') = 'PPN')[1] as ppn_ident
        , list_filter(names, n -> json_extract_string(n, '$.use') = 'official')[1] as official_name
        , list_filter(names, n -> json_extract_string(n, '$.use') = 'maiden')[1] as maiden_name_entry
        , list_filter(exts, x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.url') like '%us-core-race')[1] as race_ext
        , list_filter(exts, x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.url') like '%us-core-ethnicity')[1] as eth_ext
        , list_filter(exts, x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.url') like '%birthPlace')[1] as birthplace_ext
        , list_filter(
            from_json(resource -> '$.address[0].extension', '["JSON"]')
            , x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.url') like '%geolocation')[1] as geo_ext
    from src

)

, parsed2 as (

    select
        p.*
        , json_extract_string(
            list_filter(from_json(race_ext -> '$.extension', '["JSON"]'),
                y -> json_extract_string(y, '$.url') = 'ombCategory')[1]
            , '$.valueCoding.display') as race_display
        , json_extract_string(
            list_filter(from_json(eth_ext -> '$.extension', '["JSON"]'),
                y -> json_extract_string(y, '$.url') = 'ombCategory')[1]
            , '$.valueCoding.display') as eth_display
        , json_extract_string(
            list_filter(from_json(geo_ext -> '$.extension', '["JSON"]'),
                y -> json_extract_string(y, '$.url') = 'latitude')[1]
            , '$.valueDecimal') as lat_txt
        , json_extract_string(
            list_filter(from_json(geo_ext -> '$.extension', '["JSON"]'),
                y -> json_extract_string(y, '$.url') = 'longitude')[1]
            , '$.valueDecimal') as lon_txt
    from parsed as p

)

, states as (

    select
        upper(trim(state_abbreviation)) as state_abbreviation
        , min(state_name) as state_name
    from {{ ref('stg_map__states') }}
    group by 1

)

select
    p.patient_id::varchar as patient_id
    , try_cast(p.resource ->> '$.birthDate' as date) as birth_date
    , cast(
        (try_cast(p.resource ->> '$.deceasedDateTime' as timestamptz) at time zone 'UTC')
        as date) as death_date
    , json_extract_string(p.ssn_ident, '$.value')::varchar as ssn
    , json_extract_string(p.dl_ident, '$.value')::varchar as drivers_license_number
    , json_extract_string(p.ppn_ident, '$.value')::varchar as passport_number
    , json_extract_string(p.official_name, '$.prefix[0]')::varchar as patient_prefix
    , json_extract_string(p.official_name, '$.given[0]')::varchar as patient_first_name
    , json_extract_string(p.official_name, '$.family')::varchar as patient_last_name
    , json_extract_string(p.official_name, '$.suffix[0]')::varchar as patient_suffix
    , json_extract_string(p.maiden_name_entry, '$.family')::varchar as maiden_name
    , (p.resource ->> '$.maritalStatus.coding[0].code')::varchar as marital_status
    , (case
        when lower(trim(p.race_display)) = 'white' then 'white'
        when lower(trim(p.race_display)) = 'black or african american' then 'black'
        when lower(trim(p.race_display)) = 'asian' then 'asian'
        when lower(trim(p.race_display)) = 'american indian or alaska native' then 'native'
        when lower(trim(p.race_display)) = 'native hawaiian or other pacific islander' then 'hawaiian'
        else 'other'
      end)::varchar as race
    , (case
        when lower(trim(p.eth_display)) = 'hispanic or latino' then 'hispanic'
        else 'nonhispanic'
      end)::varchar as ethnicity
    , (case lower(trim(p.resource ->> '$.gender'))
        when 'male' then 'M'
        when 'female' then 'F'
        else null
      end)::varchar as patient_gender
    , (case
        when p.birthplace_ext is null then null
        else concat_ws('  '
            , json_extract_string(p.birthplace_ext, '$.valueAddress.city')
            , json_extract_string(p.birthplace_ext, '$.valueAddress.state')
            , json_extract_string(p.birthplace_ext, '$.valueAddress.country'))
      end)::varchar as birthplace
    , json_extract_string(p.addr, '$.line[0]')::varchar as patient_address
    , json_extract_string(p.addr, '$.city')::varchar as patient_city
    , coalesce(s.state_name, json_extract_string(p.addr, '$.state'))::varchar as patient_state
    , null::varchar as patient_county
    , json_extract_string(p.addr, '$.postalCode')::varchar as patient_zip
    , try_cast(p.lat_txt as float) as patient_latitude
    , try_cast(p.lon_txt as float) as patient_longitude
    , null::float as healthcare_expenses
    , null::float as healthcare_coverage
from parsed2 as p
left join states as s
    on upper(trim(json_extract_string(p.addr, '$.state'))) = s.state_abbreviation
```

```sql
WITH src AS (

    SELECT
        COALESCE(json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'), id) AS encounter_id
        , CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start') AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AS start_tz
        , CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.end') AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AS end_tz
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference') AS subject_ref
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.serviceProvider.reference') AS org_ref
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.participant[0].individual.display') AS practitioner_display
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.class.code') AS class_code
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].code') AS type_code
        , COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].display'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].text')
        ) AS type_display
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.reason[0].coding[0].code') AS reason_code
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.reason[0].coding[0].display') AS reason_display
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'encounter') }}
    WHERE json_extract_string(resource, '$.resourceType') = 'Encounter'
       OR json_extract_string(resource, '$.resourceType') IS NULL

)

, cte_ids AS (

    SELECT
        encounter_id
        , (start_tz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS start_dt
        , (COALESCE(end_tz, start_tz) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS stop_dt
        , regexp_replace(regexp_replace(subject_ref, '^urn:uuid:', ''), '^Patient/', '') AS patient_id
        , CASE
            WHEN org_ref LIKE '%|%' THEN split_part(org_ref, '|', 2)
            ELSE regexp_replace(org_ref, '^(urn:uuid:|Organization/)', '')
          END AS organization_id
        , regexp_replace(practitioner_display, '^(Dr|Mr|Mrs|Ms|Miss)\.?\s+', '') AS practitioner_name
        , class_code
        , type_code
        , type_display
        , reason_code
        , reason_display
    FROM src

)

, cte_providers AS (

    SELECT
        "NAME" AS provider_name
        , "ORGANIZATION" AS organization_id
        , MIN("Id") AS provider_id
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'providers') }}
    GROUP BY 1, 2

)

, cte_joined AS (

    SELECT
        i.*
        , p.provider_id
    FROM cte_ids AS i
    LEFT JOIN cte_providers AS p
        ON p.provider_name = i.practitioner_name
        AND p.organization_id = i.organization_id

)

SELECT
    CAST(encounter_id AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id
    , CAST(start_dt AS TIMESTAMP) AS encounter_start_datetime
    , CAST(start_dt AS DATE) AS encounter_start_date
    , CAST(stop_dt AS TIMESTAMP) AS encounter_stop_datetime
    , COALESCE(CAST(start_dt AS DATE), CAST(stop_dt AS DATE)) AS encounter_stop_date
    , CAST(patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id
    , CAST(organization_id AS VARCHAR) AS organization_id
    , CAST(provider_id AS VARCHAR) AS provider_id
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS payer_id
    , CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN class_code = 'AMB' THEN
                CASE
                    WHEN type_code IN ('162673000', '410620009') THEN 'wellness'
                    WHEN type_code IN ('702927004') THEN 'urgentcare'
                    WHEN type_code IN ('308335008', '390906007') THEN 'outpatient'
                    ELSE 'ambulatory'
                END
            WHEN class_code = 'EMER' THEN 'emergency'
            WHEN class_code = 'IMP' THEN 'inpatient'
            WHEN class_code = 'HH' THEN 'home'
            WHEN class_code = 'VR' THEN 'virtual'
            ELSE lower(class_code)
        END AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_class
    , CAST(type_code AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_code
    , CAST(type_display AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_description
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS base_encounter_cost
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS total_encounter_cost
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS encounter_payer_coverage
    , CAST(reason_code AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_reason_code
    , CAST(reason_display AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_reason_description
FROM cte_joined
```

```sql
WITH src AS (

    SELECT
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.id') AS encounter_id
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start') AS period_start
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.end') AS period_end
        , replace(json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'), 'urn:uuid:', '') AS patient_id
        , NULLIF(trim(split_part(json_extract_string(resource, '$.serviceProvider.reference'), '|', 2)), '') AS organization_id
        , trim(regexp_replace(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.participant[0].individual.display'),
            '^(Dr|Mr|Mrs|Ms|Miss)\.?\s+', '', 'i'
          )) AS provider_name
        , upper(json_extract_string(resource, '$.class.code')) AS class_code
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].code') AS encounter_code
        , COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].display'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].text')
          ) AS encounter_description
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.reason[0].coding[0].code') AS encounter_reason_code
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.reason[0].coding[0].display') AS encounter_reason_description
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'encounter') }}
    WHERE json_extract_string(resource, '$.resourceType') = 'Encounter'

)

, providers_unique AS (

    SELECT
        lower(trim("NAME")) AS provider_name_key
        , "ORGANIZATION" AS organization_id
        , count(DISTINCT "Id") AS n_ids
        , min("Id") AS provider_id
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'providers') }}
    GROUP BY 1, 2

)

, cte_typed AS (

    SELECT
        s.encounter_id
        , CAST(CAST(s.period_start AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP) AS encounter_start_datetime
        , COALESCE(
            CAST(CAST(s.period_end AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP),
            CAST(CAST(s.period_start AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP)
          ) AS encounter_stop_datetime
        , s.patient_id
        , s.organization_id
        , CASE WHEN p.n_ids = 1 THEN p.provider_id END AS provider_id
        , CASE
            WHEN s.class_code = 'EMER' THEN 'emergency'
            WHEN s.class_code = 'IMP' THEN 'inpatient'
            WHEN s.class_code = 'AMB' THEN
                CASE
                    WHEN s.encounter_code IN ('162673000', '410620009') THEN 'wellness'
                    WHEN s.encounter_code = '702927004' THEN 'urgentcare'
                    WHEN s.encounter_code = '308335008' THEN 'outpatient'
                    ELSE 'ambulatory'
                END
            ELSE lower(s.class_code)
          END AS encounter_class
        , s.encounter_code
        , s.encounter_description
        , s.encounter_reason_code
        , s.encounter_reason_description
    FROM src s
    LEFT JOIN providers_unique p
        ON lower(s.provider_name) = p.provider_name_key
        AND s.organization_id = p.organization_id

)

SELECT
    encounter_id
    , encounter_start_datetime
    , CAST(encounter_start_datetime AS DATE) AS encounter_start_date
    , encounter_stop_datetime
    , COALESCE(
        CAST(encounter_start_datetime AS DATE),
        CAST(encounter_stop_datetime AS DATE)
      ) AS encounter_stop_date
    , patient_id
    , organization_id
    , provider_id
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS payer_id
    , encounter_class
    , encounter_code
    , encounter_description
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS base_encounter_cost
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS total_encounter_cost
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS encounter_payer_coverage
    , encounter_reason_code
    , encounter_reason_description
FROM cte_typed
```

```sql
WITH src AS (

    SELECT
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.id') AS encounter_id
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start') AS period_start
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.end') AS period_end
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference') AS subject_ref
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.serviceProvider.reference') AS org_ref
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.participant[0].individual.display') AS practitioner_display
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.class.code') AS class_code
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].code') AS type_code
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].display') AS type_display
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].text') AS type_text
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.reason[0].coding[0].code') AS reason_code
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.reason[0].coding[0].display') AS reason_display
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'encounter') }}
    WHERE json_extract_string(resource, '$.resourceType') = 'Encounter'

)

, provider_lookup AS (

    SELECT
        lower(trim("NAME")) AS provider_name_key
        , "ORGANIZATION" AS organization_id
        , min("Id") AS provider_id
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'providers') }}
    GROUP BY lower(trim("NAME")), "ORGANIZATION"

)

, cte_parsed AS (

    SELECT
        s.encounter_id
        , CAST(CAST(s.period_start AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP) AS encounter_start_datetime
        , CAST(CAST(s.period_end AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP) AS period_end_datetime
        , replace(s.subject_ref, 'urn:uuid:', '') AS patient_id
        , NULLIF(trim(split_part(s.org_ref, '|', 2)), '') AS organization_id
        , s.practitioner_display
        , s.class_code
        , s.type_code AS encounter_code
        , COALESCE(s.type_display, s.type_text) AS encounter_description
        , s.reason_code AS encounter_reason_code
        , s.reason_display AS encounter_reason_description
    FROM src AS s

)

, cte_joined AS (

    SELECT
        p.*
        , pl.provider_id
    FROM cte_parsed AS p
    LEFT JOIN provider_lookup AS pl
        ON pl.provider_name_key = lower(trim(regexp_replace(COALESCE(p.practitioner_display, ''), '^Dr\.\s+', '')))
        AND pl.organization_id = p.organization_id

)

SELECT
    CAST(encounter_id AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id
    , CAST(encounter_start_datetime AS TIMESTAMP) AS encounter_start_datetime
    , CAST(encounter_start_datetime AS DATE) AS encounter_start_date
    , CAST(COALESCE(period_end_datetime, encounter_start_datetime) AS TIMESTAMP) AS encounter_stop_datetime
    , CAST(COALESCE(CAST(encounter_start_datetime AS DATE), CAST(period_end_datetime AS DATE)) AS DATE) AS encounter_stop_date
    , CAST(patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id
    , CAST(organization_id AS VARCHAR) AS organization_id
    , CAST(provider_id AS VARCHAR) AS provider_id
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS payer_id
    , CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN upper(class_code) = 'AMB' THEN
                CASE
                    WHEN encounter_code IN ('162673000', '410620009', '170258001', '169230002') THEN 'wellness'
                    WHEN encounter_code = '308335008' THEN 'outpatient'
                    WHEN encounter_code = '702927004' THEN 'urgentcare'
                    ELSE 'ambulatory'
                END
            WHEN upper(class_code) = 'EMER' THEN 'emergency'
            WHEN upper(class_code) = 'IMP' THEN 'inpatient'
            WHEN upper(class_code) = 'HH' THEN 'home'
            WHEN upper(class_code) = 'VR' THEN 'virtual'
            ELSE lower(class_code)
        END AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_class
    , CAST(encounter_code AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_code
    , CAST(encounter_description AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_description
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS base_encounter_cost
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS total_encounter_cost
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS encounter_payer_coverage
    , CAST(encounter_reason_code AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_reason_code
    , CAST(encounter_reason_description AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_reason_description
FROM cte_joined
```

```sql
WITH src AS (

    SELECT
        COALESCE(json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'), id) AS encounter_id
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start') AS start_raw
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.end') AS end_raw
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference') AS patient_ref
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.serviceProvider.reference') AS org_ref
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.participant[0].individual.display') AS provider_display
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.class.code') AS fhir_class
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].code') AS type_code
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].display') AS type_display
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.reason[0].coding[0].code') AS reason_code
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.reason[0].coding[0].display') AS reason_display
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'encounter') }}
    WHERE COALESCE(json_extract_string(resource, '$.resourceType'), 'Encounter') = 'Encounter'

)

, provider_lookup AS (

    -- the FHIR practitioner reference carries an NPI, not the acquirer's provider id,
    -- so the provider is resolved through name + organisation
    SELECT
        lower(trim("NAME")) AS provider_name
        , lower(trim("ORGANIZATION")) AS organization_id
        , MIN(lower(trim("Id"))) AS provider_id
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'providers') }}
    GROUP BY 1, 2

)

, cte_parsed AS (

    SELECT
        lower(trim(encounter_id)) AS encounter_id
        , CASE
            WHEN start_raw IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN regexp_matches(start_raw, '(Z|[+-][0-9][0-9]:?[0-9][0-9])$')
                THEN CAST(start_raw AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
            ELSE CAST(start_raw AS TIMESTAMP)
          END AS start_ts
        , CASE
            WHEN end_raw IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN regexp_matches(end_raw, '(Z|[+-][0-9][0-9]:?[0-9][0-9])$')
                THEN CAST(end_raw AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
            ELSE CAST(end_raw AS TIMESTAMP)
          END AS end_ts
        , lower(trim(regexp_replace(patient_ref, '^.*[:/|]', ''))) AS patient_id
        , lower(trim(regexp_replace(org_ref, '^.*[:/|]', ''))) AS organization_id
        , lower(trim(regexp_replace(trim(provider_display), '^Dr\.?\s+', ''))) AS provider_name
        , CASE
            WHEN fhir_class = 'EMER' THEN 'emergency'
            WHEN fhir_class IN ('IMP', 'ACUTE', 'NONAC') THEN 'inpatient'
            WHEN fhir_class = 'HH' THEN 'home'
            WHEN fhir_class = 'VR' THEN 'virtual'
            WHEN fhir_class = 'AMB' AND type_code IN ('162673000', '410620009') THEN 'wellness'
            WHEN fhir_class = 'AMB' AND type_code IN ('308335008', '185349003') THEN 'outpatient'
            WHEN fhir_class = 'AMB' AND type_code = '702927004' THEN 'urgentcare'
            WHEN fhir_class = 'AMB' THEN 'ambulatory'
            ELSE lower(fhir_class)
          END AS encounter_class
        , type_code AS encounter_code
        , type_display AS encounter_description
        , reason_code AS encounter_reason_code
        , reason_display AS encounter_reason_description
    FROM src

)

SELECT
    p.encounter_id AS encounter_id
    , p.start_ts AS encounter_start_datetime
    , CAST(p.start_ts AS DATE) AS encounter_start_date
    -- default to start if there is no end, as in the acquirer's model
    , COALESCE(p.end_ts, p.start_ts) AS encounter_stop_datetime
    -- the acquirer's convention: stop date is taken from the start datetime first
    , COALESCE(CAST(p.start_ts AS DATE), CAST(COALESCE(p.end_ts, p.start_ts) AS DATE)) AS encounter_stop_date
    , p.patient_id AS patient_id
    , p.organization_id AS organization_id
    , pl.provider_id AS provider_id
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS payer_id
    , p.encounter_class AS encounter_class
    , p.encounter_code AS encounter_code
    , p.encounter_description AS encounter_description
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS base_encounter_cost
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS total_encounter_cost
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS encounter_payer_coverage
    , p.encounter_reason_code AS encounter_reason_code
    , p.encounter_reason_description AS encounter_reason_description
FROM cte_parsed AS p
LEFT JOIN provider_lookup AS pl
    ON pl.provider_name = p.provider_name
    AND pl.organization_id = p.organization_id
```

```sql
WITH src AS (

    SELECT
        id
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.onsetDateTime') AS onset_raw
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.assertedDate') AS asserted_raw
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.abatementDateTime') AS abatement_raw
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference') AS subject_ref
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.context.reference') AS context_ref
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text') AS code_text
        , from_json(
            json_extract(resource, '$.code.coding')
            , '[{"system":"VARCHAR","code":"VARCHAR","display":"VARCHAR"}]'
        ) AS codings
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'condition') }}
    WHERE json_extract_string(resource, '$.resourceType') = 'Condition'

)

, picked AS (

    SELECT
        *
        , coalesce(
            list_filter(codings, x -> x.system = 'http://snomed.info/sct')[1]
            , codings[1]
        ) AS coding
    FROM src

)

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN coalesce(onset_raw, asserted_raw) IS NULL THEN NULL
        WHEN length(coalesce(onset_raw, asserted_raw)) = 10
            THEN try_cast(coalesce(onset_raw, asserted_raw) AS DATE)
        ELSE CAST(
            (try_cast(coalesce(onset_raw, asserted_raw) AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')
            AS DATE
        )
    END AS condition_start_date
    , CASE
        WHEN abatement_raw IS NULL THEN NULL
        WHEN length(abatement_raw) = 10 THEN try_cast(abatement_raw AS DATE)
        ELSE CAST(
            (try_cast(abatement_raw AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')
            AS DATE
        )
    END AS condition_stop_date
    , CAST(regexp_replace(subject_ref, '^.*[:/]', '') AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id
    , CAST(regexp_replace(context_ref, '^.*[:/]', '') AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id
    , CAST(trim(coding.code) AS VARCHAR) AS condition_code
    , CAST(coalesce(coding.display, code_text) AS VARCHAR) AS condition_description
FROM picked
```
