```sql
WITH procedures AS (

    SELECT
        id AS source_id
        , resource
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'procedure') }}
    WHERE json_extract_string(resource, '$.resourceType') = 'Procedure'

)

, conditions AS (

    SELECT
        lower(id) AS condition_id
        , min(json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code')) AS condition_code
        , min(json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display')) AS condition_display
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'condition') }}
    GROUP BY lower(id)

)

, parsed AS (

    SELECT
        source_id
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedPeriod.start') AS start_raw
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedPeriod.end') AS end_raw
        , lower(replace(json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'), 'urn:uuid:', '')) AS patient_id
        , lower(replace(json_extract_string(resource, '$.context.reference'), 'urn:uuid:', '')) AS encounter_id
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') AS procedure_code
        , coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display')
            , json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text')
        ) AS procedure_description
        , lower(replace(json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonReference[0].reference'), 'urn:uuid:', '')) AS reason_condition_id
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonReference[0].display') AS reason_display
    FROM procedures

)

, final AS (

    SELECT
        CAST(CAST(p.start_raw AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP) AS procedure_start_datetime
        , CAST(CAST(CAST(p.start_raw AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS procedure_start_date
        , CAST(CAST(p.end_raw AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP) AS procedure_stop_datetime
        , CAST(CAST(CAST(p.end_raw AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS procedure_stop_date
        , CAST(p.patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id
        , CAST(p.encounter_id AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id
        , CAST(p.procedure_code AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_code
        , CAST(p.procedure_description AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_description
        , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS procedure_base_cost
        , CAST(c.condition_code AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_reason_code
        , CAST(
            CASE
                WHEN p.reason_condition_id IS NULL THEN NULL
                ELSE coalesce(c.condition_display, p.reason_display)
            END AS VARCHAR
        ) AS procedure_reason_description
    FROM parsed AS p
    LEFT JOIN conditions AS c
        ON p.reason_condition_id = c.condition_id

)

SELECT *
FROM final
```

```sql
WITH procs AS (

    SELECT
        id AS source_id
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedPeriod.start') AS start_raw
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedPeriod.end') AS end_raw
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference') AS patient_ref
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.context.reference') AS encounter_ref
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') AS proc_code
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display') AS proc_display
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonReference[0].reference') AS reason_ref
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonReference[0].display') AS reason_display
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'procedure') }}

)

, conditions AS (

    SELECT
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.id') AS condition_id
        , MIN(json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code')) AS condition_code
        , MIN(json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display')) AS condition_display
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'condition') }}
    GROUP BY 1

)

, cte_joined AS (

    SELECT
        p.*
        , c.condition_code
        , c.condition_display
    FROM procs AS p
    LEFT JOIN conditions AS c
        ON regexp_replace(p.reason_ref, '^(urn:uuid:|.*/)', '') = c.condition_id

)

, cte_typed AS (

    SELECT
        CAST(CAST(start_raw AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP) AS procedure_start_datetime
        , CAST(CAST(end_raw AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP) AS procedure_stop_datetime
        , CAST(regexp_replace(patient_ref, '^(urn:uuid:|.*/)', '') AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id
        , CAST(regexp_replace(encounter_ref, '^(urn:uuid:|.*/)', '') AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id
        , CAST(proc_code AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_code
        , CAST(proc_display AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_description
        , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS procedure_base_cost
        , CAST(condition_code AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_reason_code
        , CAST(COALESCE(condition_display, reason_display) AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_reason_description
    FROM cte_joined

)

SELECT
    procedure_start_datetime
    , CAST(procedure_start_datetime AS DATE) AS procedure_start_date
    , procedure_stop_datetime
    , CAST(procedure_stop_datetime AS DATE) AS procedure_stop_date
    , patient_id
    , encounter_id
    , procedure_code
    , procedure_description
    , procedure_base_cost
    , procedure_reason_code
    , procedure_reason_description
FROM cte_typed
```

```sql
WITH cte_proc AS (

    SELECT
        id AS source_id
        , CAST(CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedPeriod.start') AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP) AS procedure_start_datetime
        , CAST(CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedPeriod.end') AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP) AS procedure_stop_datetime
        , lower(trim(replace(json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'), 'urn:uuid:', ''))) AS patient_id
        , lower(trim(replace(json_extract_string(resource, '$.context.reference'), 'urn:uuid:', ''))) AS encounter_id
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') AS procedure_code
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display') AS procedure_description
        , lower(trim(replace(json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonReference[0].reference'), 'urn:uuid:', ''))) AS reason_condition_id
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonReference[0].display') AS reason_ref_display
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'procedure') }}

)

, cte_condition AS (

    SELECT
        lower(trim(id)) AS condition_id
        , min(json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code')) AS condition_code
        , min(json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display')) AS condition_display
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'condition') }}
    GROUP BY lower(trim(id))

)

SELECT
    p.procedure_start_datetime AS procedure_start_datetime
    , CAST(p.procedure_start_datetime AS DATE) AS procedure_start_date
    , p.procedure_stop_datetime AS procedure_stop_datetime
    , CAST(p.procedure_stop_datetime AS DATE) AS procedure_stop_date
    , CAST(p.patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id
    , CAST(p.encounter_id AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id
    , CAST(p.procedure_code AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_code
    , CAST(p.procedure_description AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_description
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS procedure_base_cost
    , CAST(c.condition_code AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_reason_code
    , CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN p.reason_condition_id IS NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE coalesce(c.condition_display, p.reason_ref_display)
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS procedure_reason_description
FROM cte_proc AS p
LEFT JOIN cte_condition AS c
    ON p.reason_condition_id = c.condition_id
```

```sql
with proc as (

    select
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedPeriod.start') as start_raw
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedPeriod.end') as stop_raw
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference') as subject_ref
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.context.reference') as context_ref
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') as code_val
        , coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display')
            , json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text')
        ) as description_val
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonReference[0].reference') as reason_ref
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonReference[0].display') as reason_display
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'procedure') }}

)

, cond as (

    select
        lower(regexp_replace(coalesce(json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'), id), '^.*[/:]', '')) as condition_id
        , min(json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code')) as condition_code
        , min(coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display')
            , json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text')
        )) as condition_description
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'condition') }}
    group by 1

)

, proc_clean as (

    select
        case
            when start_raw is null then null
            when regexp_matches(start_raw, '(Z|[+-][0-9][0-9]:?[0-9][0-9])$')
                then cast(start_raw as timestamptz) at time zone 'UTC'
            else cast(start_raw as timestamp)
        end as procedure_start_datetime
        , case
            when stop_raw is null then null
            when regexp_matches(stop_raw, '(Z|[+-][0-9][0-9]:?[0-9][0-9])$')
                then cast(stop_raw as timestamptz) at time zone 'UTC'
            else cast(stop_raw as timestamp)
        end as procedure_stop_datetime
        , lower(regexp_replace(subject_ref, '^.*[/:]', '')) as patient_id
        , lower(regexp_replace(context_ref, '^.*[/:]', '')) as encounter_id
        , code_val
        , description_val
        , lower(regexp_replace(reason_ref, '^.*[/:]', '')) as reason_id
        , reason_display
    from proc

)

select
    cast(p.procedure_start_datetime as timestamp) as procedure_start_datetime
    , cast(p.procedure_start_datetime as date) as procedure_start_date
    , cast(p.procedure_stop_datetime as timestamp) as procedure_stop_datetime
    , cast(p.procedure_stop_datetime as date) as procedure_stop_date
    , cast(p.patient_id as varchar) as patient_id
    , cast(p.encounter_id as varchar) as encounter_id
    , cast(p.code_val as varchar) as procedure_code
    , cast(p.description_val as varchar) as procedure_description
    , cast(null as float) as procedure_base_cost
    , cast(case when p.reason_id is not null then c.condition_code end as varchar) as procedure_reason_code
    , cast(case when p.reason_id is not null then coalesce(c.condition_description, p.reason_display) end as varchar) as procedure_reason_description
from proc_clean as p
left join cond as c
    on p.reason_id = c.condition_id
```

- start and stop are performedPeriod.start and .end (or performedDateTime for both); they carry a UTC offset and the contract wants UTC.
- patient is subject.reference, the encounter is encounter.reference (R4) or context.reference (STU3), without the urn:uuid: prefix.

```sql
WITH cte_procedure AS (

    SELECT
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.id') AS source_id
        , COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedPeriod.start')
            , json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedDateTime')
        ) AS start_raw
        , COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedPeriod.end')
            , json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedDateTime')
        ) AS stop_raw
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference') AS subject_ref
        , COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.context.reference')
            , json_extract_string(resource, '$.encounter.reference')
        ) AS encounter_ref
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') AS code_value
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display') AS display_value
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonReference[0].reference') AS reason_ref
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'procedure') }}

)

, cte_condition AS (

    SELECT
        COALESCE(json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'), id) AS condition_id
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') AS condition_code
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display') AS condition_display
        , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY COALESCE(json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'), id)
            ORDER BY id
        ) AS rn
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'condition') }}

)

, cte_condition_unique AS (

    SELECT condition_id, condition_code, condition_display
    FROM cte_condition
    WHERE rn = 1

)

, cte_procedure_clean AS (

    SELECT
        CAST(timezone('UTC', CAST(start_raw AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) AS TIMESTAMP) AS procedure_start_datetime
        , CAST(timezone('UTC', CAST(stop_raw AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) AS TIMESTAMP) AS procedure_stop_datetime
        , regexp_replace(subject_ref, '^.*[:/]', '') AS patient_id
        , regexp_replace(encounter_ref, '^.*[:/]', '') AS encounter_id
        , code_value AS procedure_code
        , replace(display_value, ',', ' ') AS procedure_description
        , regexp_replace(reason_ref, '^.*[:/]', '') AS reason_id
    FROM cte_procedure

)

SELECT
    p.procedure_start_datetime AS procedure_start_datetime
```

## Mapping hints
- start and stop are performedPeriod.start and .end (or performedDateTime for both); they carry a UTC offset and the contract wants UTC.
- patient is subject.reference, the encounter is encounter.reference (R4) or context.reference (STU3), without the urn:uuid: prefix.
- code and description are code.coding[0]; commas in text become spaces. The reason is the code of the Condition that reasonReference[0].reference points to. The cost is not in the resource: NULL.
text:
```sql
WITH cte_conditions AS (

    SELECT
        id AS condition_id
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') AS condition_code
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display') AS condition_display
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text') AS condition_text
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'condition') }}
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY id ORDER BY id) = 1

)

, cte_procedures_raw AS (

    SELECT
        id AS source_id
        , COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedPeriod.start')
            , json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedDateTime')
        ) AS start_raw
        , COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedPeriod.end')
            , json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedDateTime')
        ) AS stop_raw
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference') AS patient_ref
        , COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.context.reference')
            , json_extract_string(resource, '$.encounter.reference')
        ) AS encounter_ref
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') AS code_raw
        , COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display')
            , json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text')
        ) AS description_raw
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonReference[0].reference') AS reason_ref
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonReference[0].display') AS reason_display_raw
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'procedure') }}

)

, cte_procedures_clean AS (

    SELECT
        source_id
        , CAST(CAST(start_raw AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP) AS procedure_start_datetime
        , CAST(CAST(stop_raw AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP) AS procedure_stop_datetime
        , regexp_replace(patient_ref, '^(urn:uuid:|.*/)', '') AS patient_id
        , regexp_replace(encounter_ref, '^(urn:uuid:|.*/)', '') AS encounter_id
        , code_raw AS procedure_code
        , replace(description_raw, ',', ' ') AS procedure_description
        , regexp_replace(reason_ref, '^(urn:uuid:|.*/)', '') AS reason_id
        , reason_display_raw
    FROM cte_procedures_raw

)

, cte_procedures_final AS (

    SELECT
        p.procedure_start_datetime
        , CAST(p.procedure_start_datetime AS DATE) AS procedure_start_date
        , p.procedure_stop_datetime
        , CAST(p.procedure_stop_datetime AS DATE) AS procedure_stop_date
        , CAST(p.patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id
        , CAST(p.encounter_id AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id
        , CAST(p.procedure_code AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_code
        , CAST(p.procedure_description AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_description
        , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS procedure_base_cost
        , CAST(c.condition_code AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_reason_code
        , CAST(
            replace(COALESCE(c.condition_display, c.condition_text, p.reason_display_raw), ',', ' ')
            AS VARCHAR
        ) AS procedure_reason_description
    FROM cte_procedures_clean AS p
    LEFT JOIN cte_conditions AS c
        ON p.reason_id = c.condition_id

)

SELECT *
FROM cte_procedures_final
```

```sql
with src as (

    select
        id,
        resource
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'observation') }}
    where json_extract_string(resource, '$.resourceType') = 'Observation'

-- Observations without components: the resource itself carries code and value.
-- Observations with components (blood pressure, survey panels): the acquirer's
-- rows are one per component, so each component becomes its own row.
items as (

    select
        resource,
        resource as item
    from src
    where coalesce(json_array_length(json_extract(resource, '$.component')), 0) = 0

    union all

    select
        s.resource,
        u.item
    from src s,
         unnest(from_json(json_extract(s.resource, '$.component'), '["JSON"]')) as u(item)
    where coalesce(json_array_length(json_extract(s.resource, '$.component')), 0) > 0

),

extracted as (

    select
        cast(json_extract_string(resource, '$.effectiveDateTime') as timestamptz) as effective_ts,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference') as subject_ref,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.context.reference') as context_ref,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.category[0].coding[0].code') as category_code,

        coalesce(

            json_extract_string(item, '$.code.text')
        ) as code_display,
        json_extract_string(item, '$.valueQuantity.value') as quantity_value,
        json_extract_string(item, '$.valueQuantity.unit') as quantity_unit,
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(item, '$.valueCodeableConcept.text'),
            json_extract_string(item, '$.valueCodeableConcept.coding[0].display'),
            json_extract_string(item, '$.valueString')

    from items

)

    cast(cast(timezone('UTC', effective_ts) as timestamp) as date) as observation_date,
```

```sql
WITH base AS (

    SELECT
        id
        , CAST(resource AS JSON) AS r
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'observation') }}
    WHERE json_extract_string(resource, '$.resourceType') = 'Observation'

)

, items AS (

    -- observations without components: the resource itself is the record
    SELECT
        id
        , r
        , r AS item
    FROM base
    WHERE json_extract(r, '$.component') IS NULL

    UNION ALL

    -- panels with components: each component is its own record (parent context, component code/value)
    SELECT
        id
        , r
        , c AS item
    FROM (
        SELECT
            id
            , r
            , UNNEST(from_json(json_extract(r, '$.component'), '["JSON"]')) AS c
        FROM base
        WHERE json_extract(r, '$.component') IS NOT NULL
    ) AS x

)

, cte_flat AS (

    SELECT
        CAST(
            CAST(
                COALESCE(
                    json_extract_string(r, '$.effectiveDateTime')
                    , json_extract_string(r, '$.issued')
                ) AS TIMESTAMPTZ
            ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP
        ) AS observation_datetime
        , lower(regexp_replace(json_extract_string(r, '$.subject.reference'), '^(urn:uuid:|Patient/)', '')) AS patient_id
        , lower(regexp_replace(json_extract_string(r, '$.context.reference'), '^(urn:uuid:|Encounter/)', '')) AS encounter_id
        , json_extract_string(r, '$.category[0].coding[0].code') AS observation_category
        , json_extract_string(item, '$.code.coding[0].code') AS observation_code
        , COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(item, '$.code.coding[0].display')
            , json_extract_string(item, '$.code.text')
        ) AS observation_description
        , json_extract_string(item, '$.valueQuantity.value') AS qty_value
        , COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(item, '$.valueCodeableConcept.text')
            , json_extract_string(item, '$.valueCodeableConcept.coding[0].display')
            , json_extract_string(item, '$.valueString')
        ) AS text_value
        , json_extract_string(item, '$.valueQuantity.unit') AS observation_units
    FROM items

)

SELECT
    observation_datetime
    , CAST(observation_datetime AS DATE) AS observation_date
    , CAST(patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id
    , CAST(encounter_id AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id
    , CAST(observation_category AS VARCHAR) AS observation_category
    , CAST(observation_code AS VARCHAR) AS observation_code
    , CAST(observation_description AS VARCHAR) AS observation_description
    , CAST(COALESCE(qty_value, text_value) AS VARCHAR) AS observation_value
    , CAST(observation_units AS VARCHAR) AS observation_units
    , CAST(CASE WHEN qty_value IS NOT NULL THEN 'numeric' ELSE 'text' END AS VARCHAR) AS observation_value_type
FROM cte_flat
```

```sql
with obs as (

    select

    from {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'observation') }}
    where json_extract_string(resource, '$.resourceType') = 'Observation'

obs_base as (

        lower(regexp_replace(json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'), '^(urn:uuid:|.*/)', '')) as patient_id,
        lower(regexp_replace(json_extract_string(resource, '$.context.reference'), '^(urn:uuid:|.*/)', '')) as encounter_id,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.category[0].coding[0].code') as observation_category
    from obs

),

-- observations without components: the resource itself carries code and value
simple_obs as (

    select
        effective_dt,
        patient_id,
        encounter_id,
        observation_category,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') as observation_code,
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text')
        ) as observation_description,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueQuantity.value') as qty_value,
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept.coding[0].display'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept.text'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueString')
        ) as text_value,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueQuantity.unit') as observation_units
    from obs_base
    where json_extract_string(resource, '$.component') is null
       or json_array_length(resource -> '$.component') = 0

),

-- observations with components: one row per component (acquirer's convention)
component_obs as (

    select
        b.effective_dt,
        b.patient_id,
        b.encounter_id,
        b.observation_category,
        json_extract_string(t.comp, '$.code.coding[0].code') as observation_code,
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(t.comp, '$.code.coding[0].display'),
            json_extract_string(t.comp, '$.code.text')
        ) as observation_description,
        json_extract_string(t.comp, '$.valueQuantity.value') as qty_value,
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(t.comp, '$.valueCodeableConcept.coding[0].display'),
            json_extract_string(t.comp, '$.valueCodeableConcept.text'),
            json_extract_string(t.comp, '$.valueString')
        ) as text_value,
        json_extract_string(t.comp, '$.valueQuantity.unit') as observation_units
    from obs_base as b,

),
```

```sql
WITH obs AS (

    SELECT
        id
        , resource
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.effectiveDateTime') AS effective_raw
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference') AS subject_ref
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.context.reference') AS context_ref
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.category[0].coding[0].code') AS category_code
        , coalesce(json_array_length(json_extract(resource, '$.component')), 0) AS n_components
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'observation') }}
    WHERE json_extract_string(resource, '$.resourceType') = 'Observation'

)

, items AS (

    -- observations without components: the resource itself is the item
    SELECT
        id
        , effective_raw
        , subject_ref
        , context_ref
        , category_code
        , resource AS node
    FROM obs
    WHERE n_components = 0

    UNION ALL

    -- observations with components: one item per component (panel parent carries no value)
    SELECT
        o.id
        , o.effective_raw
        , o.subject_ref
        , o.context_ref
        , o.category_code
        , c.comp AS node
    FROM obs AS o
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(CAST(json_extract(o.resource, '$.component') AS JSON[])) AS c(comp)
    WHERE o.n_components > 0

)

, extracted AS (

    SELECT
        CAST(effective_raw AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS observation_datetime
        , lower(regexp_replace(subject_ref, '^(urn:uuid:|Patient/)', '')) AS patient_id
        , lower(regexp_replace(context_ref, '^(urn:uuid:|Encounter/)', '')) AS encounter_id
        , category_code AS observation_category
        , json_extract_string(node, '$.code.coding[0].code') AS observation_code
        , coalesce(
            json_extract_string(node, '$.code.coding[0].display')
            , json_extract_string(node, '$.code.text')
        ) AS observation_description
        , json_extract_string(node, '$.valueQuantity.value') AS qty_value
        , coalesce(
            json_extract_string(node, '$.valueCodeableConcept.text')
            , json_extract_string(node, '$.valueCodeableConcept.coding[0].display')
            , json_extract_string(node, '$.valueString')
        ) AS text_value
        , json_extract_string(node, '$.valueQuantity.unit') AS qty_unit
    FROM items

)

SELECT
    CAST(observation_datetime AS TIMESTAMP) AS observation_datetime
    , CAST(observation_datetime AS DATE) AS observation_date
    , CAST(patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id
    , CAST(encounter_id AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id
    , CAST(observation_category AS VARCHAR) AS observation_category
    , CAST(observation_code AS VARCHAR) AS observation_code
    , CAST(replace(replace(replace(observation_description, chr(13), ' '), chr(10), ' '), ',', ' ') AS VARCHAR) AS observation_description
    , CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN qty_value IS NOT NULL THEN qty_value
            ELSE replace(replace(replace(text_value, chr(13), ' '), chr(10), ' '), ',', ' ')
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS observation_value
    , CAST(replace(qty_unit, ',', ' ') AS VARCHAR) AS observation_units
    , CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN qty_value IS NOT NULL THEN 'numeric'
            ELSE 'text'
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS observation_value_type
FROM extracted
```

## Mapping hints
- One row per value: an Observation with component[] gives one row per component (code and value from the component, date, patient, encounter and category from the parent); an Observation without components gives one row.
- date is effectiveDateTime (UTC); patient is subject.reference, the encounter is encounter.reference (R4) or context.reference (STU3), without the urn:uuid: prefix; category is category[0].coding[0].code.
- A valueQuantity gives type numeric, units = valueQuantity.unit and the value as text with exactly one decimal digit (163.34 is written 163.3, 71 is written 71.0). Other values give type text: the display of valueCodeableConcept.coding[0], or valueString.
- In DuckDB write (x->'$.path') IS NULL with the parentheses. Commas in text become spaces.
text:
```sql
WITH base AS (

    SELECT
        id
        , resource
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'observation') }}
    WHERE resource->>'$.resourceType' = 'Observation'

)

, items AS (

    -- observations without components: one row, the item is the resource itself
    SELECT
        id
        , resource AS parent
        , resource AS item
    FROM base
    WHERE coalesce(json_array_length(resource->'$.component'), 0) = 0

    UNION ALL

    -- observations with components: one row per component
    SELECT
        id
        , resource AS parent
        , unnest(CAST(resource->'$.component' AS JSON[])) AS item
    FROM base
    WHERE coalesce(json_array_length(resource->'$.component'), 0) > 0

)

, cte_fields AS (

    SELECT
        (CAST(parent->>'$.effectiveDateTime' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS observation_datetime
        , replace(parent->>'$.subject.reference', 'urn:uuid:', '') AS patient_id
        , replace(
            coalesce(parent->>'$.context.reference', parent->>'$.encounter.reference')
            , 'urn:uuid:', ''
        ) AS encounter_id
        , parent->>'$.category[0].coding[0].code' AS observation_category
        , item->>'$.code.coding[0].code' AS observation_code
        , replace(item->>'$.code.coding[0].display', ',', ' ') AS observation_description
        , (item->'$.valueQuantity') IS NOT NULL AS is_quantity
        , item->>'$.valueQuantity.value' AS quantity_value
        , item->>'$.valueQuantity.unit' AS quantity_unit
        , coalesce(
            item->>'$.valueCodeableConcept.coding[0].display'
            , item->>'$.valueString'
        ) AS text_value
    FROM items

)

SELECT
    CAST(observation_datetime AS TIMESTAMP) AS observation_datetime
    , CAST(observation_datetime AS DATE) AS observation_date
    , CAST(patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id
    , CAST(encounter_id AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id
    , CAST(observation_category AS VARCHAR) AS observation_category
    , CAST(observation_code AS VARCHAR) AS observation_code
    , CAST(observation_description AS VARCHAR) AS observation_description
    , CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN is_quantity THEN
                CAST(
                    ROUND(CAST(quantity_value AS DECIMAL(28, 6)), 1)
                    AS DECIMAL(28, 1)
                )::VARCHAR
            ELSE replace(text_value, ',', ' ')
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS observation_value
    , CAST(
        CASE WHEN is_quantity THEN replace(quantity_unit, ',', ' ') ELSE NULL END
        AS VARCHAR
    ) AS observation_units
    , CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN is_quantity THEN 'numeric'
            WHEN text_value IS NOT NULL THEN 'text'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS observation_value_type
FROM cte_fields
```

```sql
        lower(trim(regexp_replace(

        cast(json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start') as timestamptz) as start_ts,
```

```sql
with allergy as (

    select
        a.id as resource_id
        , cast(json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.assertedDate') as timestamptz) at time zone 'UTC' as asserted_ts
        , replace(json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.patient.reference'), 'urn:uuid:', '') as patient_id
        , json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') as allergy_code
        , json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.coding[0].system') as code_system_uri
        , coalesce(
            json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.coding[0].display')
            , json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.text')
        ) as allergy_description
        , json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.type') as allergy_type
        , json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.category[0]') as allergy_category
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'allergyintolerance') }} as a

)

, enc as (

    select
        replace(json_extract_string(e.resource, '$.subject.reference'), 'urn:uuid:', '') as patient_id
        , cast(json_extract_string(e.resource, '$.period.start') as timestamptz) at time zone 'UTC' as start_ts
        , e.id as encounter_id
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'encounter') }} as e

)

, enc_dedup as (

    select
        patient_id
        , start_ts
        , min(encounter_id) as encounter_id
    from enc
    group by patient_id, start_ts

)

select
    cast(a.asserted_ts as date) as allergy_start_date
    , cast(null as date) as allergy_stop_date
    , cast(a.patient_id as varchar) as patient_id
    , cast(e.encounter_id as varchar) as encounter_id
    , cast(a.allergy_code as varchar) as allergy_code
    , cast(
        case a.code_system_uri
            when 'http://snomed.info/sct' then 'SNOMED-CT'
            when 'http://www.nlm.nih.gov/research/umls/rxnorm' then 'RxNorm'
            else a.code_system_uri
        end as varchar
    ) as allergy_code_system
    , cast(a.allergy_description as varchar) as allergy_description
    , cast(a.allergy_type as varchar) as allergy_type
    , cast(a.allergy_category as varchar) as allergy_category
    , cast(null as varchar) as reaction_1_code
    , cast(null as varchar) as reaction_1_description
    , cast(null as varchar) as reaction_1_severity
    , cast(null as varchar) as reaction_2_code
    , cast(null as varchar) as reaction_2_description
    , cast(null as varchar) as reaction_2_severity
from allergy as a
left join enc_dedup as e
    on a.patient_id = e.patient_id
    and a.asserted_ts = e.start_ts
```

## Mapping hints
- One row per value: an Observation with component[] gives one row per component (code and value from the component, date, patient, encounter and category from the parent); an Observation without components gives one row.
- date is effectiveDateTime (UTC); patient is subject.reference, the encounter is encounter.reference (R4) or context.reference (STU3), without the urn:uuid: prefix; category is category[0].coding[0].code.
- A valueQuantity gives type numeric, units = valueQuantity.unit and the value as text with exactly one decimal digit (163.34 is written 163.3, 71 is written 71.0). Other values give type text: the display of valueCodeableConcept.coding[0], or valueString.
- In DuckDB write (x->'$.path') IS NULL with the parentheses. Commas in text become spaces.
text:
```sql
WITH src AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        resource AS r
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'observation') }}
    WHERE (resource->>'$.resourceType') = 'Observation'
),

parent AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        r,
        timezone('UTC', CAST(r->>'$.effectiveDateTime' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) AS observation_datetime,
        replace(r->>'$.subject.reference', 'urn:uuid:', '') AS patient_id,
        replace(coalesce(r->>'$.context.reference', r->>'$.encounter.reference'), 'urn:uuid:', '') AS encounter_id,
        r->>'$.category[0].coding[0].code' AS observation_category,
        CASE
            WHEN (r->'$.component') IS NOT NULL
             AND json_array_length(r->'$.component') > 0
            THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE
        END AS has_components
    FROM src
),

items AS (
    SELECT
        observation_datetime, patient_id, encounter_id, observation_category,
        r AS item
    FROM parent
    WHERE NOT has_components

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        observation_datetime, patient_id, encounter_id, observation_category,
        unnest(from_json(r->'$.component', '["JSON"]')) AS item
    FROM parent
    WHERE has_components
)

SELECT
    CAST(observation_datetime AS TIMESTAMP) AS observation_datetime,
    CAST(observation_datetime AS DATE) AS observation_date,
    CAST(patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id,
    CAST(encounter_id AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id,
    CAST(observation_category AS VARCHAR) AS observation_category,
    CAST(item->>'$.code.coding[0].code' AS VARCHAR) AS observation_code,
    CAST(replace(item->>'$.code.coding[0].display', ',', ' ') AS VARCHAR) AS observation_description,
    CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN (item->'$.valueQuantity') IS NOT NULL
            THEN CAST(CAST(item->>'$.valueQuantity.value' AS DECIMAL(18,1)) AS VARCHAR)
            ELSE replace(
                    coalesce(item->>'$.valueCodeableConcept.coding[0].display',
                             item->>'$.valueString'),
                    ',', ' ')
        END AS VARCHAR) AS observation_value,
    CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN (item->'$.valueQuantity') IS NOT NULL
            THEN replace(item->>'$.valueQuantity.unit', ',', ' ')
            ELSE NULL
        END AS VARCHAR) AS observation_units,
    CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN (item->'$.valueQuantity') IS NOT NULL THEN 'numeric'
            ELSE 'text'
        END AS VARCHAR) AS observation_value_type
FROM items
```

```sql
WITH allergy AS (

    SELECT
        id AS resource_id
        , regexp_replace(resource->>'$.patient.reference', '^(urn:uuid:|Patient/)', '') AS patient_id
        , CAST(resource->>'$.assertedDate' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AS asserted_ts
        , resource->>'$.code.coding[0].code' AS allergy_code
        , resource->>'$.code.coding[0].system' AS fhir_system
        , COALESCE(resource->>'$.code.coding[0].display', resource->>'$.code.text') AS allergy_description
        , resource->>'$.type' AS allergy_type
        , resource->>'$.category[0]' AS allergy_category
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'allergyintolerance') }}

)

, encounter AS (

    SELECT
        regexp_replace(resource->>'$.subject.reference', '^(urn:uuid:|Patient/)', '') AS patient_id
        , CAST(resource->>'$.period.start' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AS start_ts
        , MIN(id) AS encounter_id
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'encounter') }}
    GROUP BY 1, 2

)

SELECT
    CAST((a.asserted_ts AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS allergy_start_date
    , CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS allergy_stop_date
    , CAST(a.patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id
    , CAST(e.encounter_id AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id
    , CAST(a.allergy_code AS VARCHAR) AS allergy_code
    , CAST(
        CASE a.fhir_system
            WHEN 'http://snomed.info/sct' THEN 'SNOMED-CT'
            WHEN 'http://www.nlm.nih.gov/research/umls/rxnorm' THEN 'RxNorm'
            ELSE a.fhir_system
        END AS VARCHAR) AS allergy_code_system
    , CAST(a.allergy_description AS VARCHAR) AS allergy_description
    , CAST(a.allergy_type AS VARCHAR) AS allergy_type
    , CAST(a.allergy_category AS VARCHAR) AS allergy_category
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS reaction_1_code
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS reaction_1_description
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS reaction_1_severity
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS reaction_2_code
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS reaction_2_description
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS reaction_2_severity
FROM allergy AS a
LEFT JOIN encounter AS e
    ON a.patient_id = e.patient_id
    AND a.asserted_ts = e.start_ts
```

- patient is patient.reference without the urn:uuid: prefix. The resource has no encounter reference: use the patient's Encounter whose period.start equals that timestamp.

```sql
WITH allergy AS (

    SELECT
        id AS resource_id
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.assertedDate') AS asserted_raw
        , replace(json_extract_string(resource, '$.patient.reference'), 'urn:uuid:', '') AS patient_id
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') AS allergy_code
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].system') AS system_url
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display') AS allergy_description
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.type') AS allergy_type
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.category[0]') AS allergy_category
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].code') AS reaction_1_code
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].display') AS reaction_1_description
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[0].severity') AS reaction_1_severity
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].coding[0].code') AS reaction_2_code
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].coding[0].display') AS reaction_2_description
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[1].severity') AS reaction_2_severity
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'allergyintolerance') }}

)

, allergy_ts AS (

    SELECT
        *
        , CAST(asserted_raw AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AS asserted_ts
    FROM allergy

)

, enc AS (

    SELECT
        replace(json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'), 'urn:uuid:', '') AS patient_id
        , CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start') AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AS start_ts
        , MIN(id) AS encounter_id
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'encounter') }}
    GROUP BY 1, 2

)

SELECT
    CAST(CAST(timezone('UTC', a.asserted_ts) AS DATE) AS DATE) AS allergy_start_date
    , CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS allergy_stop_date
    , CAST(a.patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id
    , CAST(e.encounter_id AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id
    , CAST(a.allergy_code AS VARCHAR) AS allergy_code
    , CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN lower(a.system_url) LIKE '%snomed%' THEN 'SNOMED-CT'
            WHEN lower(a.system_url) LIKE '%rxnorm%' THEN 'RxNorm'
            ELSE a.system_url
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS allergy_code_system
    , CAST(replace(a.allergy_description, ',', ' ') AS VARCHAR) AS allergy_description
    , CAST(a.allergy_type AS VARCHAR) AS allergy_type
    , CAST(a.allergy_category AS VARCHAR) AS allergy_category
    , CAST(a.reaction_1_code AS VARCHAR) AS reaction_1_code
    , CAST(replace(a.reaction_1_description, ',', ' ') AS VARCHAR) AS reaction_1_description
    , CAST(upper(a.reaction_1_severity) AS VARCHAR) AS reaction_1_severity
    , CAST(a.reaction_2_code AS VARCHAR) AS reaction_2_code
    , CAST(replace(a.reaction_2_description, ',', ' ') AS VARCHAR) AS reaction_2_description
    , CAST(upper(a.reaction_2_severity) AS VARCHAR) AS reaction_2_severity
FROM allergy_ts AS a
LEFT JOIN enc AS e
    ON a.patient_id = e.patient_id
    AND a.asserted_ts = e.start_ts
```

```sql
with allergy as (

    select
        id as source_id,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.patient.reference') as patient_ref,
        cast(json_extract_string(resource, '$.assertedDate') as timestamptz) as asserted_ts,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') as code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].system') as code_system,
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text')
        ) as description,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.type') as allergy_type,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.category[0]') as allergy_category
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'allergyintolerance') }}

),

encounter as (

    select
        coalesce(json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'), id) as encounter_id,
        replace(json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'), 'urn:uuid:', '') as patient_id,
        cast(json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start') as timestamptz) as start_ts
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'encounter') }}

),

allergy_prepared as (

    select
        source_id,
        replace(patient_ref, 'urn:uuid:', '') as patient_id,
        asserted_ts,
        code,
        case
            when code_system = 'http://snomed.info/sct' then 'SNOMED-CT'
            when code_system = 'http://www.nlm.nih.gov/research/umls/rxnorm' then 'RxNorm'
            else code_system
        end as code_system,
        description,
        allergy_type,
        allergy_category
    from allergy

),

matched as (

    select
        a.*,
        e.encounter_id,
        row_number() over (
            partition by a.source_id
            order by e.encounter_id
        ) as rn
    from allergy_prepared a
    left join encounter e
        on e.patient_id = a.patient_id
        and e.start_ts = a.asserted_ts

)

select
    cast((asserted_ts at time zone 'UTC') as date) as allergy_start_date,
    cast(null as date) as allergy_stop_date,
    cast(patient_id as varchar) as patient_id,
    cast(encounter_id as varchar) as encounter_id,
    cast(code as varchar) as allergy_code,
    cast(code_system as varchar) as allergy_code_system,
    cast(description as varchar) as allergy_description,
    cast(allergy_type as varchar) as allergy_type,
    cast(allergy_category as varchar) as allergy_category,
    cast(null as varchar) as reaction_1_code,
    cast(null as varchar) as reaction_1_description,
    cast(null as varchar) as reaction_1_severity,
    cast(null as varchar) as reaction_2_code,
    cast(null as varchar) as reaction_2_description,
    cast(null as varchar) as reaction_2_severity
from matched
where rn = 1
```

```sql
        , try_cast(nullif(trim("Date of death"), '') AS DATE) AS dod

        , row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY lower(trim("Member id")) ORDER BY "Member id") AS rn
    FROM {{ source('raw_claims', 'members') }}
    WHERE nullif(trim("Member id"), '') IS NOT NULL
)

, dedup AS (

)

, named AS (

        d.*
        , regexp_extract(d.full_name, '^(Mr\.|Mrs\.|Ms\.|Miss|Dr\.)\s+', 1) AS name_prefix
        , regexp_replace(d.full_name, '^(Mr\.|Mrs\.|Ms\.|Miss|Dr\.)\s+', '') AS name_rest

)

    , n.dob AS birth_date

    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS ssn
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS drivers_license_number

    , nullif(split_part(n.name_rest, ' ', 1), '') AS patient_first_name
```

```sql
        , nullif(trim("Date of death"), '') AS dod_raw
        , nullif(trim("Home_County"), '') AS county_raw
        , nullif(trim("Home_State"), '') AS state_raw
        , nullif(trim("Home_Zip code"), '') AS zip_raw
        , nullif(trim("Race code"), '') AS race_raw
        , nullif(trim("Ethnicity"), '') AS ethnicity_raw
        , nullif(trim("Gender code"), '') AS gender_raw
        , nullif(trim("Birth sex"), '') AS birth_sex_raw
        , nullif(trim("Name"), '') AS name_raw
        , row_number() OVER (
            PARTITION BY lower(trim("Member id"))
            ORDER BY "Date of death" DESC NULLS LAST, "Date of birth"
        ) AS rn
    FROM {{ source('raw_claims', 'members') }}
    WHERE nullif(trim("Member id"), '') IS NOT NULL

)

, states AS (

    SELECT
        lower(trim(state_name)) AS state_key
        , min(state_name) AS state_name
    FROM {{ ref('stg_map__states') }}
    GROUP BY 1

    UNION

    SELECT
        lower(trim(state_abbreviation)) AS state_key
        , min(state_name) AS state_name
    FROM {{ ref('stg_map__states') }}
    GROUP BY 1

)

, states_dedup AS (

    SELECT
        state_key
        , min(state_name) AS state_name
    FROM states
    GROUP BY 1

)

SELECT
    s.patient_id::VARCHAR AS patient_id
    , coalesce(
        try_cast(s.dob_raw AS DATE)
        , try_cast(try_strptime(s.dob_raw, '%m/%d/%Y') AS DATE)
        , try_cast(try_strptime(s.dob_raw, '%Y/%m/%d') AS DATE)
    )::DATE AS birth_date
    , coalesce(
        try_cast(s.dod_raw AS DATE)
        , try_cast(try_strptime(s.dod_raw, '%m/%d/%Y') AS DATE)
        , try_cast(try_strptime(s.dod_raw, '%Y/%m/%d') AS DATE)
    )::DATE AS death_date
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS ssn
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS drivers_license_number
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS passport_number
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS patient_prefix
    , CASE
        WHEN s.name_raw IS NULL THEN NULL
        ELSE split_part(s.name_raw, ' ', 1)
    END::VARCHAR AS patient_first_name
    , CASE
        WHEN s.name_raw IS NULL OR strpos(s.name_raw, ' ') = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE nullif(trim(substr(s.name_raw, strpos(s.name_raw, ' ') + 1)), '')
    END::VARCHAR AS patient_last_name
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS patient_suffix
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS maiden_name
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS marital_status
    , lower(s.race_raw)::VARCHAR AS race
    , lower(s.ethnicity_raw)::VARCHAR AS ethnicity
    , CASE
        WHEN upper(left(coalesce(s.gender_raw, s.birth_sex_raw), 1)) IN ('M', 'F')
            THEN upper(left(coalesce(s.gender_raw, s.birth_sex_raw), 1))
        ELSE NULL
    END::VARCHAR AS patient_gender
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS birthplace
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS patient_address
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS patient_city
    , coalesce(st.state_name, s.state_raw)::VARCHAR AS patient_state
    , s.county_raw::VARCHAR AS patient_county
    , CASE
        WHEN s.zip_raw IS NULL THEN NULL
        WHEN regexp_matches(s.zip_raw, '^[0-9]{1,4}$') THEN lpad(s.zip_raw, 5, '0')
        ELSE s.zip_raw
    END::VARCHAR AS patient_zip
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS patient_latitude
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS patient_longitude
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS healthcare_expenses
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS healthcare_coverage
FROM src AS s
LEFT JOIN states_dedup AS st
    ON lower(s.state_raw) = st.state_key
WHERE s.rn = 1
```

```sql
        , CASE
            WHEN name_raw LIKE '%,%'
                THEN trim(split_part(name_raw, ',', 1))
            WHEN strpos(name_raw, ' ') > 0
                THEN trim(substr(name_raw, strpos(name_raw, ' ') + 1))
        END AS last_name_p
        , upper(coalesce(gender_raw, birth_sex_raw)) AS gender_up
    FROM deduped AS d

)

SELECT
    p.member_id AS patient_id
    , p.birth_date_p AS birth_date
    , p.death_date_p AS death_date
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS ssn
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS drivers_license_number
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS passport_number
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS patient_prefix
    , nullif(p.first_name_p, '') AS patient_first_name
    , nullif(p.last_name_p, '') AS patient_last_name
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS patient_suffix
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS maiden_name
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS marital_status
    , lower(p.race_raw) AS race
    , lower(p.ethnicity_raw) AS ethnicity
    , CASE
        WHEN p.gender_up IN ('F', 'FEMALE') THEN 'F'
        WHEN p.gender_up IN ('M', 'MALE') THEN 'M'
        ELSE p.gender_up
    END AS patient_gender
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS birthplace
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS patient_address
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS patient_city
    , coalesce(s.state_name, p.state_raw) AS patient_state
    , p.county_raw AS patient_county
    , CASE
        WHEN p.zip_raw IS NULL THEN NULL
        ELSE lpad(left(p.zip_raw, 5), 5, '0')
    END AS patient_zip
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS patient_latitude
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS patient_longitude
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS healthcare_expenses
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS healthcare_coverage
FROM parsed AS p
LEFT JOIN states AS s
    ON lower(trim(p.state_raw)) = s.state_key
```

```sql
        , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS passport_number
        , CASE WHEN prefix_raw IS NOT NULL THEN prefix_raw || '.' END AS patient_prefix
        , NULLIF(SPLIT_PART(name_no_prefix, ' ', 1), '') AS patient_first_name
        , NULLIF(TRIM(SUBSTRING(name_no_prefix, LENGTH(SPLIT_PART(name_no_prefix, ' ', 1)) + 1)), '') AS patient_last_name
        , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS patient_suffix
        , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS maiden_name
        , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS marital_status
        , LOWER(race_code) AS race
        , LOWER(ethnicity) AS ethnicity
        , CASE
            WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(gender_code, birth_sex)) IN ('M', 'MALE') THEN 'M'
            WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(gender_code, birth_sex)) IN ('F', 'FEMALE') THEN 'F'
            ELSE UPPER(COALESCE(gender_code, birth_sex))
        END AS patient_gender
        , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS birthplace
        , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS patient_address
        , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS patient_city
        , COALESCE(
            (SELECT MIN(m.state_name) FROM {{ ref('stg_map__states') }} AS m
                WHERE UPPER(m.state_abbreviation) = UPPER(cte_name.home_state))
            , (SELECT MIN(m.state_name) FROM {{ ref('stg_map__states') }} AS m
                WHERE UPPER(m.state_name) = UPPER(cte_name.home_state))
            , home_state
        ) AS patient_state
        , home_county AS patient_county
        , CASE
            WHEN home_zip IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(home_zip) < 5 AND REGEXP_MATCHES(home_zip, '^[0-9]+$')
                THEN LPAD(home_zip, 5, '0')
            ELSE home_zip
        END AS patient_zip
        , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS patient_latitude
        , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS patient_longitude
        , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS healthcare_expenses
        , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS healthcare_coverage
```

```sql
    select
        lower(trim("Member id")) as member_id
        , try_cast(nullif(trim("Date of birth"), '') as date) as birth_date
        , try_cast(nullif(trim("Date of death"), '') as date) as death_date

        , nullif(trim("Home_State"), '') as home_state
        , nullif(trim("Home_Zip code"), '') as home_zip
        , nullif(trim("Race code"), '') as race
        , nullif(trim("Ethnicity"), '') as ethnicity
        , nullif(trim("Gender code"), '') as gender
    from {{ source('raw_claims', 'members') }}

)

, states as (

    select
        lower(trim(state_name)) as state_name_key
        , lower(trim(state_abbreviation)) as state_abbr_key
        , state_name
    from {{ ref('stg_map__states') }}

)

select
    m.member_id::varchar as patient_id
    , m.birth_date::date as birth_date
    , m.death_date::date as death_date
    , cast(null as varchar) as ssn
    , cast(null as varchar) as drivers_license_number
    , cast(null as varchar) as passport_number
    , cast(null as varchar) as patient_prefix
    , split_part(m.full_name, ' ', 1)::varchar as patient_first_name
    , nullif(trim(substr(m.full_name, strpos(m.full_name, ' ') + 1)), '')::varchar as patient_last_name
    , cast(null as varchar) as patient_suffix
    , cast(null as varchar) as maiden_name
    , cast(null as varchar) as marital_status
    , m.race::varchar as race
    , m.ethnicity::varchar as ethnicity
    , m.gender::varchar as patient_gender
    , cast(null as varchar) as birthplace
    , cast(null as varchar) as patient_address
    , cast(null as varchar) as patient_city
    , coalesce(s1.state_name, s2.state_name, m.home_state)::varchar as patient_state
    , m.home_county::varchar as patient_county
    , m.home_zip::varchar as patient_zip
    , cast(null as float) as patient_latitude
    , cast(null as float) as patient_longitude
    , cast(null as float) as healthcare_expenses
    , cast(null as float) as healthcare_coverage
from members m
left join states s1
    on lower(m.home_state) = s1.state_name_key
left join states s2
    on lower(m.home_state) = s2.state_abbr_key
```

```sql
with src as (

    select
        try_cast(nullif(trim("Claim service start date"), '') as date) as condition_start_date,
        cast(null as date) as condition_stop_date,
        lower(trim("Patient account number")) as patient_id,
        lower(trim("Medical record number")) as encounter_id,
        trim("Diagnosis code") as condition_code,
        trim("Diagnosis description") as condition_description,
        "Line number" as line_number
    from {{ source('raw_claims', 'claims') }}
    where nullif(trim("Diagnosis code"), '') is not null

),

dedup as (

    select
        *,
        row_number() over (
            partition by patient_id, encounter_id, condition_code, condition_start_date
            order by try_cast(line_number as integer)
        ) as rn
    from src

)

select
    cast(condition_start_date as date) as condition_start_date,
    cast(condition_stop_date as date) as condition_stop_date,
    cast(patient_id as varchar) as patient_id,
    cast(encounter_id as varchar) as encounter_id,
    cast(condition_code as varchar) as condition_code,
    cast(condition_description as varchar) as condition_description
from dedup
where rn = 1
```

## Mapping hints
- Diagnoses are claim lines with "Diagnosis code" filled; the patient is "Patient account number". The same diagnosis appears on many lines (later visits and drugs name it as their reason): return one row per patient, code, "Service (from) date" and "Service to date".
- The start date is "Service (from) date"; the stop date is "Service to date", where 1969-12-31 means no stop date. There is no encounter id: NULL.
text:
```sql
WITH diagnosis_lines AS (

    SELECT
        TRY_CAST(TRIM("Service (from) date") AS DATE) AS condition_start_date
        , TRY_CAST(TRIM("Service to date") AS DATE) AS stop_raw
        , LOWER(TRIM("Patient account number")) AS patient_id
        , TRIM("Diagnosis code") AS condition_code
        , TRIM("Diagnosis description") AS condition_description
    FROM {{ source('raw_claims', 'claims') }}
    WHERE "Diagnosis code" IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM("Diagnosis code") <> ''

)

, cte_conditions AS (

    SELECT
        condition_start_date
        , CASE
            WHEN stop_raw = DATE '1969-12-31' THEN NULL
            ELSE stop_raw
        END AS condition_stop_date
        , patient_id
        , condition_code
        , condition_description
    FROM diagnosis_lines

)

SELECT
    condition_start_date
    , condition_stop_date
    , patient_id
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id
    , condition_code
    , MIN(condition_description) AS condition_description
FROM cte_conditions
GROUP BY
    condition_start_date
    , condition_stop_date
    , patient_id
    , condition_code
```

## Mapping hints
- Diagnoses are claim lines with "Diagnosis code" filled; the patient is "Patient account number". The same diagnosis appears on many lines (later visits and drugs name it as their reason): return one row per patient, code, "Service (from) date" and "Service to date".
- The start date is "Service (from) date"; the stop date is "Service to date", where 1969-12-31 means no stop date. There is no encounter id: NULL.
text:
```sql
WITH diagnoses AS (

    SELECT
        CAST(substr(trim("Service (from) date"), 1, 10) AS DATE) AS condition_start_date
        , CAST(substr(trim("Service to date"), 1, 10) AS DATE) AS stop_raw
        , lower(trim("Patient account number")) AS patient_id
        , trim("Diagnosis code") AS condition_code
        , trim("Diagnosis description") AS condition_description
    FROM {{ source('raw_claims', 'claims') }}
    WHERE nullif(trim("Diagnosis code"), '') IS NOT NULL

)

, deduplicated AS (

    SELECT
        condition_start_date
        , CASE
            WHEN stop_raw = DATE '1969-12-31' THEN NULL
            ELSE stop_raw
        END AS condition_stop_date
        , patient_id
        , condition_code
        , min(condition_description) AS condition_description
    FROM diagnoses
    GROUP BY
        condition_start_date
        , stop_raw
        , patient_id
        , condition_code

)

SELECT
    condition_start_date
    , condition_stop_date
    , CAST(patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id
    , CAST(condition_code AS VARCHAR) AS condition_code
    , CAST(condition_description AS VARCHAR) AS condition_description
FROM deduplicated
```

```sql
-- Conditions are taken from the claim lines that carry a diagnosis.
-- Mapping:
--   patient_id         <- "Patient account number"
--   encounter_id       <- "Medical record number" (differs per claim, so it is the encounter id)
--   condition_code     <- "Diagnosis code"
--   condition_start_date <- "Claim service start date"
-- The export has no resolution date, so condition_stop_date is NULL.
-- Claim lines that repeat the same diagnosis within an encounter are collapsed to one row.
with src as (

    select
        try_cast(nullif(trim("Claim service start date"), '') as date) as condition_start_date,
        cast(null as date) as condition_stop_date,
        lower(trim("Patient account number")) as patient_id,
        lower(trim("Medical record number")) as encounter_id,
        trim("Diagnosis code") as condition_code,
        trim("Diagnosis description") as condition_description
    from {{ source('raw_claims', 'claims') }}
    where nullif(trim("Diagnosis code"), '') is not null

),

dedup as (

    select
        *,
        row_number() over (
            partition by patient_id, encounter_id, condition_code, condition_start_date
            order by condition_description
        ) as rn
    from src

)

select
    cast(condition_start_date as date) as condition_start_date,
    cast(condition_stop_date as date) as condition_stop_date,
    cast(patient_id as varchar) as patient_id,
    cast(encounter_id as varchar) as encounter_id,
    cast(condition_code as varchar) as condition_code,
    cast(condition_description as varchar) as condition_description
from dedup
where rn = 1
```

```sql
WITH cte_src AS (

    SELECT
        NULLIF(TRIM("Procedure date"), '') AS proc_date
        , NULLIF(TRIM("Patient account number"), '') AS patient_id
        , NULLIF(TRIM("Medical record number"), '') AS encounter_id
        , NULLIF(TRIM("Procedure code"), '') AS procedure_code
        , NULLIF(TRIM("Procedure description"), '') AS procedure_description
        , NULLIF(TRIM("Line submitted amount"), '') AS line_amount
    FROM {{ source('raw_claims', 'claims') }}
    WHERE NULLIF(TRIM("Procedure code"), '') IS NOT NULL

)

SELECT
    CAST(CAST(proc_date AS DATE) AS TIMESTAMP) AS procedure_start_datetime
    , CAST(proc_date AS DATE) AS procedure_start_date
    , CAST(CAST(proc_date AS DATE) AS TIMESTAMP) AS procedure_stop_datetime
    , CAST(proc_date AS DATE) AS procedure_stop_date
    , CAST(patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id
    , CAST(encounter_id AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id
    , CAST(procedure_code AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_code
    , CAST(procedure_description AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_description
    , CAST(line_amount AS FLOAT) AS procedure_base_cost
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_reason_code
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_reason_description
FROM cte_src
```

```sql
WITH src AS (

    SELECT
        NULLIF(TRIM("Procedure date"), '') AS proc_date
        , LOWER(NULLIF(TRIM("Patient account number"), '')) AS patient_id
        , LOWER(NULLIF(TRIM("Medical record number"), '')) AS encounter_id
        , NULLIF(TRIM("Procedure code"), '') AS procedure_code
        , NULLIF(TRIM("Procedure description"), '') AS procedure_description
        , NULLIF(TRIM("Line submitted amount"), '') AS line_amount
    FROM {{ source('raw_claims', 'claims') }}
    WHERE NULLIF(TRIM("Procedure code"), '') IS NOT NULL

)

, typed AS (

    SELECT
        CAST(TRY_CAST(proc_date AS DATE) AS TIMESTAMP) AS procedure_start_datetime
        , CAST(TRY_CAST(proc_date AS DATE) AS TIMESTAMP) AS procedure_stop_datetime
        , patient_id
        , encounter_id
        , procedure_code
        , CASE
            WHEN procedure_description IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN procedure_description LIKE '%)' THEN procedure_description
            ELSE procedure_description || ' (procedure)'
          END AS procedure_description
        , TRY_CAST(line_amount AS FLOAT) AS procedure_base_cost
    FROM src

)

SELECT
    procedure_start_datetime
    , CAST(procedure_start_datetime AS DATE) AS procedure_start_date
    , procedure_stop_datetime
    , CAST(procedure_stop_datetime AS DATE) AS procedure_stop_date
    , CAST(patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id
    , CAST(encounter_id AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id
    , CAST(procedure_code AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_code
    , CAST(procedure_description AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_description
    , CAST(procedure_base_cost AS FLOAT) AS procedure_base_cost
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_reason_code
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_reason_description
FROM typed
```

```sql
WITH cte_src AS (

    SELECT
        NULLIF(TRIM("Procedure code"), '') AS procedure_code
        , NULLIF(TRIM("Procedure description"), '') AS procedure_description
        , NULLIF(TRIM("Procedure date"), '') AS procedure_date_raw
        , LOWER(NULLIF(TRIM("Patient account number"), '')) AS patient_id
    FROM {{ source('raw_claims', 'claims') }}
    WHERE NULLIF(TRIM("Procedure code"), '') IS NOT NULL

)

, cte_dates AS (

    SELECT
        *
        , COALESCE(
            TRY_CAST(procedure_date_raw AS DATE)
            , CAST(TRY_STRPTIME(procedure_date_raw, '%m/%d/%Y') AS DATE)
            , CAST(TRY_STRPTIME(procedure_date_raw, '%Y/%m/%d') AS DATE)
        ) AS procedure_dt
    FROM cte_src

)

SELECT

    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS procedure_base_cost

    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_reason_description
FROM cte_dates
```

## Mapping hints
- Procedures are claim lines with "Procedure code" filled; the patient is "Patient account number"; code and description are "Procedure code" and "Procedure description".
- The export has a date but no time: use "Procedure date" for both start and stop. There is no encounter id, cost or reason: NULL.
text:
```sql
WITH src AS (

    SELECT
        NULLIF(TRIM("Procedure code"), '') AS procedure_code
        , NULLIF(TRIM("Procedure description"), '') AS procedure_description
        , NULLIF(TRIM("Procedure date"), '') AS procedure_date_raw
        , NULLIF(LOWER(TRIM("Patient account number")), '') AS patient_id
    FROM {{ source('raw_claims', 'claims') }}
    WHERE NULLIF(TRIM("Procedure code"), '') IS NOT NULL

)

, parsed AS (

    SELECT
        CAST(
            COALESCE(
                TRY_CAST(procedure_date_raw AS DATE)
                , TRY_CAST(TRY_STRPTIME(procedure_date_raw, '%m/%d/%Y') AS DATE)
            ) AS TIMESTAMP
        ) AS procedure_datetime
        , patient_id
        , procedure_code
        , procedure_description
    FROM src

)

SELECT
    procedure_datetime AS procedure_start_datetime
    , CAST(procedure_datetime AS DATE) AS procedure_start_date
    , procedure_datetime AS procedure_stop_datetime
    , CAST(procedure_datetime AS DATE) AS procedure_stop_date
    , CAST(patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id
    , CAST(procedure_code AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_code
    , CAST(procedure_description AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_description
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS procedure_base_cost
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_reason_code
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_reason_description
FROM parsed
```

```sql
WITH src AS (

    SELECT
        NULLIF(TRIM("Service (from) date"), '') AS start_raw
        , NULLIF(TRIM("Service to date"), '') AS stop_raw
        , NULLIF(TRIM("Patient account number"), '') AS patient_raw
        , NULLIF(TRIM("Claim payer identifier"), '') AS payer_raw
        , NULLIF(TRIM("Medical record number"), '') AS encounter_raw
        , NULLIF(TRIM("National drug code"), '') AS code_raw
        , NULLIF(TRIM("Drug cost"), '') AS drug_cost_raw
        , NULLIF(TRIM("Line primary payer paid amount"), '') AS payer_paid_raw
        , NULLIF(TRIM("Quantity dispensed"), '') AS dispenses_raw
        , NULLIF(TRIM("Line submitted amount"), '') AS total_raw
        , NULLIF(TRIM("Diagnosis code"), '') AS reason_code_raw
        , NULLIF(TRIM("Diagnosis description"), '') AS reason_desc_raw
    FROM {{ source('raw_claims', 'claims') }}
    WHERE LOWER(TRIM("Claim type")) = 'pharmacy'

)

, typed AS (

    SELECT
        CAST(TRY_CAST(start_raw AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP) AS medication_start_datetime
        , CAST(TRY_CAST(stop_raw AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP) AS medication_stop_datetime
        , LOWER(patient_raw) AS patient_id
        , LOWER(payer_raw) AS payer_id
        , LOWER(encounter_raw) AS encounter_id
        , code_raw AS medication_code
        , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS medication_description
        , CAST(TRY_CAST(drug_cost_raw AS DOUBLE) AS FLOAT) AS medication_base_cost
        , CAST(TRY_CAST(payer_paid_raw AS DOUBLE) AS FLOAT) AS medication_payer_coverage
        , CAST(TRY_CAST(dispenses_raw AS DOUBLE) AS FLOAT) AS dispenses
        , CAST(TRY_CAST(total_raw AS DOUBLE) AS FLOAT) AS medication_total_cost
        , reason_code_raw AS medication_reason_code
        , reason_desc_raw AS medication_reason_description
    FROM src

)

SELECT
    medication_start_datetime
    , CAST(medication_start_datetime AS DATE) AS medication_start_date
    , medication_stop_datetime
    , CAST(medication_stop_datetime AS DATE) AS medication_stop_date
    , CAST(patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id
    , CAST(payer_id AS VARCHAR) AS payer_id
    , CAST(encounter_id AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id
    , CAST(medication_code AS VARCHAR) AS medication_code
    , CAST(medication_description AS VARCHAR) AS medication_description
    , medication_base_cost
    , medication_payer_coverage
    , dispenses
    , medication_total_cost
    , CAST(medication_reason_code AS VARCHAR) AS medication_reason_code
    , CAST(medication_reason_description AS VARCHAR) AS medication_reason_description
FROM typed
```

```sql
WITH src AS (

    SELECT *
    FROM {{ source('raw_claims', 'claims') }}
    WHERE NULLIF(TRIM("National drug code"), '') IS NOT NULL

)

, typed AS (

    SELECT
        CAST(TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Service (from) date"), '') AS DATE) AS TIMESTAMP) AS medication_start_datetime
        , CAST(TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Service to date"), '') AS DATE) AS TIMESTAMP) AS medication_stop_datetime
        , NULLIF(TRIM("Patient account number"), '') AS patient_id
        , NULLIF(TRIM("Claim payer identifier"), '') AS payer_id
        , NULLIF(TRIM("Medical record number"), '') AS encounter_id
        , NULLIF(TRIM("National drug code"), '') AS medication_code
        , TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Drug cost"), '') AS DOUBLE) AS base_cost
        , TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Line primary payer paid amount"), '') AS DOUBLE) AS payer_coverage
        , TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Line submitted amount"), '') AS DOUBLE) AS total_cost
        , NULLIF(TRIM("Diagnosis code"), '') AS reason_code
        , NULLIF(TRIM("Diagnosis description"), '') AS reason_description
    FROM src

)

SELECT
    medication_start_datetime AS medication_start_datetime
    , CAST(medication_start_datetime AS DATE) AS medication_start_date
    , medication_stop_datetime AS medication_stop_datetime
    , CAST(medication_stop_datetime AS DATE) AS medication_stop_date
    , CAST(patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id
    , CAST(payer_id AS VARCHAR) AS payer_id
    , CAST(encounter_id AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id
    , CAST(medication_code AS VARCHAR) AS medication_code
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS medication_description
    , CAST(base_cost AS FLOAT) AS medication_base_cost
    , CAST(payer_coverage AS FLOAT) AS medication_payer_coverage
    , CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN base_cost IS NOT NULL AND base_cost > 0 AND total_cost IS NOT NULL
                THEN ROUND(total_cost / base_cost)
        END AS FLOAT
    ) AS dispenses
    , CAST(total_cost AS FLOAT) AS medication_total_cost
    , CAST(reason_code AS VARCHAR) AS medication_reason_code
    , CAST(reason_description AS VARCHAR) AS medication_reason_description
FROM typed
```

## Mapping hints
- Drugs are claim lines with "National drug code" filled (the column holds the RxNorm code the acquirer uses); the patient is "Patient account number".
- start is "Service (from) date" and stop is "Service to date", where 1969-12-31 means no stop. The export has dates without times.
- The reason is "Diagnosis code" and "Diagnosis description" of the same line. The payer identifier of the export is not one of the acquirer's payer ids and there is no encounter id: NULL for both.
text:
```sql
WITH cte_src AS (

    SELECT
        NULLIF(TRIM("Service (from) date"), '') AS start_raw
        , NULLIF(TRIM("Service to date"), '') AS stop_raw
        , NULLIF(TRIM("Patient account number"), '') AS patient_raw
        , NULLIF(TRIM("National drug code"), '') AS ndc
        , NULLIF(TRIM("Drug cost"), '') AS drug_cost
        , NULLIF(TRIM("Line payment amount"), '') AS payer_paid
        , NULLIF(TRIM("Quantity dispensed"), '') AS qty
        , NULLIF(TRIM("Line submitted amount"), '') AS submitted
        , NULLIF(TRIM("Diagnosis code"), '') AS dx_code
        , NULLIF(TRIM("Diagnosis description"), '') AS dx_desc
    FROM {{ source('raw_claims', 'claims') }}

)

, cte_drugs AS (

    SELECT *
    FROM cte_src
    WHERE ndc IS NOT NULL

)

, cte_typed AS (

    SELECT
        CAST(TRY_CAST(start_raw AS DATE) AS TIMESTAMP) AS medication_start_datetime
        , CASE
            WHEN stop_raw IS NULL OR stop_raw LIKE '1969-12-31%' THEN NULL
            ELSE CAST(TRY_CAST(stop_raw AS DATE) AS TIMESTAMP)
        END AS medication_stop_datetime
        , patient_raw AS patient_id
        , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS payer_id
        , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id
        , ndc AS medication_code
        , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS medication_description
        , CAST(TRY_CAST(drug_cost AS DOUBLE) AS FLOAT) AS medication_base_cost
        , CAST(TRY_CAST(payer_paid AS DOUBLE) AS FLOAT) AS medication_payer_coverage
        , CAST(TRY_CAST(qty AS DOUBLE) AS FLOAT) AS dispenses
        , CAST(TRY_CAST(submitted AS DOUBLE) AS FLOAT) AS medication_total_cost
        , dx_code AS medication_reason_code
        , dx_desc AS medication_reason_description
    FROM cte_drugs

)

SELECT
    CAST(medication_start_datetime AS TIMESTAMP) AS medication_start_datetime
    , CAST(medication_start_datetime AS DATE) AS medication_start_date
    , CAST(medication_stop_datetime AS TIMESTAMP) AS medication_stop_datetime
    , CAST(medication_stop_datetime AS DATE) AS medication_stop_date
    , CAST(patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id
    , CAST(payer_id AS VARCHAR) AS payer_id
    , CAST(encounter_id AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id
    , CAST(medication_code AS VARCHAR) AS medication_code
    , CAST(medication_description AS VARCHAR) AS medication_description
    , CAST(medication_base_cost AS FLOAT) AS medication_base_cost
    , CAST(medication_payer_coverage AS FLOAT) AS medication_payer_coverage
    , CAST(dispenses AS FLOAT) AS dispenses
    , CAST(medication_total_cost AS FLOAT) AS medication_total_cost
    , CAST(medication_reason_code AS VARCHAR) AS medication_reason_code
    , CAST(medication_reason_description AS VARCHAR) AS medication_reason_description
FROM cte_typed
```

```sql
WITH src AS (
    SELECT * FROM {{ source('raw_d1', 'member_master') }}
)

, states AS (
    SELECT
        upper(trim(state_abbreviation)) AS abbr
        , state_name
    FROM {{ ref('stg_map__states') }}
)

SELECT
    lower(trim(s.rec_uuid))::VARCHAR AS patient_id
    , s.dob::DATE AS birth_date
    , s.dod::DATE AS death_date
    , nullif(trim(s.national_id), '')::VARCHAR AS ssn
    , nullif(trim(s.licence_no), '')::VARCHAR AS drivers_license_number
    , nullif(trim(s.passport_no), '')::VARCHAR AS passport_number
    , nullif(trim(s.title), '')::VARCHAR AS patient_prefix
    , nullif(trim(s.given_nm), '')::VARCHAR AS patient_first_name
    , nullif(trim(s.family_nm), '')::VARCHAR AS patient_last_name
    , nullif(trim(s.name_suffix), '')::VARCHAR AS patient_suffix
    , nullif(trim(s.birth_family_nm), '')::VARCHAR AS maiden_name
    , nullif(upper(trim(s.marital_cd)), '')::VARCHAR AS marital_status
    , nullif(lower(trim(s.race_txt)), '')::VARCHAR AS race
    , nullif(lower(trim(s.ethnic_txt)), '')::VARCHAR AS ethnicity
    , nullif(left(upper(trim(s.sex_cd)), 1), '')::VARCHAR AS patient_gender
    , nullif(trim(s.born_in), '')::VARCHAR AS birthplace
    , nullif(trim(s.street), '')::VARCHAR AS patient_address
    , nullif(trim(s.town), '')::VARCHAR AS patient_city
    , coalesce(st.state_name, nullif(trim(s.region), ''))::VARCHAR AS patient_state
    , nullif(trim(s.district), '')::VARCHAR AS patient_county
    , (CASE
        WHEN nullif(trim(s.postcode), '') IS NULL THEN NULL
        WHEN regexp_matches(trim(s.postcode), '^[0-9]{1,4}$') THEN lpad(trim(s.postcode), 5, '0')
        ELSE trim(s.postcode)
      END)::VARCHAR AS patient_zip
    , s.geo_lat::FLOAT AS patient_latitude
    , s.geo_lon::FLOAT AS patient_longitude
    , s.lifetime_spend::FLOAT AS healthcare_expenses
    , s.lifetime_covered::FLOAT AS healthcare_coverage
FROM src AS s
LEFT JOIN states AS st
    ON upper(trim(s.region)) = st.abbr
```

## Mapping hints
- Drugs are claim lines with "National drug code" filled (the column holds the RxNorm code the acquirer uses); the patient is "Patient account number".
- start is "Service (from) date" and stop is "Service to date", where 1969-12-31 means no stop. The export has dates without times.
- The reason is "Diagnosis code" and "Diagnosis description" of the same line. The payer identifier of the export is not one of the acquirer's payer ids and there is no encounter id: NULL for both.
text:
```sql
WITH src AS (

    SELECT
        NULLIF(TRIM("National drug code"), '') AS ndc
        , TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Service (from) date"), '') AS DATE) AS start_d
        , TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Service to date"), '') AS DATE) AS stop_d
        , NULLIF(TRIM("Patient account number"), '') AS patient_id
        , NULLIF(TRIM("Drug cost"), '') AS drug_cost
        , NULLIF(TRIM("Line payment amount"), '') AS line_payment
        , NULLIF(TRIM("Line submitted amount"), '') AS line_submitted
        , NULLIF(TRIM("Quantity dispensed"), '') AS qty
        , NULLIF(TRIM("Diagnosis code"), '') AS dx_code
        , NULLIF(TRIM("Diagnosis description"), '') AS dx_desc
    FROM {{ source('raw_claims', 'claims') }}

)

, drugs AS (

    SELECT *
    FROM src
    WHERE ndc IS NOT NULL

)

SELECT
    CAST(start_d AS TIMESTAMP) AS medication_start_datetime
    , CAST(start_d AS DATE) AS medication_start_date
    , CAST(CASE WHEN stop_d = DATE '1969-12-31' THEN NULL ELSE stop_d END AS TIMESTAMP) AS medication_stop_datetime
    , CAST(CASE WHEN stop_d = DATE '1969-12-31' THEN NULL ELSE stop_d END AS DATE) AS medication_stop_date
    , CAST(patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS payer_id
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id
    , CAST(ndc AS VARCHAR) AS medication_code
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS medication_description
    , CAST(TRY_CAST(drug_cost AS DOUBLE) AS FLOAT) AS medication_base_cost
    , CAST(TRY_CAST(line_payment AS DOUBLE) AS FLOAT) AS medication_payer_coverage
    , CAST(TRY_CAST(qty AS DOUBLE) AS FLOAT) AS dispenses
    , CAST(TRY_CAST(line_submitted AS DOUBLE) AS FLOAT) AS medication_total_cost
    , CAST(dx_code AS VARCHAR) AS medication_reason_code
    , CAST(dx_desc AS VARCHAR) AS medication_reason_description
FROM drugs
```

```sql
WITH src AS (

    SELECT
        lower(trim(rec_uuid)) AS patient_id
        , dob
        , dod
        , nullif(trim(national_id), '') AS national_id
        , nullif(trim(licence_no), '') AS licence_no
        , nullif(trim(passport_no), '') AS passport_no
        , nullif(trim(title), '') AS title
        , nullif(trim(given_nm), '') AS given_nm
        , nullif(trim(family_nm), '') AS family_nm
        , nullif(trim(name_suffix), '') AS name_suffix
        , nullif(trim(birth_family_nm), '') AS birth_family_nm
        , nullif(upper(trim(marital_cd)), '') AS marital_cd
        , nullif(lower(trim(race_txt)), '') AS race_txt
        , nullif(lower(trim(ethnic_txt)), '') AS ethnic_txt
        , nullif(upper(trim(sex_cd)), '') AS sex_cd
        , nullif(trim(born_in), '') AS born_in
        , nullif(trim(street), '') AS street
        , nullif(trim(town), '') AS town
        , nullif(trim(region), '') AS region

        , geo_lat

        , lifetime_spend
        , lifetime_covered
    FROM {{ source('raw_d1', 'member_master') }}

, state_keys AS (

    FROM {{ ref('stg_map__states') }}
    GROUP BY 1

, state_lookup AS (

    FROM state_keys
    GROUP BY 1

)

SELECT
    s.patient_id::VARCHAR AS patient_id
    , s.dob::DATE AS birth_date
    , s.dod::DATE AS death_date
    , CASE
        WHEN length(regexp_replace(s.national_id, '[^0-9]', '', 'g')) = 9
            THEN substr(regexp_replace(s.national_id, '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), 1, 3) || '-'
                || substr(regexp_replace(s.national_id, '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), 4, 2) || '-'
                || substr(regexp_replace(s.national_id, '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), 6, 4)

    , s.title::VARCHAR AS patient_prefix
```
