```sql
    , s.marital_cd::VARCHAR AS marital_status
    , s.race_txt::VARCHAR AS race
    , s.ethnic_txt::VARCHAR AS ethnicity
    , s.sex_cd::VARCHAR AS patient_gender
    , s.born_in::VARCHAR AS birthplace
    , s.street::VARCHAR AS patient_address
    , s.town::VARCHAR AS patient_city
    , coalesce(m.state_name, s.region)::VARCHAR AS patient_state

    , s.geo_lon::FLOAT AS patient_longitude
    , s.lifetime_spend::FLOAT AS healthcare_expenses
```

```sql
        , NULLIF(TRIM(district), '') AS district

        , geo_lat

        UPPER(TRIM(state_name)) AS name_key
        , MAX(state_name) AS state_name
    FROM {{ ref('stg_map__states') }}

    , s.dob::DATE AS birth_date
    , s.dod::DATE AS death_date
    , CASE

            THEN SUBSTR(s.national_id, 1, 3) || '-' || SUBSTR(s.national_id, 4, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(s.national_id, 6, 4)
        ELSE s.national_id
      END::VARCHAR AS ssn

    , s.lifetime_spend::FLOAT AS healthcare_expenses
    , s.lifetime_covered::FLOAT AS healthcare_coverage
```

```sql
WITH src AS (

    SELECT *
    FROM {{ source('raw_d1', 'member_master') }}

)

, states AS (

    SELECT DISTINCT
        upper(trim(state_abbreviation)) AS state_abbreviation
        , state_name
    FROM {{ ref('stg_map__states') }}

)

, cleaned AS (

    SELECT
        lower(nullif(trim(s.rec_uuid), '')) AS patient_id
        , CAST(s.dob AS DATE) AS birth_date
        , CAST(s.dod AS DATE) AS death_date
        , nullif(trim(s.national_id), '') AS ssn
        , nullif(trim(s.licence_no), '') AS drivers_license_number
        , nullif(trim(s.passport_no), '') AS passport_number
        , nullif(trim(s.title), '') AS patient_prefix
        , nullif(trim(s.given_nm), '') AS patient_first_name
        , nullif(trim(s.family_nm), '') AS patient_last_name
        , nullif(trim(s.name_suffix), '') AS patient_suffix
        , nullif(trim(s.birth_family_nm), '') AS maiden_name
        , upper(nullif(trim(s.marital_cd), '')) AS marital_status
        , lower(nullif(trim(s.race_txt), '')) AS race
        , lower(nullif(trim(s.ethnic_txt), '')) AS ethnicity
        , upper(nullif(trim(s.sex_cd), '')) AS patient_gender
        , nullif(trim(s.born_in), '') AS birthplace
        , nullif(trim(s.street), '') AS patient_address
        , nullif(trim(s.town), '') AS patient_city
        , coalesce(st.state_name, nullif(trim(s.region), '')) AS patient_state
        , nullif(trim(s.district), '') AS patient_county
        , nullif(trim(s.postcode), '') AS patient_zip
        , CAST(s.geo_lat AS FLOAT) AS patient_latitude
        , CAST(s.geo_lon AS FLOAT) AS patient_longitude
        , CAST(s.lifetime_spend AS FLOAT) AS healthcare_expenses
        , CAST(s.lifetime_covered AS FLOAT) AS healthcare_coverage
    FROM src AS s
    LEFT JOIN states AS st
        ON upper(trim(s.region)) = st.state_abbreviation

)

SELECT
    patient_id
    , birth_date
    , death_date
    , ssn
    , drivers_license_number
    , passport_number
    , patient_prefix
    , patient_first_name
    , patient_last_name
    , patient_suffix
    , maiden_name
    , marital_status
    , race
    , ethnicity
    , patient_gender
    , birthplace
    , patient_address
    , patient_city
    , patient_state
    , patient_county
    , patient_zip
    , patient_latitude
    , patient_longitude
    , healthcare_expenses
    , healthcare_coverage
FROM cleaned
```

```sql
WITH states AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        TRIM(state_name) AS state_name
        , UPPER(TRIM(state_abbreviation)) AS state_abbreviation
    FROM {{ ref('stg_map__states') }}
)

, src AS (
    SELECT
        LOWER(NULLIF(TRIM(rec_uuid), '')) AS patient_id
        , dob AS birth_date
        , dod AS death_date
        , NULLIF(TRIM(national_id), '') AS ssn_raw
        , NULLIF(TRIM(licence_no), '') AS drivers_license_number
        , NULLIF(TRIM(passport_no), '') AS passport_number
        , NULLIF(TRIM(title), '') AS prefix_raw
        , NULLIF(TRIM(given_nm), '') AS patient_first_name
        , NULLIF(TRIM(family_nm), '') AS patient_last_name
        , NULLIF(TRIM(name_suffix), '') AS patient_suffix
        , NULLIF(TRIM(birth_family_nm), '') AS maiden_name
        , UPPER(NULLIF(TRIM(marital_cd), '')) AS marital_raw
        , LOWER(NULLIF(TRIM(race_txt), '')) AS race
        , LOWER(NULLIF(TRIM(ethnic_txt), '')) AS ethnicity
        , UPPER(NULLIF(TRIM(sex_cd), '')) AS gender_raw
        , NULLIF(TRIM(born_in), '') AS birthplace
        , NULLIF(TRIM(street), '') AS patient_address
        , NULLIF(TRIM(town), '') AS patient_city
        , NULLIF(TRIM(region), '') AS region_raw
        , NULLIF(TRIM(district), '') AS patient_county
        , NULLIF(TRIM(postcode), '') AS zip_raw
        , geo_lat
        , geo_lon
        , lifetime_spend
        , lifetime_covered
    FROM {{ source('raw_d1', 'member_master') }}
)

SELECT
    s.patient_id::VARCHAR AS patient_id
    , s.birth_date::DATE AS birth_date
    , s.death_date::DATE AS death_date
    , CASE
        WHEN REGEXP_MATCHES(s.ssn_raw, '^[0-9]{9}$')
            THEN SUBSTR(s.ssn_raw, 1, 3) || '-' || SUBSTR(s.ssn_raw, 4, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(s.ssn_raw, 6, 4)
        ELSE s.ssn_raw
      END::VARCHAR AS ssn
    , s.drivers_license_number::VARCHAR AS drivers_license_number
    , s.passport_number::VARCHAR AS passport_number
    , CASE
        WHEN s.prefix_raw IN ('Mr', 'Mrs', 'Ms', 'Dr') THEN s.prefix_raw || '.'
        ELSE s.prefix_raw
      END::VARCHAR AS patient_prefix
    , s.patient_first_name::VARCHAR AS patient_first_name
    , s.patient_last_name::VARCHAR AS patient_last_name
    , s.patient_suffix::VARCHAR AS patient_suffix
    , s.maiden_name::VARCHAR AS maiden_name
    , CASE
        WHEN s.marital_raw IN ('MARRIED') THEN 'M'
        WHEN s.marital_raw IN ('SINGLE') THEN 'S'
        ELSE s.marital_raw
      END::VARCHAR AS marital_status
    , s.race::VARCHAR AS race
    , s.ethnicity::VARCHAR AS ethnicity
    , CASE
        WHEN s.gender_raw IN ('MALE') THEN 'M'
        WHEN s.gender_raw IN ('FEMALE') THEN 'F'
        ELSE s.gender_raw
      END::VARCHAR AS patient_gender
    , s.birthplace::VARCHAR AS birthplace
    , s.patient_address::VARCHAR AS patient_address
    , s.patient_city::VARCHAR AS patient_city
    , COALESCE(st.state_name, s.region_raw)::VARCHAR AS patient_state
    , s.patient_county::VARCHAR AS patient_county
    , CASE
        WHEN REGEXP_MATCHES(s.zip_raw, '^[0-9]{1,4}$') THEN LPAD(s.zip_raw, 5, '0')
        ELSE s.zip_raw
      END::VARCHAR AS patient_zip
    , s.geo_lat::FLOAT AS patient_latitude
    , s.geo_lon::FLOAT AS patient_longitude
    , s.lifetime_spend::FLOAT AS healthcare_expenses
    , s.lifetime_covered::FLOAT AS healthcare_coverage
FROM src AS s
LEFT JOIN states AS st
    ON UPPER(s.region_raw) = st.state_abbreviation
    OR UPPER(s.region_raw) = UPPER(st.state_name)
```

```sql
with src as (
    select * from {{ source('raw_d1', 'member_master') }}
),

states as (
    select
        upper(trim(state_abbreviation)) as abbr_key,
        min(trim(state_name)) as state_name
    from {{ ref('stg_map__states') }}
    group by 1
),

state_names as (
    select
        upper(trim(state_name)) as name_key,
        min(trim(state_name)) as state_name
    from {{ ref('stg_map__states') }}
    group by 1
)

select
    cast(lower(nullif(trim(s.rec_uuid), '')) as varchar) as patient_id,
    cast(s.dob as date) as birth_date,
    cast(s.dod as date) as death_date,
    cast(nullif(trim(s.national_id), '') as varchar) as ssn,
    cast(nullif(trim(s.licence_no), '') as varchar) as drivers_license_number,
    cast(nullif(trim(s.passport_no), '') as varchar) as passport_number,
    cast(nullif(trim(s.title), '') as varchar) as patient_prefix,
    cast(nullif(trim(s.given_nm), '') as varchar) as patient_first_name,
    cast(nullif(trim(s.family_nm), '') as varchar) as patient_last_name,
    cast(nullif(trim(s.name_suffix), '') as varchar) as patient_suffix,
    cast(nullif(trim(s.birth_family_nm), '') as varchar) as maiden_name,
    cast(upper(nullif(trim(s.marital_cd), '')) as varchar) as marital_status,
    cast(lower(nullif(trim(s.race_txt), '')) as varchar) as race,
    cast(lower(nullif(trim(s.ethnic_txt), '')) as varchar) as ethnicity,
    cast(upper(nullif(trim(s.sex_cd), '')) as varchar) as patient_gender,
    cast(nullif(trim(s.born_in), '') as varchar) as birthplace,
    cast(nullif(trim(s.street), '') as varchar) as patient_address,
    cast(nullif(trim(s.town), '') as varchar) as patient_city,
    cast(coalesce(sa.state_name, sn.state_name, nullif(trim(s.region), '')) as varchar) as patient_state,
    cast(nullif(trim(s.district), '') as varchar) as patient_county,
    cast(nullif(trim(s.postcode), '') as varchar) as patient_zip,
    cast(s.geo_lat as float) as patient_latitude,
    cast(s.geo_lon as float) as patient_longitude,
    cast(s.lifetime_spend as float) as healthcare_expenses,
    cast(s.lifetime_covered as float) as healthcare_coverage
from src s
left join states sa
    on upper(trim(s.region)) = sa.abbr_key
left join state_names sn
    on upper(trim(s.region)) = sn.name_key
```

```sql
WITH src AS (

    SELECT
        lower(trim(id)) AS patient_id
        , CAST(try_strptime(nullif(trim(birthdate), ''), '%d-%b-%Y') AS DATE) AS birth_date
        , CAST(try_strptime(nullif(trim(deathdate), ''), '%d-%b-%Y') AS DATE) AS death_date
        , nullif(trim(ssn), '') AS ssn
        , nullif(trim(drivers), '') AS drivers_license_number
        , nullif(trim(passport), '') AS passport_number
        , nullif(trim(prefix), '') AS patient_prefix
        , nullif(trim(split_part(full_name, ',', 2)), '') AS patient_first_name
        , nullif(trim(split_part(full_name, ',', 1)), '') AS patient_last_name
        , nullif(trim(suffix), '') AS patient_suffix
        , nullif(trim(maiden), '') AS maiden_name
        , nullif(upper(trim(marital)), '') AS marital_status
        , nullif(lower(trim(race)), '') AS race
        , nullif(lower(trim(ethnicity)), '') AS ethnicity
        , nullif(upper(trim(gender)), '') AS patient_gender
        , nullif(trim(birthplace), '') AS birthplace
        , nullif(trim(address), '') AS patient_address
        , nullif(trim(split_part(city_state_zip, ',', 1)), '') AS patient_city
        , trim(regexp_replace(
            trim(substr(city_state_zip, strpos(city_state_zip, ',') + 1))
            , '\s*\d{5}(-\d{4})?$', '')) AS raw_state
        , nullif(regexp_extract(
            trim(substr(city_state_zip, strpos(city_state_zip, ',') + 1))
            , '(\d{5})(-\d{4})?$', 1), '') AS patient_zip
        , nullif(trim(county), '') AS patient_county
        , CAST(lat AS FLOAT) AS patient_latitude
        , CAST(lon AS FLOAT) AS patient_longitude
        , CAST(healthcare_expenses AS FLOAT) AS healthcare_expenses
        , CAST(healthcare_coverage AS FLOAT) AS healthcare_coverage
    FROM {{ source('raw_d2', 'patients') }}

)

, states AS (

    SELECT
        state_name
        , state_abbreviation
    FROM {{ ref('stg_map__states') }}

)

SELECT
    s.patient_id
    , s.birth_date
    , s.death_date
    , s.ssn
    , s.drivers_license_number
    , s.passport_number
    , s.patient_prefix
    , s.patient_first_name
    , s.patient_last_name
    , s.patient_suffix
    , s.maiden_name
    , s.marital_status
    , s.race
    , s.ethnicity
    , s.patient_gender
    , s.birthplace
    , s.patient_address
    , s.patient_city
    , coalesce(
        (SELECT min(m.state_name)
         FROM states m
         WHERE upper(m.state_abbreviation) = upper(s.raw_state)
            OR upper(m.state_name) = upper(s.raw_state))
        , nullif(s.raw_state, '')
      ) AS patient_state
    , s.patient_county
    , s.patient_zip
    , s.patient_latitude
    , s.patient_longitude
    , s.healthcare_expenses
    , s.healthcare_coverage
FROM src s
```

```sql
WITH src AS (

    SELECT
        nullif(trim(id), '') AS patient_id
        , coalesce(
            try_strptime(trim(birthdate), '%d-%b-%Y')
            , try_strptime(trim(birthdate), '%Y-%m-%d')
        )::DATE AS birth_date
        , coalesce(
            try_strptime(trim(deathdate), '%d-%b-%Y')
            , try_strptime(trim(deathdate), '%Y-%m-%d')
        )::DATE AS death_date
        , nullif(trim(ssn), '') AS ssn
        , nullif(trim(drivers), '') AS drivers_license_number
        , nullif(trim(passport), '') AS passport_number
        , nullif(trim(prefix), '') AS patient_prefix
        , nullif(trim(
            CASE WHEN position(',' IN full_name) > 0
                 THEN substr(full_name, position(',' IN full_name) + 1)
                 ELSE full_name END
        ), '') AS patient_first_name
        , nullif(trim(
            CASE WHEN position(',' IN full_name) > 0
                 THEN substr(full_name, 1, position(',' IN full_name) - 1)
                 ELSE NULL END
        ), '') AS patient_last_name
        , nullif(trim(suffix), '') AS patient_suffix
        , nullif(trim(maiden), '') AS maiden_name
        , nullif(trim(marital), '') AS marital_status
        , nullif(trim(race), '') AS race
        , nullif(trim(ethnicity), '') AS ethnicity
        , nullif(trim(gender), '') AS patient_gender
        , nullif(trim(birthplace), '') AS birthplace
        , nullif(trim(address), '') AS patient_address
        , nullif(trim(regexp_extract(trim(city_state_zip), '^(.*),\s*([^,]*?)(?:\s+(\d{5}))?$', 1)), '') AS city_raw
        , nullif(trim(regexp_extract(trim(city_state_zip), '^(.*),\s*([^,]*?)(?:\s+(\d{5}))?$', 2)), '') AS state_raw
        , nullif(trim(regexp_extract(trim(city_state_zip), '^(.*),\s*([^,]*?)(?:\s+(\d{5}))?$', 3)), '') AS patient_zip
        , nullif(trim(county), '') AS patient_county
        , lat
        , lon
        , healthcare_expenses
        , healthcare_coverage
    FROM {{ source('raw_d2', 'patients') }}

)

SELECT
    s.patient_id::VARCHAR AS patient_id
    , s.birth_date::DATE AS birth_date
    , s.death_date::DATE AS death_date
    , s.ssn::VARCHAR AS ssn
    , s.drivers_license_number::VARCHAR AS drivers_license_number
    , s.passport_number::VARCHAR AS passport_number
    , s.patient_prefix::VARCHAR AS patient_prefix
    , s.patient_first_name::VARCHAR AS patient_first_name
    , s.patient_last_name::VARCHAR AS patient_last_name
    , s.patient_suffix::VARCHAR AS patient_suffix
    , s.maiden_name::VARCHAR AS maiden_name
    , s.marital_status::VARCHAR AS marital_status
    , s.race::VARCHAR AS race
    , s.ethnicity::VARCHAR AS ethnicity
    , s.patient_gender::VARCHAR AS patient_gender
    , s.birthplace::VARCHAR AS birthplace
    , s.patient_address::VARCHAR AS patient_address
    , s.city_raw::VARCHAR AS patient_city
    , coalesce(m.state_name, s.state_raw)::VARCHAR AS patient_state
    , s.patient_county::VARCHAR AS patient_county

    , s.lat::FLOAT AS patient_latitude
```

```sql
        , lat

, parsed AS (

    SELECT
        src.*
        , regexp_extract(city_state_zip, '^(.*?),\s*([^,]*?)(?:\s+(\d{4,5}(?:-\d{4})?))?\s*$', 1) AS city_raw
        , regexp_extract(city_state_zip, '^(.*?),\s*([^,]*?)(?:\s+(\d{4,5}(?:-\d{4})?))?\s*$', 2) AS state_raw
        , regexp_extract(city_state_zip, '^(.*?),\s*([^,]*?)(?:\s+(\d{4,5}(?:-\d{4})?))?\s*$', 3) AS zip_raw
        , regexp_extract(full_name, '^(.*?),\s*(.*)$', 1) AS last_raw
        , regexp_extract(full_name, '^(.*?),\s*(.*)$', 2) AS first_raw
    FROM src

    , CAST(coalesce(
        try_strptime(p.birthdate, '%d-%b-%Y')
        , try_strptime(p.birthdate, '%Y-%m-%d')

    , CAST(coalesce(
        try_strptime(p.deathdate, '%d-%b-%Y')
        , try_strptime(p.deathdate, '%Y-%m-%d')
    ) AS DATE) AS death_date
    , p.ssn AS ssn
    , p.drivers AS drivers_license_number

    , p.prefix AS patient_prefix
    , nullif(trim(p.first_raw), '') AS patient_first_name

    , p.suffix AS patient_suffix
    , p.maiden AS maiden_name
    , upper(p.marital) AS marital_status
    , lower(p.race) AS race
    , lower(p.ethnicity) AS ethnicity
    , upper(p.gender) AS patient_gender
    , p.birthplace AS birthplace
    , p.address AS patient_address
    , nullif(trim(p.city_raw), '') AS patient_city
    , coalesce(sn.state_name, sa.state_name, nullif(trim(p.state_raw), '')) AS patient_state
    , p.county AS patient_county

    , CAST(p.healthcare_expenses AS FLOAT) AS healthcare_expenses

LEFT JOIN (

    ON lower(trim(p.state_raw)) = lower(sn.state_name)

    GROUP BY state_abbreviation
) AS sa
    ON lower(trim(p.state_raw)) = lower(sa.state_abbreviation)
```

```sql
WITH src AS (

    SELECT
        lower(trim(id)) AS patient_id
        , try_strptime(nullif(trim(birthdate), ''), '%d-%b-%Y')::DATE AS birth_date
        , try_strptime(nullif(trim(deathdate), ''), '%d-%b-%Y')::DATE AS death_date
        , nullif(trim(ssn), '') AS ssn
        , nullif(trim(drivers), '') AS drivers_license_number
        , nullif(trim(passport), '') AS passport_number
        , nullif(trim(prefix), '') AS patient_prefix
        , nullif(trim(split_part(full_name, ',', 2)), '') AS patient_first_name
        , nullif(trim(split_part(full_name, ',', 1)), '') AS patient_last_name
        , nullif(trim(suffix), '') AS patient_suffix
        , nullif(trim(maiden), '') AS maiden_name
        , nullif(upper(trim(marital)), '') AS marital_status
        , nullif(lower(trim(race)), '') AS race
        , nullif(lower(trim(ethnicity)), '') AS ethnicity
        , nullif(upper(trim(gender)), '') AS patient_gender
        , nullif(trim(birthplace), '') AS birthplace
        , nullif(trim(address), '') AS patient_address
        , nullif(trim(split_part(city_state_zip, ',', 1)), '') AS patient_city
        , trim(substr(city_state_zip, strpos(city_state_zip, ',') + 1)) AS state_zip
        , nullif(trim(county), '') AS patient_county
        , CAST(lat AS FLOAT) AS patient_latitude
        , CAST(lon AS FLOAT) AS patient_longitude
        , CAST(healthcare_expenses AS FLOAT) AS healthcare_expenses
        , CAST(healthcare_coverage AS FLOAT) AS healthcare_coverage
    FROM {{ source('raw_d2', 'patients') }}

)

, parsed AS (

    SELECT
        *
        , nullif(trim(regexp_replace(state_zip, '\s*[0-9]{5}(-[0-9]{4})?$', '')), '') AS state_raw
        , nullif(regexp_extract(state_zip, '([0-9]{5})(-[0-9]{4})?$', 1), '') AS patient_zip
    FROM src

)

, state_lookup AS (

    SELECT DISTINCT lower(state_abbreviation) AS k, state_name
    FROM {{ ref('stg_map__states') }}

    UNION

    SELECT DISTINCT lower(state_name) AS k, state_name
    FROM {{ ref('stg_map__states') }}

)

SELECT
    p.patient_id
    , p.birth_date
    , p.death_date
    , p.ssn
    , p.drivers_license_number
    , p.passport_number
    , p.patient_prefix
    , p.patient_first_name
    , p.patient_last_name
    , p.patient_suffix
    , p.maiden_name
    , p.marital_status
    , p.race
    , p.ethnicity
    , p.patient_gender
    , p.birthplace
    , p.patient_address
    , p.patient_city
    , coalesce(s.state_name, p.state_raw) AS patient_state
    , p.patient_county
    , p.patient_zip
    , p.patient_latitude
    , p.patient_longitude
    , p.healthcare_expenses
    , p.healthcare_coverage
FROM parsed AS p
LEFT JOIN state_lookup AS s
    ON lower(p.state_raw) = s.k
```

- Timestamps are split into <column>_date (MM/DD/YYYY) and <column>_time (HH:MM:SS), both in UTC.
- Date columns are text written DD-Mon-YYYY (03-Sep-1942).

```sql
WITH src AS (

    SELECT
        lower(trim(id)) AS patient_id
        , NULLIF(trim(birthdate), '') AS birthdate
        , NULLIF(trim(deathdate), '') AS deathdate
        , NULLIF(trim(ssn), '') AS ssn
        , NULLIF(trim(drivers), '') AS drivers
        , NULLIF(trim(passport), '') AS passport
        , NULLIF(trim(prefix), '') AS prefix
        , NULLIF(trim(full_name), '') AS full_name
        , NULLIF(trim(suffix), '') AS suffix
        , NULLIF(trim(maiden), '') AS maiden
        , NULLIF(trim(marital), '') AS marital
        , NULLIF(trim(race), '') AS race
        , NULLIF(trim(ethnicity), '') AS ethnicity
        , NULLIF(trim(gender), '') AS gender
        , NULLIF(trim(birthplace), '') AS birthplace
        , NULLIF(trim(address), '') AS address
        , NULLIF(trim(city_state_zip), '') AS csz
        , NULLIF(trim(county), '') AS county
        , lat
        , lon
        , healthcare_expenses
        , healthcare_coverage
    FROM {{ source('raw_d2', 'patients') }}

)

, parsed AS (

    SELECT
        *
        , NULLIF(trim(regexp_extract(csz, '^(.*), ([^,]*)$', 1)), '') AS city_raw
        , CASE
            WHEN regexp_matches(csz, ',') THEN trim(regexp_extract(csz, '^(.*), ([^,]*)$', 2))
            ELSE csz
          END AS rest
    FROM src

)

, parsed2 AS (

    SELECT
        *
        , NULLIF(regexp_extract(rest, '(\d{5})\s*$', 1), '') AS zip_raw
        , NULLIF(trim(regexp_replace(rest, '\s*\d{5}\s*$', '')), '') AS state_raw
    FROM parsed

)

SELECT
    patient_id::VARCHAR AS patient_id
    , CAST(strptime(birthdate, '%d-%b-%Y') AS DATE) AS birth_date
    , CAST(strptime(deathdate, '%d-%b-%Y') AS DATE) AS death_date
    , ssn::VARCHAR AS ssn
    , drivers::VARCHAR AS drivers_license_number
    , passport::VARCHAR AS passport_number
    , prefix::VARCHAR AS patient_prefix
    , NULLIF(trim(substr(full_name, strpos(full_name, ',') + 1)), '')::VARCHAR AS patient_first_name
    , NULLIF(trim(CASE WHEN strpos(full_name, ',') > 0
                       THEN substr(full_name, 1, strpos(full_name, ',') - 1)
                       ELSE full_name END), '')::VARCHAR AS patient_last_name
    , suffix::VARCHAR AS patient_suffix
    , maiden::VARCHAR AS maiden_name
    , upper(marital)::VARCHAR AS marital_status
    , lower(race)::VARCHAR AS race
    , lower(ethnicity)::VARCHAR AS ethnicity
    , upper(gender)::VARCHAR AS patient_gender
    , birthplace::VARCHAR AS birthplace
    , address::VARCHAR AS patient_address
    , city_raw::VARCHAR AS patient_city
    , COALESCE(
        (SELECT min(m.state_name) FROM {{ ref('stg_map__states') }} m
         WHERE upper(m.state_abbreviation) = upper(parsed2.state_raw))
        , state_raw
      )::VARCHAR AS patient_state
    , county::VARCHAR AS patient_county
    , zip_raw::VARCHAR AS patient_zip
    , CAST(lat AS FLOAT) AS patient_latitude
    , CAST(lon AS FLOAT) AS patient_longitude
    , CAST(healthcare_expenses AS FLOAT) AS healthcare_expenses
    , CAST(healthcare_coverage AS FLOAT) AS healthcare_coverage
```

```sql
WITH cte_enc AS (

    SELECT
        trim(id) AS encounter_id
        , strptime(trim(start_date) || ' ' || trim(start_time), '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S') AS start_dt
        , CASE
            WHEN nullif(trim(stop_date), '') IS NOT NULL AND nullif(trim(stop_time), '') IS NOT NULL
            THEN strptime(trim(stop_date) || ' ' || trim(stop_time), '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S')
          END AS stop_dt
        , trim(patient) AS patient_id
        , trim(organization) AS organization_id
        , trim(provider) AS provider_id
        , trim(payer) AS payer_id
        , trim(encounterclass) AS encounter_class
        , nullif(trim(code_display), '') AS code_display
        , nullif(trim(reason), '') AS reason
    FROM {{ source('raw_d2', 'encounters') }}

)

, cte_charges AS (

    SELECT
        trim(encounter_id) AS encounter_id
        , base_encounter_cost
        , total_claim_cost
        , payer_coverage
    FROM {{ source('raw_d2', 'encounter_charges') }}

)

, cte_final AS (

    SELECT
        e.encounter_id
        , CAST(e.start_dt AS TIMESTAMP) AS encounter_start_datetime
        , CAST(e.start_dt AS DATE) AS encounter_start_date
        , CAST(COALESCE(e.stop_dt, e.start_dt) AS TIMESTAMP) AS encounter_stop_datetime
        -- same convention as the acquirer's staging: start date takes precedence
        , COALESCE(CAST(e.start_dt AS DATE), CAST(COALESCE(e.stop_dt, e.start_dt) AS DATE)) AS encounter_stop_date
        , e.patient_id
        , e.organization_id
        , e.provider_id
        , e.payer_id
        , e.encounter_class
        , CASE
            WHEN strpos(e.code_display, ' | ') > 0
            THEN trim(substr(e.code_display, 1, strpos(e.code_display, ' | ') - 1))
            ELSE e.code_display
          END AS encounter_code
        , CASE
            WHEN strpos(e.code_display, ' | ') > 0
            THEN trim(substr(e.code_display, strpos(e.code_display, ' | ') + 3))
          END AS encounter_description
        , CAST(c.base_encounter_cost AS FLOAT) AS base_encounter_cost
        , CAST(c.total_claim_cost AS FLOAT) AS total_encounter_cost
        , CAST(c.payer_coverage AS FLOAT) AS encounter_payer_coverage
        , CASE
            WHEN strpos(e.reason, ' | ') > 0
            THEN trim(substr(e.reason, 1, strpos(e.reason, ' | ') - 1))
            ELSE e.reason
          END AS encounter_reason_code
        , CASE
            WHEN strpos(e.reason, ' | ') > 0
            THEN trim(substr(e.reason, strpos(e.reason, ' | ') + 3))
          END AS encounter_reason_description
    FROM cte_enc AS e
    LEFT JOIN cte_charges AS c
        ON e.encounter_id = c.encounter_id

)

FROM cte_final
```

```sql
WITH enc AS (

    SELECT
        lower(trim(id)) AS encounter_id
        , try_strptime(trim(start_date) || ' ' || trim(start_time), '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S') AS start_dt
        , try_strptime(trim(stop_date) || ' ' || trim(stop_time), '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S') AS stop_dt
        , lower(trim(patient)) AS patient_id
        , lower(trim(organization)) AS organization_id
        , lower(trim(provider)) AS provider_id
        , lower(trim(payer)) AS payer_id
        , lower(trim(encounterclass)) AS encounter_class
        , NULLIF(trim(code_display), '') AS code_display
        , NULLIF(trim(reason), '') AS reason
    FROM {{ source('raw_d2', 'encounters') }}

)

, charges AS (

    SELECT
        lower(trim(encounter_id)) AS encounter_id
        , base_encounter_cost
        , total_claim_cost
        , payer_coverage
    FROM {{ source('raw_d2', 'encounter_charges') }}

)

, cte_joined AS (

    SELECT
        e.encounter_id
        , e.start_dt AS encounter_start_datetime
        , COALESCE(e.stop_dt, e.start_dt) AS encounter_stop_datetime
        , e.patient_id
        , e.organization_id
        , e.provider_id
        , e.payer_id
        , e.encounter_class
        , CASE WHEN e.code_display IS NULL THEN NULL
               WHEN position('|' IN e.code_display) > 0
                   THEN NULLIF(trim(split_part(e.code_display, '|', 1)), '')
               ELSE e.code_display END AS encounter_code
        , CASE WHEN e.code_display IS NULL THEN NULL
               WHEN position('|' IN e.code_display) > 0
                   THEN NULLIF(trim(substr(e.code_display, position('|' IN e.code_display) + 1)), '')
               ELSE NULL END AS encounter_description
        , c.base_encounter_cost
        , c.total_claim_cost
        , c.payer_coverage
        , CASE WHEN e.reason IS NULL THEN NULL
               WHEN position('|' IN e.reason) > 0
                   THEN NULLIF(trim(split_part(e.reason, '|', 1)), '')
               ELSE e.reason END AS encounter_reason_code
        , CASE WHEN e.reason IS NULL THEN NULL
               WHEN position('|' IN e.reason) > 0
                   THEN NULLIF(trim(substr(e.reason, position('|' IN e.reason) + 1)), '')
               ELSE NULL END AS encounter_reason_description
    FROM enc AS e
    LEFT JOIN charges AS c
        ON e.encounter_id = c.encounter_id

)

SELECT
    CAST(encounter_id AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id
    , CAST(encounter_start_datetime AS TIMESTAMP) AS encounter_start_datetime
    , CAST(encounter_start_datetime AS DATE) AS encounter_start_date
    , CAST(encounter_stop_datetime AS TIMESTAMP) AS encounter_stop_datetime
    , COALESCE(CAST(encounter_start_datetime AS DATE), CAST(encounter_stop_datetime AS DATE)) AS encounter_stop_date
    , CAST(patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id
    , CAST(organization_id AS VARCHAR) AS organization_id
    , CAST(provider_id AS VARCHAR) AS provider_id
    , CAST(payer_id AS VARCHAR) AS payer_id
    , CAST(encounter_class AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_class
    , CAST(encounter_code AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_code
    , CAST(encounter_description AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_description
    , CAST(base_encounter_cost AS FLOAT) AS base_encounter_cost
    , CAST(total_claim_cost AS FLOAT) AS total_encounter_cost
    , CAST(payer_coverage AS FLOAT) AS encounter_payer_coverage
    , CAST(encounter_reason_code AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_reason_code
    , CAST(encounter_reason_description AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_reason_description
FROM cte_joined
```

```sql
WITH src AS (

    SELECT
        lower(trim(e."id")) AS encounter_id
        , strptime(trim(e."start_date") || ' ' || trim(e."start_time"), '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S') AS start_dt
        , CASE
            WHEN nullif(trim(e."stop_date"), '') IS NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE strptime(trim(e."stop_date") || ' ' || trim(e."stop_time"), '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S')
          END AS stop_dt
        , lower(trim(e."patient")) AS patient_id
        , lower(trim(e."organization")) AS organization_id
        , lower(trim(e."provider")) AS provider_id
        , lower(trim(e."payer")) AS payer_id
        , lower(trim(e."encounterclass")) AS encounter_class
        , trim(e."code_display") AS code_display
        , nullif(trim(e."reason"), '') AS reason
    FROM {{ source('raw_d2', 'encounters') }} AS e

)

, charges AS (

    SELECT
        lower(trim(c."encounter_id")) AS encounter_id
        , max(c."base_encounter_cost") AS base_encounter_cost
        , max(c."total_claim_cost") AS total_claim_cost
        , max(c."payer_coverage") AS payer_coverage
    FROM {{ source('raw_d2', 'encounter_charges') }} AS c
    GROUP BY 1

)

, joined AS (

    SELECT
        s.encounter_id
        , s.start_dt AS encounter_start_datetime
        , COALESCE(s.stop_dt, s.start_dt) AS encounter_stop_datetime
        , s.patient_id
        , s.organization_id
        , s.provider_id
        , s.payer_id
        , s.encounter_class
        , CASE
            WHEN strpos(s.code_display, ' | ') > 0
                THEN trim(substr(s.code_display, 1, strpos(s.code_display, ' | ') - 1))
            ELSE nullif(s.code_display, '')
          END AS encounter_code
        , CASE
            WHEN strpos(s.code_display, ' | ') > 0
                THEN nullif(trim(substr(s.code_display, strpos(s.code_display, ' | ') + 3)), '')
            ELSE NULL
          END AS encounter_description
        , ch.base_encounter_cost
        , ch.total_claim_cost AS total_encounter_cost
        , ch.payer_coverage AS encounter_payer_coverage
        , CASE
            WHEN s.reason IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN strpos(s.reason, ' | ') > 0
                THEN trim(substr(s.reason, 1, strpos(s.reason, ' | ') - 1))
            ELSE s.reason
          END AS encounter_reason_code
        , CASE
            WHEN s.reason IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN strpos(s.reason, ' | ') > 0
                THEN nullif(trim(substr(s.reason, strpos(s.reason, ' | ') + 3)), '')
            ELSE NULL
          END AS encounter_reason_description
    FROM src AS s
    LEFT JOIN charges AS ch
        ON s.encounter_id = ch.encounter_id

)

SELECT
    encounter_id::VARCHAR AS encounter_id
    , encounter_start_datetime::TIMESTAMP AS encounter_start_datetime
    , CAST(encounter_start_datetime AS DATE) AS encounter_start_date
    , encounter_stop_datetime::TIMESTAMP AS encounter_stop_datetime
    , COALESCE(CAST(encounter_start_datetime AS DATE), CAST(encounter_stop_datetime AS DATE)) AS encounter_stop_date
    , patient_id::VARCHAR AS patient_id
    , organization_id::VARCHAR AS organization_id
    , provider_id::VARCHAR AS provider_id
    , payer_id::VARCHAR AS payer_id
    , encounter_class::VARCHAR AS encounter_class
    , encounter_code::VARCHAR AS encounter_code
    , encounter_description::VARCHAR AS encounter_description
    , CAST(base_encounter_cost AS FLOAT) AS base_encounter_cost
    , CAST(total_encounter_cost AS FLOAT) AS total_encounter_cost
    , CAST(encounter_payer_coverage AS FLOAT) AS encounter_payer_coverage
    , encounter_reason_code::VARCHAR AS encounter_reason_code
    , encounter_reason_description::VARCHAR AS encounter_reason_description
FROM joined
```

```sql
            WHEN nullif(trim(e."stop_date"), '') IS NULL OR nullif(trim(e."stop_time"), '') IS NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE strptime(trim(e."stop_date") || ' ' || trim(e."stop_time"), '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S')
          END AS stop_dt
        , nullif(trim(e."patient"), '') AS patient_id
        , nullif(trim(e."organization"), '') AS organization_id
        , nullif(trim(e."provider"), '') AS provider_id
        , nullif(trim(e."payer"), '') AS payer_id
        , nullif(trim(e."encounterclass"), '') AS encounter_class
        , nullif(trim(e."code_display"), '') AS code_display
        , nullif(trim(e."reason"), '') AS reason
    FROM {{ source('raw_d2', 'encounters') }} AS e

)

, charges AS (

    SELECT
        lower(trim(encounter_id)) AS encounter_id
        , max(base_encounter_cost) AS base_encounter_cost
        , max(total_claim_cost) AS total_claim_cost
        , max(payer_coverage) AS payer_coverage
    FROM {{ source('raw_d2', 'encounter_charges') }}
    GROUP BY lower(trim(encounter_id))

)

, joined AS (

    SELECT
        s.encounter_id
        , s.start_dt AS encounter_start_datetime
        , COALESCE(s.stop_dt, s.start_dt) AS encounter_stop_datetime
        , s.patient_id
        , s.organization_id
        , s.provider_id
        , s.payer_id
        , s.encounter_class
        , CASE
            WHEN s.code_display IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN strpos(s.code_display, ' | ') > 0
                THEN trim(substr(s.code_display, 1, strpos(s.code_display, ' | ') - 1))
            ELSE s.code_display
          END AS encounter_code
        , CASE
            WHEN s.code_display IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN strpos(s.code_display, ' | ') > 0
                THEN trim(substr(s.code_display, strpos(s.code_display, ' | ') + 3))
            ELSE NULL
          END AS encounter_description
        , c.base_encounter_cost
        , c.total_claim_cost AS total_encounter_cost
        , c.payer_coverage AS encounter_payer_coverage
        , CASE
            WHEN s.reason IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN strpos(s.reason, ' | ') > 0
                THEN trim(substr(s.reason, 1, strpos(s.reason, ' | ') - 1))
            ELSE s.reason
          END AS encounter_reason_code
        , CASE
            WHEN s.reason IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN strpos(s.reason, ' | ') > 0
                THEN trim(substr(s.reason, strpos(s.reason, ' | ') + 3))
            ELSE NULL
          END AS encounter_reason_description
    FROM src AS s
    LEFT JOIN charges AS c
        ON s.encounter_id = c.encounter_id

)

    CAST(encounter_id AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id
    , CAST(encounter_start_datetime AS TIMESTAMP) AS encounter_start_datetime
    , CAST(encounter_start_datetime AS DATE) AS encounter_start_date
    , CAST(encounter_stop_datetime AS TIMESTAMP) AS encounter_stop_datetime

    , CAST(organization_id AS VARCHAR) AS organization_id
    , CAST(provider_id AS VARCHAR) AS provider_id
    , CAST(payer_id AS VARCHAR) AS payer_id
    , CAST(encounter_class AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_class
    , CAST(encounter_code AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_code
    , CAST(encounter_description AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_description
    , CAST(base_encounter_cost AS FLOAT) AS base_encounter_cost
    , CAST(total_encounter_cost AS FLOAT) AS total_encounter_cost
    , CAST(encounter_payer_coverage AS FLOAT) AS encounter_payer_coverage
    , CAST(encounter_reason_code AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_reason_code
```

## Mapping hints
- Timestamps are split into <column>_date (MM/DD/YYYY) and <column>_time (HH:MM:SS), both in UTC.
- Date columns are text written DD-Mon-YYYY (03-Sep-1942).
- code_display is the code, ' | ', then the description: split at the first ' | '.
- reason is the reason code, ' | ', then the reason description (NULL when there is no reason).
- The three cost columns are in raw_d2.encounter_charges, joined on encounter_id = id.
- All other columns keep the acquirer's source column names in lower case.
text:

```sql
WITH enc AS (

    SELECT
        e.id
        , e.patient
        , e.organization
        , e.provider
        , e.payer
        , e.encounterclass
        , e.code_display
        , e.reason
        , CAST(strptime(trim(e.start_date) || ' ' || trim(e.start_time), '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S') AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_dt
        , CAST(strptime(trim(e.stop_date) || ' ' || trim(e.stop_time), '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S') AS TIMESTAMP) AS stop_dt
        , c.base_encounter_cost
        , c.total_claim_cost
        , c.payer_coverage
    FROM {{ source('raw_d2', 'encounters') }} AS e
    LEFT JOIN {{ source('raw_d2', 'encounter_charges') }} AS c
        ON c.encounter_id = e.id

)

, final AS (

    SELECT
        id AS encounter_id
        , start_dt AS encounter_start_datetime
        , CAST(start_dt AS DATE) AS encounter_start_date
        , COALESCE(stop_dt, start_dt) AS encounter_stop_datetime
        , COALESCE(CAST(start_dt AS DATE), CAST(COALESCE(stop_dt, start_dt) AS DATE)) AS encounter_stop_date
        , patient AS patient_id
        , organization AS organization_id
        , provider AS provider_id
        , payer AS payer_id
        , encounterclass AS encounter_class
        , CASE
            WHEN strpos(code_display, ' | ') > 0
                THEN trim(substr(code_display, 1, strpos(code_display, ' | ') - 1))
            ELSE NULLIF(trim(code_display), '')
          END AS encounter_code
        , CASE
            WHEN strpos(code_display, ' | ') > 0
                THEN trim(substr(code_display, strpos(code_display, ' | ') + 3))
            ELSE NULL
          END AS encounter_description
        , CAST(base_encounter_cost AS FLOAT) AS base_encounter_cost
        , CAST(total_claim_cost AS FLOAT) AS total_encounter_cost
        , CAST(payer_coverage AS FLOAT) AS encounter_payer_coverage
        , CASE
            WHEN reason IS NULL OR trim(reason) = '' THEN NULL
            WHEN strpos(reason, ' | ') > 0
                THEN trim(substr(reason, 1, strpos(reason, ' | ') - 1))
            ELSE trim(reason)
          END AS encounter_reason_code
        , CASE
            WHEN reason IS NULL OR trim(reason) = '' THEN NULL
            WHEN strpos(reason, ' | ') > 0
                THEN trim(substr(reason, strpos(reason, ' | ') + 3))
            ELSE NULL
          END AS encounter_reason_description
    FROM enc

)

SELECT
    encounter_id
    , encounter_start_datetime
    , encounter_start_date
    , encounter_stop_datetime
    , encounter_stop_date
    , patient_id
    , organization_id
    , provider_id
    , payer_id
    , encounter_class
    , encounter_code
    , encounter_description
    , base_encounter_cost
    , total_encounter_cost
    , encounter_payer_coverage
    , encounter_reason_code
    , encounter_reason_description
FROM final
```

## Mapping hints
- Timestamps are split into <column>_date (MM/DD/YYYY) and <column>_time (HH:MM:SS), both in UTC.
- Date columns are text written DD-Mon-YYYY (03-Sep-1942).
- code_display is the code, ' | ', then the description: split at the first ' | '.
- reason is the reason code, ' | ', then the reason description (NULL when there is no reason).
- The three cost columns are in raw_d2.encounter_charges, joined on encounter_id = id.
- All other columns keep the acquirer's source column names in lower case.
text:
```sql
WITH cte_enc AS (

    SELECT
        lower(trim(e."id")) AS encounter_id
        , strptime(trim(e."start_date") || ' ' || trim(e."start_time"), '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S') AS start_dt
        , strptime(trim(e."stop_date") || ' ' || trim(e."stop_time"), '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S') AS stop_dt
        , lower(trim(e."patient")) AS patient_id
        , lower(trim(e."organization")) AS organization_id
        , lower(trim(e."provider")) AS provider_id
        , lower(trim(e."payer")) AS payer_id
        , e."encounterclass" AS encounter_class
        , e."code_display" AS code_display
        , NULLIF(trim(e."reason"), '') AS reason
    FROM {{ source('raw_d2', 'encounters') }} AS e

)

, cte_charges AS (

    SELECT
        lower(trim("encounter_id")) AS encounter_id
        , "base_encounter_cost" AS base_encounter_cost
        , "total_claim_cost" AS total_claim_cost
        , "payer_coverage" AS payer_coverage
    FROM {{ source('raw_d2', 'encounter_charges') }}

)

, cte_joined AS (

    SELECT
        e.encounter_id
        , e.start_dt AS encounter_start_datetime
        , COALESCE(e.stop_dt, e.start_dt) AS encounter_stop_datetime
        , e.patient_id
        , e.organization_id
        , e.provider_id
        , e.payer_id
        , e.encounter_class
        , CASE WHEN strpos(e.code_display, ' | ') > 0
               THEN substr(e.code_display, 1, strpos(e.code_display, ' | ') - 1)
               ELSE e.code_display END AS encounter_code
        , CASE WHEN strpos(e.code_display, ' | ') > 0
               THEN substr(e.code_display, strpos(e.code_display, ' | ') + 3)
               ELSE NULL END AS encounter_description
        , c.base_encounter_cost
        , c.total_claim_cost AS total_encounter_cost
        , c.payer_coverage AS encounter_payer_coverage
        , CASE WHEN e.reason IS NULL THEN NULL
               WHEN strpos(e.reason, ' | ') > 0
               THEN substr(e.reason, 1, strpos(e.reason, ' | ') - 1)
               ELSE e.reason END AS encounter_reason_code
        , CASE WHEN e.reason IS NULL THEN NULL
               WHEN strpos(e.reason, ' | ') > 0
               THEN substr(e.reason, strpos(e.reason, ' | ') + 3)
               ELSE NULL END AS encounter_reason_description
    FROM cte_enc AS e
    LEFT JOIN cte_charges AS c
        ON e.encounter_id = c.encounter_id

)

SELECT
    CAST(encounter_id AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id
    , CAST(encounter_start_datetime AS TIMESTAMP) AS encounter_start_datetime
    , CAST(encounter_start_datetime AS DATE) AS encounter_start_date
    , CAST(encounter_stop_datetime AS TIMESTAMP) AS encounter_stop_datetime
    , COALESCE(CAST(encounter_start_datetime AS DATE), CAST(encounter_stop_datetime AS DATE)) AS encounter_stop_date
    , CAST(patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id
    , CAST(organization_id AS VARCHAR) AS organization_id
    , CAST(provider_id AS VARCHAR) AS provider_id
    , CAST(payer_id AS VARCHAR) AS payer_id
    , CAST(encounter_class AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_class
    , CAST(encounter_code AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_code
    , CAST(encounter_description AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_description
    , CAST(base_encounter_cost AS FLOAT) AS base_encounter_cost
    , CAST(total_encounter_cost AS FLOAT) AS total_encounter_cost
    , CAST(encounter_payer_coverage AS FLOAT) AS encounter_payer_coverage
    , CAST(encounter_reason_code AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_reason_code
    , CAST(encounter_reason_description AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_reason_description
FROM cte_joined
```

```sql
WITH src AS (

    SELECT
        NULLIF(TRIM("start"), '') AS start_raw
        , NULLIF(TRIM("stop"), '') AS stop_raw
        , LOWER(TRIM(patient)) AS patient_id
        , LOWER(TRIM(encounter)) AS encounter_id
        , TRIM(code_display) AS code_display
    FROM {{ source('raw_d2', 'conditions') }}

)

SELECT
    CAST(TRY_STRPTIME(INITCAP(start_raw), '%d-%b-%Y') AS DATE) AS condition_start_date
    , CAST(TRY_STRPTIME(INITCAP(stop_raw), '%d-%b-%Y') AS DATE) AS condition_stop_date
    , CAST(patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id
    , CAST(encounter_id AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id
    , CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN STRPOS(code_display, ' | ') > 0
                THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(code_display, 1, STRPOS(code_display, ' | ') - 1))
            ELSE code_display
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS condition_code
    , CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN STRPOS(code_display, ' | ') > 0
                THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(code_display, STRPOS(code_display, ' | ') + 3))
            ELSE NULL
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS condition_description
FROM src
```

```sql
        , nullif(trim("code_display"), '') AS code_display
```

```sql
        , NULLIF(TRIM("stop"), '') AS stop_txt
        , NULLIF(TRIM(patient), '') AS patient
        , NULLIF(TRIM(encounter), '') AS encounter
        , NULLIF(TRIM(code_display), '') AS code_display
        , NULLIF(TRIM("system"), '') AS code_system
        , NULLIF(TRIM("type"), '') AS allergy_type
        , NULLIF(TRIM(category), '') AS allergy_category
        , NULLIF(TRIM(reaction1), '') AS reaction1
        , NULLIF(TRIM(description1), '') AS description1
        , NULLIF(TRIM(severity1), '') AS severity1
        , NULLIF(TRIM(reaction2), '') AS reaction2
        , NULLIF(TRIM(description2), '') AS description2
        , NULLIF(TRIM(severity2), '') AS severity2
    FROM {{ source('raw_d2', 'allergies') }}
)

SELECT
    CAST(try_strptime(start_txt, '%d-%b-%Y') AS DATE) AS allergy_start_date
    , CAST(try_strptime(stop_txt, '%d-%b-%Y') AS DATE) AS allergy_stop_date
    , CAST(LOWER(patient) AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id
    , CAST(LOWER(encounter) AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id
    , CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN strpos(code_display, ' | ') > 0
                THEN NULLIF(TRIM(substr(code_display, 1, strpos(code_display, ' | ') - 1)), '')
            ELSE code_display
        END AS VARCHAR) AS allergy_code
    , CAST(code_system AS VARCHAR) AS allergy_code_system
    , CAST(

    , CAST(reaction2 AS VARCHAR) AS reaction_2_code
    , CAST(description2 AS VARCHAR) AS reaction_2_description
    , CAST(UPPER(severity2) AS VARCHAR) AS reaction_2_severity
```

```sql
with src as (
    select * from {{ source('raw_d3', 'patients') }}
),

codes as (
    select
        lower(trim(list_name)) as list_name,
        trim(local_code) as local_code,
        trim(standard_value) as standard_value
    from {{ source('raw_d3', 'code_map') }}
),

states as (
    select
        lower(trim(state_name)) as state_key,
        state_name,
        state_abbreviation
    from {{ ref('stg_map__states') }}
),

joined as (
    select
        s.*,
        (select max(c.standard_value) from codes c
            where c.list_name in ('marital', 'marital_status')
              and c.local_code = trim(s."MARITAL")) as marital_std,
        (select max(c.standard_value) from codes c
            where c.list_name = 'race'
              and c.local_code = trim(s."RACE")) as race_std,
        (select max(c.standard_value) from codes c
            where c.list_name = 'ethnicity'
              and c.local_code = trim(s."ETHNICITY")) as ethnicity_std,
        (select max(c.standard_value) from codes c
            where c.list_name = 'gender'
              and c.local_code = trim(s."GENDER")) as gender_std,
        (select max(st.state_name) from states st
            where st.state_key = lower(trim(s."STATE"))
               or lower(st.state_abbreviation) = lower(trim(s."STATE"))) as state_std
    from src s
)

select
    cast(nullif(trim("Id"), '') as varchar) as patient_id,
    cast("BIRTHDATE" as date) as birth_date,
    cast("DEATHDATE" as date) as death_date,
    cast(nullif(trim("SSN"), '') as varchar) as ssn,
    cast(nullif(trim("DRIVERS"), '') as varchar) as drivers_license_number,
    cast(nullif(trim("PASSPORT"), '') as varchar) as passport_number,
    cast(nullif(trim("PREFIX"), '') as varchar) as patient_prefix,
    cast(nullif(trim("FIRST"), '') as varchar) as patient_first_name,
    cast(nullif(trim("LAST"), '') as varchar) as patient_last_name,
    cast(nullif(trim("SUFFIX"), '') as varchar) as patient_suffix,
    cast(nullif(trim("MAIDEN"), '') as varchar) as maiden_name,
    cast(coalesce(marital_std, nullif(trim("MARITAL"), '')) as varchar) as marital_status,
    cast(coalesce(race_std, nullif(trim("RACE"), '')) as varchar) as race,
    cast(coalesce(ethnicity_std, nullif(trim("ETHNICITY"), '')) as varchar) as ethnicity,
    cast(coalesce(gender_std, nullif(trim("GENDER"), '')) as varchar) as patient_gender,
    cast(nullif(trim("BIRTHPLACE"), '') as varchar) as birthplace,
    cast(nullif(trim("ADDRESS"), '') as varchar) as patient_address,
    cast(nullif(trim("CITY"), '') as varchar) as patient_city,
    cast(coalesce(state_std, nullif(trim("STATE"), '')) as varchar) as patient_state,
    cast(nullif(trim("COUNTY"), '') as varchar) as patient_county,
    cast(
        case
            when nullif(trim("ZIP"), '') is null then null
            when regexp_matches(trim("ZIP"), '^[0-9]{1,4}$') then lpad(trim("ZIP"), 5, '0')
            else left(trim("ZIP"), 5)
        end as varchar
    ) as patient_zip,
    cast("LAT" as float) as patient_latitude,
    cast("LON" as float) as patient_longitude,
    cast("HEALTHCARE_EXPENSES" as float) as healthcare_expenses,
    cast("HEALTHCARE_COVERAGE" as float) as healthcare_coverage
from joined
```

```sql
with src as (
    select * from {{ source('raw_d3', 'patients') }}
),

cm as (
    select list_name, trim(local_code) as local_code, standard_value
    from {{ source('raw_d3', 'code_map') }}
)

select
    lower(trim(p."Id"))::varchar as patient_id,
    p."BIRTHDATE"::date as birth_date,
    p."DEATHDATE"::date as death_date,
    case
        when regexp_matches(trim(p."SSN"), '^[0-9]{9}$')
            then substr(trim(p."SSN"), 1, 3) || '-' || substr(trim(p."SSN"), 4, 2) || '-' || substr(trim(p."SSN"), 6, 4)
        else nullif(trim(p."SSN"), '')
    end::varchar as ssn,
    nullif(trim(p."DRIVERS"), '')::varchar as drivers_license_number,
    nullif(trim(p."PASSPORT"), '')::varchar as passport_number,
    nullif(trim(p."PREFIX"), '')::varchar as patient_prefix,
    nullif(trim(p."FIRST"), '')::varchar as patient_first_name,
    nullif(trim(p."LAST"), '')::varchar as patient_last_name,
    nullif(trim(p."SUFFIX"), '')::varchar as patient_suffix,
    nullif(trim(p."MAIDEN"), '')::varchar as maiden_name,
    case when nullif(trim(p."MARITAL"), '') is null then null
         else coalesce(m_mar.standard_value, trim(p."MARITAL")) end::varchar as marital_status,
    case when nullif(trim(p."RACE"), '') is null then null
         else coalesce(m_race.standard_value, trim(p."RACE")) end::varchar as race,
    case when nullif(trim(p."ETHNICITY"), '') is null then null
         else coalesce(m_eth.standard_value, trim(p."ETHNICITY")) end::varchar as ethnicity,
    case when nullif(trim(p."GENDER"), '') is null then null
         else coalesce(m_gen.standard_value, trim(p."GENDER")) end::varchar as patient_gender,
    nullif(trim(p."BIRTHPLACE"), '')::varchar as birthplace,
    nullif(trim(p."ADDRESS"), '')::varchar as patient_address,
    nullif(trim(p."CITY"), '')::varchar as patient_city,
    coalesce(st.state_name, nullif(trim(p."STATE"), ''))::varchar as patient_state,
    nullif(trim(p."COUNTY"), '')::varchar as patient_county,
    nullif(trim(p."ZIP"), '')::varchar as patient_zip,
    p."LAT"::float as patient_latitude,
    p."LON"::float as patient_longitude,
    p."HEALTHCARE_EXPENSES"::float as healthcare_expenses,
    p."HEALTHCARE_COVERAGE"::float as healthcare_coverage
from src p
left join cm m_mar
    on m_mar.list_name in ('marital', 'marital_status')
   and m_mar.local_code = trim(p."MARITAL")
left join cm m_race
    on m_race.list_name = 'race'
   and m_race.local_code = trim(p."RACE")
left join cm m_eth
    on m_eth.list_name = 'ethnicity'
   and m_eth.local_code = trim(p."ETHNICITY")
left join cm m_gen
    on m_gen.list_name = 'gender'
   and m_gen.local_code = trim(p."GENDER")
left join {{ ref('stg_map__states') }} st
    on upper(trim(p."STATE")) = upper(st.state_abbreviation)
```

```sql
    nullif(trim(s."ZIP"), '')::varchar as patient_zip,

    s."LON"::float as patient_longitude,
    s."HEALTHCARE_EXPENSES"::float as healthcare_expenses,
    s."HEALTHCARE_COVERAGE"::float as healthcare_coverage
from src s
left join cm m
    on m.list_name in ('marital', 'marital_status', 'marital status')

left join cm r
    on r.list_name = 'race'
   and r.local_code = trim(s."RACE")
left join cm e

   and e.local_code = trim(s."ETHNICITY")
left join cm g
    on g.list_name = 'gender'
   and g.local_code = trim(s."GENDER")
left join states_u st
    on st.k = lower(trim(s."STATE"))
```

```sql
    FROM {{ source('raw_d3', 'patients') }}
)

    GROUP BY 1, 2
)

SELECT
    lower(trim(p."Id"))::VARCHAR AS patient_id
    , p."BIRTHDATE"::DATE AS birth_date
    , p."DEATHDATE"::DATE AS death_date
    , nullif(trim(p."SSN"), '')::VARCHAR AS ssn
    , nullif(trim(p."DRIVERS"), '')::VARCHAR AS drivers_license_number
    , nullif(trim(p."PASSPORT"), '')::VARCHAR AS passport_number
    , nullif(trim(p."PREFIX"), '')::VARCHAR AS patient_prefix
    , nullif(trim(p."FIRST"), '')::VARCHAR AS patient_first_name
    , nullif(trim(p."LAST"), '')::VARCHAR AS patient_last_name
    , nullif(trim(p."SUFFIX"), '')::VARCHAR AS patient_suffix
    , nullif(trim(p."MAIDEN"), '')::VARCHAR AS maiden_name
    , cm.standard_value::VARCHAR AS marital_status
    , cr.standard_value::VARCHAR AS race
    , ce.standard_value::VARCHAR AS ethnicity
    , cg.standard_value::VARCHAR AS patient_gender
    , nullif(trim(p."BIRTHPLACE"), '')::VARCHAR AS birthplace
    , nullif(trim(p."ADDRESS"), '')::VARCHAR AS patient_address
    , nullif(trim(p."CITY"), '')::VARCHAR AS patient_city
    , coalesce(s.state_name, nullif(trim(p."STATE"), ''))::VARCHAR AS patient_state
    , nullif(trim(p."COUNTY"), '')::VARCHAR AS patient_county
    , nullif(trim(p."ZIP"), '')::VARCHAR AS patient_zip
    , p."LAT"::FLOAT AS patient_latitude
    , p."LON"::FLOAT AS patient_longitude
    , p."HEALTHCARE_EXPENSES"::FLOAT AS healthcare_expenses
    , p."HEALTHCARE_COVERAGE"::FLOAT AS healthcare_coverage
FROM src AS p

LEFT JOIN codes AS cm
    ON cm.list_name = 'marital' AND cm.local_code = lower(trim(p."MARITAL"))
LEFT JOIN codes AS cr
    ON cr.list_name = 'race' AND cr.local_code = lower(trim(p."RACE"))
LEFT JOIN codes AS ce
    ON ce.list_name = 'ethnicity' AND ce.local_code = lower(trim(p."ETHNICITY"))
LEFT JOIN {{ ref('stg_map__states') }} AS s
    ON upper(trim(p."STATE")) = upper(s.state_abbreviation)
```

```sql
        , NULLIF(TRIM("MAIDEN"), '') AS maiden

        , NULLIF(TRIM("ETHNICITY"), '') AS ethnicity
```

```sql
WITH src AS (
    SELECT * FROM {{ source('raw_d3', 'patients') }}
)

, codes AS (
    SELECT
        lower(trim(list_name)) AS list_name
        , trim(local_code) AS local_code
        , max(trim(standard_value)) AS standard_value
    FROM {{ source('raw_d3', 'code_map') }}
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)

, states AS (
    SELECT
        state_name
        , state_abbreviation
    FROM {{ ref('stg_map__states') }}
)

SELECT
    lower(trim(s."Id"))::VARCHAR AS patient_id
    , s."BIRTHDATE"::DATE AS birth_date
    , s."DEATHDATE"::DATE AS death_date
    , NULLIF(trim(s."SSN"), '')::VARCHAR AS ssn
    , NULLIF(trim(s."DRIVERS"), '')::VARCHAR AS drivers_license_number
    , NULLIF(trim(s."PASSPORT"), '')::VARCHAR AS passport_number
    , NULLIF(trim(s."PREFIX"), '')::VARCHAR AS patient_prefix
    , NULLIF(trim(s."FIRST"), '')::VARCHAR AS patient_first_name
    , NULLIF(trim(s."LAST"), '')::VARCHAR AS patient_last_name
    , NULLIF(trim(s."SUFFIX"), '')::VARCHAR AS patient_suffix
    , NULLIF(trim(s."MAIDEN"), '')::VARCHAR AS maiden_name
    , CASE WHEN NULLIF(trim(s."MARITAL"), '') IS NULL THEN NULL
           ELSE coalesce(cm.standard_value, trim(s."MARITAL")) END::VARCHAR AS marital_status
    , CASE WHEN NULLIF(trim(s."RACE"), '') IS NULL THEN NULL
           ELSE coalesce(cr.standard_value, trim(s."RACE")) END::VARCHAR AS race
    , CASE WHEN NULLIF(trim(s."ETHNICITY"), '') IS NULL THEN NULL
           ELSE coalesce(ce.standard_value, trim(s."ETHNICITY")) END::VARCHAR AS ethnicity
    , CASE WHEN NULLIF(trim(s."GENDER"), '') IS NULL THEN NULL
           ELSE coalesce(cg.standard_value, trim(s."GENDER")) END::VARCHAR AS patient_gender
    , NULLIF(trim(s."BIRTHPLACE"), '')::VARCHAR AS birthplace
    , NULLIF(trim(s."ADDRESS"), '')::VARCHAR AS patient_address
    , NULLIF(trim(s."CITY"), '')::VARCHAR AS patient_city
    , CASE WHEN NULLIF(trim(s."STATE"), '') IS NULL THEN NULL
           ELSE coalesce(st1.state_name, st2.state_name, trim(s."STATE")) END::VARCHAR AS patient_state
    , NULLIF(trim(s."COUNTY"), '')::VARCHAR AS patient_county
    , CASE
        WHEN NULLIF(trim(s."ZIP"), '') IS NULL THEN NULL
        WHEN regexp_matches(trim(s."ZIP"), '^[0-9]{1,4}$') THEN lpad(trim(s."ZIP"), 5, '0')
        ELSE trim(s."ZIP")
      END::VARCHAR AS patient_zip
    , s."LAT"::FLOAT AS patient_latitude
    , s."LON"::FLOAT AS patient_longitude
    , s."HEALTHCARE_EXPENSES"::FLOAT AS healthcare_expenses
    , s."HEALTHCARE_COVERAGE"::FLOAT AS healthcare_coverage
FROM src AS s
LEFT JOIN codes AS cg
    ON cg.list_name = 'gender' AND cg.local_code = trim(s."GENDER")
LEFT JOIN codes AS cm
    ON cm.list_name = 'marital' AND cm.local_code = trim(s."MARITAL")
LEFT JOIN codes AS cr
    ON cr.list_name = 'race' AND cr.local_code = trim(s."RACE")
LEFT JOIN codes AS ce
    ON ce.list_name = 'ethnicity' AND ce.local_code = trim(s."ETHNICITY")
LEFT JOIN states AS st1
    ON lower(st1.state_abbreviation) = lower(trim(s."STATE"))
LEFT JOIN states AS st2
    ON lower(st2.state_name) = lower(trim(s."STATE"))
```

```sql
WITH src AS (

    SELECT
        lower(trim("Id")) AS encounter_id
        , timezone('UTC', "START") AS start_dt
        , timezone('UTC', "STOP") AS stop_dt
        , lower(trim("PATIENT")) AS patient_id
        , lower(trim("ORGANIZATION")) AS organization_id
        , lower(trim("PROVIDER")) AS provider_id
        , lower(trim("PAYER")) AS payer_id
        , trim("ENCOUNTERCLASS") AS class_local
        , nullif(regexp_replace(trim("CODE"), '^[A-Za-z]+:', ''), '') AS encounter_code
        , nullif(trim("DESCRIPTION"), '') AS encounter_description
        , "BASE_ENCOUNTER_COST" AS base_cost
        , "TOTAL_CLAIM_COST" AS total_cost
        , "PAYER_COVERAGE" AS payer_coverage
        , nullif(regexp_replace(trim("REASONCODE"), '^[A-Za-z]+:', ''), '') AS reason_code
        , nullif(trim("REASONDESCRIPTION"), '') AS reason_description
    FROM {{ source('raw_d3', 'encounters') }}

)

, class_map AS (

    SELECT
        trim(local_code) AS local_code
        , min(trim(standard_value)) AS standard_value
    FROM {{ source('raw_d3', 'code_map') }}
    WHERE list_name = 'encounter_class'
    GROUP BY trim(local_code)

)

, final AS (

    SELECT
        s.encounter_id
        , s.start_dt AS encounter_start_datetime
        , CAST(s.start_dt AS DATE) AS encounter_start_date
        , COALESCE(s.stop_dt, s.start_dt) AS encounter_stop_datetime
        , COALESCE(CAST(s.start_dt AS DATE), CAST(COALESCE(s.stop_dt, s.start_dt) AS DATE)) AS encounter_stop_date
        , s.patient_id
        , s.organization_id
        , s.provider_id
        , s.payer_id
        , COALESCE(m.standard_value, s.class_local) AS encounter_class
        , s.encounter_code
        , s.encounter_description
        , CAST(s.base_cost AS FLOAT) AS base_encounter_cost
        , CAST(s.total_cost AS FLOAT) AS total_encounter_cost
        , CAST(s.payer_coverage AS FLOAT) AS encounter_payer_coverage
        , s.reason_code AS encounter_reason_code
        , s.reason_description AS encounter_reason_description
    FROM src AS s
    LEFT JOIN class_map AS m
        ON s.class_local = m.local_code

)
```

## Mapping hints
- CODE carries the prefix 'SCT:': strip it.
- REASONCODE carries the prefix 'SCT:': strip it.
- ENCOUNTERCLASS holds local codes: translate with raw_d3.code_map where list_name = 'encounter_class' (local_code to standard_value).
- Column names and all other values are as in the acquirer's source table.
text:

```sql
WITH class_map AS (

    SELECT
        local_code
        , MAX(standard_value) AS standard_value
    FROM {{ source('raw_d3', 'code_map') }}
    WHERE list_name = 'encounter_class'
    GROUP BY local_code

)

, cte_enc AS (

    SELECT
        e."Id" AS encounter_id
        , timezone('UTC', e."START") AS encounter_start_datetime
        , COALESCE(timezone('UTC', e."STOP"), timezone('UTC', e."START")) AS encounter_stop_datetime
        , e."PATIENT" AS patient_id
        , e."ORGANIZATION" AS organization_id
        , e."PROVIDER" AS provider_id
        , e."PAYER" AS payer_id
        , COALESCE(m.standard_value, e."ENCOUNTERCLASS") AS encounter_class
        , regexp_replace(e."CODE", '^SCT:', '') AS encounter_code
        , e."DESCRIPTION" AS encounter_description
        , CAST(e."BASE_ENCOUNTER_COST" AS FLOAT) AS base_encounter_cost
        , CAST(e."TOTAL_CLAIM_COST" AS FLOAT) AS total_encounter_cost
        , CAST(e."PAYER_COVERAGE" AS FLOAT) AS encounter_payer_coverage
        , NULLIF(regexp_replace(e."REASONCODE", '^SCT:', ''), '') AS encounter_reason_code
        , e."REASONDESCRIPTION" AS encounter_reason_description
    FROM {{ source('raw_d3', 'encounters') }} AS e
    LEFT JOIN class_map AS m
        ON e."ENCOUNTERCLASS" = m.local_code

)

    CAST(encounter_id AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id
    , CAST(encounter_start_datetime AS TIMESTAMP) AS encounter_start_datetime
    , CAST(encounter_start_datetime AS DATE) AS encounter_start_date
    , CAST(encounter_stop_datetime AS TIMESTAMP) AS encounter_stop_datetime
    , COALESCE(CAST(encounter_start_datetime AS DATE), CAST(encounter_stop_datetime AS DATE)) AS encounter_stop_date
    , CAST(patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id
    , CAST(organization_id AS VARCHAR) AS organization_id
    , CAST(provider_id AS VARCHAR) AS provider_id
    , CAST(payer_id AS VARCHAR) AS payer_id
    , CAST(encounter_class AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_class
    , CAST(encounter_code AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_code
    , CAST(encounter_description AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_description
    , base_encounter_cost
    , total_encounter_cost
    , encounter_payer_coverage
    , CAST(encounter_reason_code AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_reason_code
    , CAST(encounter_reason_description AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_reason_description
FROM cte_enc
```

```sql
    , coalesce(sum(case when pp.plan_source_value = 'Humana' then datediff('month', pp.payer_plan_period_start_date, pp.payer_plan_period_end_date) end), 0) as months_humana
    , coalesce(sum(case when pp.plan_source_value = 'Medicaid' then datediff('month', pp.payer_plan_period_start_date, pp.payer_plan_period_end_date) end), 0) as months_medicaid
    , coalesce(sum(case when pp.plan_source_value = 'Medicare' then datediff('month', pp.payer_plan_period_start_date, pp.payer_plan_period_end_date) end), 0) as months_medicare
    , coalesce(sum(case when pp.plan_source_value = 'NO_INSURANCE' then datediff('month', pp.payer_plan_period_start_date, pp.payer_plan_period_end_date) end), 0) as months_no_insurance
    , coalesce(sum(case when pp.plan_source_value = 'UnitedHealthcare' then datediff('month', pp.payer_plan_period_start_date, pp.payer_plan_period_end_date) end), 0) as months_unitedhealthcare

left join {{ ref('payer_plan_period') }} as pp

group by p.person_id
```

```sql
WITH src AS (

    SELECT
        CAST(("DATE" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS TIMESTAMP) AS observation_datetime
        , lower(nullif(trim("PATIENT"), '')) AS patient_id
        , lower(nullif(trim("ENCOUNTER"), '')) AS encounter_id

        , nullif(trim("UNITS"), '') AS raw_units
        , lower(nullif(trim("TYPE"), '')) AS observation_value_type
    FROM {{ source('raw_d3', 'observations') }}

)

, units_clean AS (

    SELECT
        *
        , CASE
            WHEN raw_units IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN lower(raw_units) IN ('mmhg', 'mm hg', 'mm[hg]') THEN 'mm[Hg]'
            WHEN lower(raw_units) IN ('celsius', 'degc', '°c') THEN 'Cel'
            ELSE
                regexp_replace(
                    replace(replace(raw_units, 'µ', 'u'), 'μ', 'u')
```

```sql
        , TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Line submitted amount"), '') AS DOUBLE) AS total_cost
        , NULLIF(TRIM("Diagnosis code"), '') AS reason_code
        , NULLIF(TRIM("Diagnosis description"), '') AS reason_description
    FROM src

)

SELECT

    , CAST(medication_start_datetime AS DATE) AS medication_start_date
    , medication_stop_datetime AS medication_stop_datetime
    , CAST(medication_stop_datetime AS DATE) AS medication_stop_date
    , CAST(patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id
    , CAST(payer_id AS VARCHAR) AS payer_id
    , CAST(encounter_id AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id
    , CAST(medication_code AS VARCHAR) AS medication_code
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS medication_description
    , CAST(base_cost AS FLOAT) AS medication_base_cost
    , CAST(payer_coverage AS FLOAT) AS medication_payer_coverage
    , CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN base_cost IS NOT NULL AND base_cost > 0 AND total_cost IS NOT NULL
                THEN ROUND(total_cost / base_cost)
        END AS FLOAT
    ) AS dispenses
    , CAST(total_cost AS FLOAT) AS medication_total_cost
    , CAST(reason_code AS VARCHAR) AS medication_reason_code
    , CAST(reason_description AS VARCHAR) AS medication_reason_description
FROM typed
```

```sql
        END AS race
        , CASE
            WHEN eth_code = '2135-2' THEN 'hispanic'
            WHEN eth_code = '2186-5' THEN 'nonhispanic'
            WHEN eth_text LIKE 'not hispanic%' THEN 'nonhispanic'
            WHEN eth_text LIKE 'hispanic%' THEN 'hispanic'
        END AS ethnicity
        , CASE
            WHEN lower(json_extract_string(resource, '$.gender')) = 'male' THEN 'M'
            WHEN lower(json_extract_string(resource, '$.gender')) = 'female' THEN 'F'
            WHEN upper(json_extract_string(sex_ext, '$.valueCode')) IN ('M', 'F')
                THEN upper(json_extract_string(sex_ext, '$.valueCode'))
        END AS patient_gender
        , nullif(concat_ws(
            '  '
            , nullif(json_extract_string(bp_ext, '$.valueAddress.city'), '')
            , nullif(json_extract_string(bp_ext, '$.valueAddress.state'), '')
            , nullif(json_extract_string(bp_ext, '$.valueAddress.country'), '')
        ), '') AS birthplace
        , nullif(trim(json_extract_string(a1, '$.line[0]')), '') AS patient_address
        , nullif(trim(json_extract_string(a1, '$.city')), '') AS patient_city
        , nullif(trim(json_extract_string(a1, '$.state')), '') AS state_raw
        , nullif(trim(json_extract_string(a1, '$.postalCode')), '') AS patient_zip
        , CAST(json_extract_string(lat_obj, '$.valueDecimal') AS FLOAT) AS patient_latitude
        , CAST(json_extract_string(lon_obj, '$.valueDecimal') AS FLOAT) AS patient_longitude
    FROM parts3

)
```

## Mapping hints
- patient_id is the resource id. birth_date is birthDate. death_date is the first 10 characters of deceasedDateTime (the local date).
- ssn, drivers licence and passport are identifier[] entries whose type.coding[0].code is SS, DL and PPN.
- Names come from the name[] entry with use = official (prefix[0], given[0], family, suffix[0]); the maiden name is the family of the entry with use = maiden.
- marital status is maritalStatus.coding[0].code. gender: male becomes M, female becomes F.
- race is the ombCategory display of the us-core-race extension, written as the acquirer writes it: White = white, Black or African American = black, Asian = asian, American Indian or Alaska Native = native, Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander = hawaiian, anything else = other. ethnicity: Hispanic or Latino = hispanic, otherwise nonhispanic.
- birthplace is city, state and country of the birthPlace extension joined by two spaces.
- address is address[0].line[0]; city and postalCode as given; the state is an abbreviation and the acquirer stores the full name (stg_map__states); latitude and longitude are in the geolocation extension of address[0].
- The county and the two healthcare amounts are not in the resource: return NULL.

```sql
        list_filter(exts, lambda x: json_extract_string(x, '$.url') like '%us-core-race')[1] as race_ext,
        list_filter(exts, lambda x: json_extract_string(x, '$.url') like '%us-core-ethnicity')[1] as eth_ext,
        list_filter(exts, lambda x: json_extract_string(x, '$.url') like '%patient-birthPlace')[1] as bp_ext,
        list_filter(
            cast(json_extract(addr, '$.extension') as json[]),
            lambda x: json_extract_string(x, '$.url') like '%geolocation'
        )[1] as geo_ext
    from parsed

),

detail as (

    select
        patient_id,
        birth_raw,
        death_raw,
        gender_raw,
        marital_raw,
        addr,
        ssn_ident,
        dl_ident,
        ppn_ident,
        official_name,
        maiden_entry,
        bp_ext,
        json_extract_string(
            list_filter(
                cast(json_extract(race_ext, '$.extension') as json[]),
                lambda y: json_extract_string(y, '$.url') = 'ombCategory'
            )[1],
            '$.valueCoding.display'
        ) as race_display,
        json_extract_string(
            list_filter(
                cast(json_extract(eth_ext, '$.extension') as json[]),
                lambda y: json_extract_string(y, '$.url') = 'ombCategory'
            )[1],
            '$.valueCoding.display'
        ) as eth_display,
        json_extract_string(
            list_filter(
                cast(json_extract(geo_ext, '$.extension') as json[]),
                lambda y: json_extract_string(y, '$.url') = 'latitude'
            )[1],
            '$.valueDecimal'
        ) as lat_raw,
        json_extract_string(
            list_filter(
                cast(json_extract(geo_ext, '$.extension') as json[]),
                lambda y: json_extract_string(y, '$.url') = 'longitude'
            )[1],
            '$.valueDecimal'
        ) as lon_raw
    from picked

),

states as (

    select
        upper(trim(state_abbreviation)) as abbr,
        min(state_name) as state_name
    from {{ ref('stg_map__states') }}
    group by 1

)

select
    cast(d.patient_id as varchar) as patient_id,
    cast(d.birth_raw as date) as birth_date,
    case
        when d.death_raw is null then null
        else cast(substr(d.death_raw, 1, 10) as date)
    end as death_date,
    cast(json_extract_string(d.ssn_ident, '$.value') as varchar) as ssn,
    cast(json_extract_string(d.dl_ident, '$.value') as varchar) as drivers_license_number,
    cast(json_extract_string(d.ppn_ident, '$.value') as varchar) as passport_number,
    cast(json_extract_string(d.official_name, '$.prefix[0]') as varchar) as patient_prefix,
    cast(json_extract_string(d.official_name, '$.given[0]') as varchar) as patient_first_name,
    cast(json_extract_string(d.official_name, '$.family') as varchar) as patient_last_name,
    cast(json_extract_string(d.official_name, '$.suffix[0]') as varchar) as patient_suffix,
    cast(json_extract_string(d.maiden_entry, '$.family') as varchar) as maiden_name,
    cast(d.marital_raw as varchar) as marital_status,
    cast(case
        when d.race_display is null then null
        when d.race_display = 'White' then 'white'
        when d.race_display = 'Black or African American' then 'black'
        when d.race_display = 'Asian' then 'asian'
        when d.race_display = 'American Indian or Alaska Native' then 'native'
        when d.race_display = 'Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander' then 'hawaiian'
        else 'other'
    end as varchar) as race,
    cast(case
        when d.eth_display = 'Hispanic or Latino' then 'hispanic'
        else 'nonhispanic'
    end as varchar) as ethnicity,
    cast(case lower(d.gender_raw)
        when 'male' then 'M'
        when 'female' then 'F'
        else null
    end as varchar) as patient_gender,
    cast(
        case
            when d.bp_ext is null then null
            else concat_ws(
                '  ',
                json_extract_string(d.bp_ext, '$.valueAddress.city'),
                json_extract_string(d.bp_ext, '$.valueAddress.state'),
                json_extract_string(d.bp_ext, '$.valueAddress.country')
            )
        end as varchar
    ) as birthplace,
    cast(json_extract_string(d.addr, '$.line[0]') as varchar) as patient_address,
    cast(json_extract_string(d.addr, '$.city') as varchar) as patient_city,
    cast(coalesce(s.state_name, json_extract_string(d.addr, '$.state')) as varchar) as patient_state,
    cast(null as varchar) as patient_county,
    cast(json_extract_string(d.addr, '$.postalCode') as varchar) as patient_zip,
    cast(cast(d.lat_raw as double) as float) as patient_latitude,
    cast(cast(d.lon_raw as double) as float) as patient_longitude,
    cast(null as float) as healthcare_expenses,
    cast(null as float) as healthcare_coverage
from detail d
left join states s
    on upper(trim(json_extract_string(d.addr, '$.state'))) = s.abbr
```

## Mapping hints
- patient_id is the resource id. birth_date is birthDate. death_date is the first 10 characters of deceasedDateTime (the local date).
- ssn, drivers licence and passport are identifier[] entries whose type.coding[0].code is SS, DL and PPN.
- Names come from the name[] entry with use = official (prefix[0], given[0], family, suffix[0]); the maiden name is the family of the entry with use = maiden.
- marital status is maritalStatus.coding[0].code. gender: male becomes M, female becomes F.
- race is the ombCategory display of the us-core-race extension, written as the acquirer writes it: White = white, Black or African American = black, Asian = asian, American Indian or Alaska Native = native, Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander = hawaiian, anything else = other. ethnicity: Hispanic or Latino = hispanic, otherwise nonhispanic.
- birthplace is city, state and country of the birthPlace extension joined by two spaces.
- address is address[0].line[0]; city and postalCode as given; the state is an abbreviation and the acquirer stores the full name (stg_map__states); latitude and longitude are in the geolocation extension of address[0].
- The county and the two healthcare amounts are not in the resource: return NULL.
